```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;

/** The counter-tests of the deadcode check. */
final class DeadcodeCanaries {

  private static final String TESTS = "core/src/test/java/dev/metis/core/";

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          // An entry for the one method a canary class needs, so that its other method is unused.
          Canary.of("deadcode-public-method", "deadcode", "CanaryDead.idle() is never used")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryDead.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  public final class CanaryDead {
                    private CanaryDead() {}

                    public static int used() {
                      return 1;
                    }

                    public static int idle() {
                      return 2;
                    }
                  }
                  """)
              .appending("config/entry-points.txt", "dev.metis.core.CanaryDead.used: a canary\n"),
          Canary.of("deadcode-test-only", "deadcode", "core: class dev.metis.core.CanaryTestOnly")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryTestOnly.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  final class CanaryTestOnly {
                    private CanaryTestOnly() {}

                    static int one() {
                      return 1;
                    }
                  }
                  """)
              .writing(
                  TESTS + "CanaryTestOnlyTest.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

                  import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

                  class CanaryTestOnlyTest {
                    @Test
                    void one() {
                      assertThat(CanaryTestOnly.one()).isEqualTo(1);
                    }
                  }
                  """),
          Canary.of(
                  "deadcode-test-helper",
                  "deadcode",
                  "core tests: class dev.metis.core.CanaryHelper")
              .writing(
                  TESTS + "CanaryHelper.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  final class CanaryHelper {
                    private CanaryHelper() {}

                    static String help() {
                      return "help";
                    }
                  }
                  """),
          // A library the tool declares and never uses, which no bundle of a starter names; the
          // advice of the plugin, which no error of the lock prints.
          Canary.of("deadcode-dependency", "deadcode", "implementation(\"org.slf4j:slf4j-api")
              .appending(
                  "tools/build.gradle.kts",
                  "\ndependencies {\n    implementation(\"org.slf4j:slf4j-api\")\n}\n"),
          // A library of Spring declared and never used, which no starter may stand for.
          Canary.of(
                  "deadcode-spring-dependency",
                  "deadcode",
                  "implementation(\"org.springframework:spring-expression")
              .appending(
                  "core/build.gradle.kts",
                  "\ndependencies {\n    implementation(\"org.springframework:spring-expression\")\n}\n"),
          // A library a bundle names, declared and unused by the code of the core, which the
          // bundle would hide.
          Canary.of("deadcode-bundle-member", "deadcode", "a bundle names what a project declares")
              .appending(
                  "core/build.gradle.kts",
                  "\ndependencies {\n    implementation(\"org.springframework:spring-web\")\n}\n"),
          // A bean Spring makes by itself, one of whose methods nothing calls.
          Canary.of("deadcode-bean-method", "deadcode", "CanaryBean.idle() is never used")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryBean.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

                  @Component
                  final class CanaryBean {
                    public int idle() {
                      return 1;
                    }
                  }
                  """),
          // A file of settings of a profile, which Spring Boot reads as it reads application.yml.
          Canary.of("deadcode-setting", "deadcode", "metis.unread")
              .writing(
                  "core/src/main/resources/application-canary.yml", "metis:\n  unread: true\n"));

  private DeadcodeCanaries() {}
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;

/** The counter-tests of the language check. */
final class LanguageCanaries {

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          // The letters as escapes, so that this file stays English.
          Canary.of("language-vietnamese", "language", "non-ascii-letter")
              .writing(Canaries.CORE + "CanaryVietnamese.java", comment("Ti\u1ebfng Vi\u1ec7t")),
          Canary.of("language-ruling", "language", "plan-reference")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryRuling.java",
                  comment("closes on select, as R-" + "B15 says")),
          Canary.of("language-date", "language", ": date: ")
              .writing(Canaries.CORE + "CanaryDate.java", comment("measured on 9 Oct" + " 2026")),
          // A migration, whose comments open with two dashes.
          Canary.of("language-sql-date", "language", "V0__canary.sql:1: date")
              .writing(
                  "core/src/main/resources/db/migration/V0__canary.sql",
                  "-- measured on 9 Oct" + " 2026\nselect 1;\n"),
          // The title of a test, which a reader sees as a comment.
          Canary.of("language-test-title", "language", "CanaryTitleTest.java:7: plan-reference")
              .writing(
                  "core/src/test/java/dev/metis/core/CanaryTitleTest.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
                  import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

                  class CanaryTitleTest {
                    @DisplayName("TEN-02 as R-%s says")
                    @Test
                    void one() {}
                  }
                  """
                      .formatted("B15")));

  private LanguageCanaries() {}

  // A class of the core whose only comment is the text.
  private static String comment(String text) {
    return """
        package dev.metis.core;

        // %s
        final class Canary {}
        """
        .formatted(text);
  }
}
```

### Task 3: The platform: errors, security and the clock

The first module, `platform`, without a database yet. `web`: every error leaves as Problem Details, the record `Problem` with its `kind` and a `correlationId`, Spring's own exceptions included, through one advice, and the line a defect logs holds the types and the frames of its causes and never a message, which may hold a value of a record; a filter first in the chain gives each request its id, for the logs and the error body, and sets `Cache-Control: no-store`; the error page of the server answers as Problem Details too, a request for the page itself is a missing path, and Tomcat hands an encoded slash on, so that the firewall of Spring Security refuses it with a body. `security`: bearer tokens only, no session, no cookie, no CSRF token; the decoder reads the keys of the issuer at the first token, checks the issuer, the audience `metis-core`, an expiry, which a token must have, and the time of the machine, whatever date the core is fixed at; a decoder whose keys cannot be read rejects the token, so the answer is 401 and never 500; a token whose `tenant_id` is not one UUID written in full, in either case, alone or as the one value of a list, or that has no subject, is not trusted; the controller receives `CurrentUser`, and Spring names the person by the subject alone, never by the text of the whole user with its tenant. Spring Security 7 publishes the metadata of the resource to anyone, so it says only what holds. `time`: the business clock, which `metis.time.fixed` stops at a date under the profile `demo` or `test` alone, and the time of the machine, which nothing else reads. `logging`: after the token is checked, the tenant goes on every log line of the request, and one line per request names its route, never its path. The tests that start the whole core send a token of the issuer of the tests, which serves its keys on this machine; the architecture rule against the system clock now spares the clock bean, and the mutation judge holds every project with code to its mutants, since the core has its first.

```kotlin
import java.time.Duration

plugins {
    id("metis.java-conventions")
    alias(libs.plugins.spring.boot)
    alias(libs.plugins.license.report)
}

// What the tests of both kinds share, such as the issuer of their tokens.
val shared = layout.projectDirectory.dir("src/testShared/java")
sourceSets.test {
    java.srcDir(shared)
}

// The tests on a real PostgreSQL and a real Keycloak, apart from the tests that need no container.
val integrationTest = sourceSets.create("integrationTest") {
    java.srcDir(shared)
    java.srcDir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("test-support/java"))
    // The architecture rules run with the unit tests alone, and need ArchUnit, which these lack.
    java.exclude("**/ArchitectureRules.java")
    resources.srcDir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("test-support/resources"))
    compileClasspath += sourceSets.main.get().output
    runtimeClasspath += sourceSets.main.get().output
}

// As the unit tests do, so the versions and the libraries of the core hold for them too.
configurations[integrationTest.implementationConfigurationName].extendsFrom(configurations.implementation.get())
configurations[integrationTest.runtimeOnlyConfigurationName].extendsFrom(configurations.runtimeOnly.get())

dependencies {
    implementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc")
    implementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-security-oauth2-resource-server")
    implementation("org.slf4j:slf4j-api")
    implementation("tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind")
    runtimeOnly("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-actuator")
    testImplementation(libs.archunit)
    testImplementation("org.awaitility:awaitility")
    testImplementation("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-params")
    testImplementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-security-test")
    testImplementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test")
    "integrationTestImplementation"(platform(libs.junit.bom))
    "integrationTestImplementation"("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-api")
    "integrationTestImplementation"("org.assertj:assertj-core")
    "integrationTestCompileOnly"("org.jspecify:jspecify")
    "integrationTestRuntimeOnly"("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-engine")
    "integrationTestRuntimeOnly"("org.junit.platform:junit-platform-launcher")
}

val integrationTestTask = tasks.register<Test>("integrationTest") {
    description = "Runs the tests on a real PostgreSQL and a real Keycloak."
    testClassesDirs = integrationTest.output.classesDirs
    classpath = integrationTest.runtimeClasspath
    // One JVM, so the containers and the contexts of Spring start once for every class.
    maxParallelForks = 1
    // The tests read the stack's own files, so the stack and the tests share one source.
    workingDir = rootDir
    // Those files are inputs, so a changed stack runs the tests again and no cached result stands in.
    inputs.dir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("stack")).withPathSensitivity(PathSensitivity.RELATIVE)
    // A test that would wait for ever fails the check after this instead of holding it.
    timeout = Duration.ofMinutes(20)
}

// Coverage counts the lines both test tasks run, since only a database runs a repository.
tasks.jacocoTestReport {
    dependsOn(integrationTestTask)
    executionData(tasks.test.get(), integrationTestTask.get())
}

tasks.register<Test>("deadcodeTest") {
    description = "Runs the test that every setting of application.yml is one that something defines."
    testClassesDirs = sourceSets.test.get().output.classesDirs
    classpath = sourceSets.test.get().runtimeClasspath
    useJUnitPlatform {
        includeTags("deadcode")
    }
}

licenseReport {
    configurations = arrayOf("runtimeClasspath")
    filters = arrayOf(com.github.jk1.license.filter.SpdxLicenseBundleNormalizer())
    allowedLicensesFile = rootProject.file("config/allowed-licenses.json")
}
```

```kotlin
plugins {
    alias(libs.plugins.spotless)
}

dependencyLocking {
    lockAllConfigurations()
}

spotless {
    java {
        target("core/src/**/*.java", "tools/src/**/*.java", "test-support/**/*.java")
        googleJavaFormat(libs.versions.google.java.format.get())
        removeUnusedImports()
    }
    format("misc") {
        target(
            "**/*.kts", "**/*.md", "**/*.yml", "**/*.yaml", "**/*.toml", "**/*.properties",
            "**/*.json", "**/*.xml", "**/*.txt", "**/Dockerfile", "**/.gitignore", ".dockerignore",
            "verify", "canary",
        )
        targetExclude("**/build/**", "**/.gradle/**", "**/.kotlin/**", "gradle/verification-metadata.xml")
        trimTrailingWhitespace()
        endWithNewline()
    }
}

// A scanner that is no Gradle plugin, run as its pinned image in the tree, which it reads only.
fun scanner(name: String, image: Provider<String>, options: List<String>, vararg arguments: String) =
    tasks.register<Exec>(name) {
        val tree = rootDir.absolutePath
        commandLine(
            listOf("docker", "run", "--rm", "--volume", "$tree:/work:ro", "--workdir", "/work") +
                options + listOf(image.get()) + arguments,
        )
    }

// Trivy keeps its database in a volume of its own, so a scan downloads it once a day at most.
val trivy = listOf("--volume", "metis-trivy-cache:/root/.cache")

scanner(
    "depsVulnerabilities", libs.versions.image.trivy, trivy,
    "fs", "--scanners", "vuln", "--exit-code", "1", "--quiet",
    "--skip-dirs", "/work/build", "--skip-dirs", "/work/**/build", "--skip-dirs", "/work/.gradle", "/work",
)

// A relative folder, so the paths the allow-list of .gitleaks.toml matches start at the root.
scanner(
    "secretsScan", libs.versions.image.gitleaks, listOf(),
    "dir", ".", "--no-banner", "--redact", "--verbose", "--config", ".gitleaks.toml",
)

// actionlint finds the workflows through .git, which the copy of a canary lacks, so each is named.
val workflows = file(".github/workflows").list().orEmpty().sorted().map { ".github/workflows/$it" }

scanner("workflowLint", libs.versions.image.actionlint, listOf(), "-color", *workflows.toTypedArray())

// The image the image check builds from the sources, with Docker alone, as any platform would.
tasks.register<Exec>("imageBuild") {
    commandLine("docker", "build", "--file", "core/Dockerfile", "--tag", "metis-core:check", ".")
}

tasks.register<Exec>("imageLint") {
    val dockerfile = file("core/Dockerfile")
    commandLine("docker", "run", "--rm", "--interactive", libs.versions.image.hadolint.get(), "hadolint", "-")
    doFirst {
        standardInput = dockerfile.inputStream()
    }
}

// Trivy reads the image from an archive in the tree, so it needs no hand on the Docker daemon.
tasks.register<Exec>("imageSave") {
    dependsOn("imageBuild")
    val archive = layout.buildDirectory.file("image/core.tar")
    doFirst {
        archive.get().asFile.parentFile.mkdirs()
    }
    commandLine("docker", "save", "--output", archive.get().asFile.path, "metis-core:check")
}

scanner(
    "imageScan", libs.versions.image.trivy, trivy,
    "image", "--input", "/work/build/image/core.tar", "--scanners", "vuln", "--exit-code", "1", "--quiet",
).configure { dependsOn("imageSave") }

// The checks of ./verify, which runs them in the order of the list of the tool, Checks.ORDER.

tasks.register("checkFormat") {
    description = "Every source file is formatted."
    dependsOn("spotlessCheck")
}

tasks.register("checkCompile") {
    description = "The code compiles with every warning an error, no bug pattern and no null where none is allowed."
    dependsOn(
        ":core:compileJava", ":core:compileTestJava", ":core:compileIntegrationTestJava",
        ":tools:compileJava", ":tools:compileTestJava",
    )
}

tasks.register("checkLint") {
    description = "No method above a complexity of 10, no file above 300 lines, a reason on every mark."
    dependsOn(
        ":core:checkstyleMain", ":core:checkstyleTest", ":core:checkstyleIntegrationTest",
        ":tools:checkstyleMain", ":tools:checkstyleTest", ":tools:marks",
    )
}

tasks.register("checkLanguage") {
    description = "English only, and no comment that cites a plan, a ruling, a task, a date or a line of a file."
    dependsOn(":tools:language")
}

tasks.register("checkArchitecture") {
    description = "The architecture rules of both projects hold."
    dependsOn(":core:architectureTest", ":tools:architectureTest", ":tools:judgeArchitecture")
}

tasks.register("checkDeadcode") {
    description = "Nothing unused: code, test helpers, dependencies and settings."
    dependsOn(
        ":core:projectHealth", ":tools:projectHealth", "bundledDeclared", ":tools:deadcode",
        ":core:deadcodeTest", ":tools:judgeDeadcode",
    )
}

tasks.register("checkTooling") {
    description = "The tests of the tool pass, every check has a counter-test, the workflow passes its linter."
    dependsOn(":tools:test", ":tools:judgeTooling", "workflowLint")
}

tasks.register("checkUnit") {
    description = "The tests of the core that need no container pass, none skipped, as many as the floor."
    dependsOn(":core:test", ":tools:judgeUnit")
}

tasks.register("checkIntegration") {
    description = "The tests on a real PostgreSQL and a real Keycloak pass, none skipped, as many as the floor."
    dependsOn(":core:integrationTest", ":tools:judgeIntegration")
}

tasks.register("checkCoverage") {
    description = "Every line and every branch of the core and the tool runs in a test."
    dependsOn(":core:jacocoTestReport", ":tools:jacocoTestReport", ":tools:judgeCoverage")
}

tasks.register("checkMutation") {
    description = "Every mutant PIT makes of the core and the tool is killed by a test."
    dependsOn(":core:pitest", ":tools:pitest", ":tools:judgeMutation")
}

tasks.register("checkDeps") {
    description = "No known vulnerability, only allowed licences, and current lock files and checksums."
    dependsOn("depsVulnerabilities", ":core:checkLicense", ":core:resolveLocked", ":tools:resolveLocked")
}

tasks.register("checkSecrets") {
    description = "No secret in the tree."
    dependsOn("secretsScan")
}

tasks.register("checkImage") {
    description = "The image builds from the sources, passes its linter and its scan, and runs locked down."
    dependsOn("imageLint", "imageBuild", "imageScan", ":tools:imageRun")
}

// A check whose judge did not run would pass on the exit of its tasks alone, so a check that owes
// facts fails without them; ./verify and ./canary clear the facts before each run of a check.
val factFree = setOf("checkFormat", "checkCompile", "checkDeps", "checkSecrets")
tasks.matching { it.name.matches(Regex("check[A-Z]\\w*")) && it.name !in factFree }.configureEach {
    val check = name.removePrefix("check").replaceFirstChar(Char::lowercase)
    val facts = layout.buildDirectory.file("facts/$check.txt")
    doLast {
        if (!facts.get().asFile.exists()) {
            throw GradleException("$name: its judge left no facts in build/facts/$check.txt")
        }
    }
}

// A starter stands for the libraries of it that the code uses, named one by one, which the plugin
// would otherwise ask to declare; a library a bundle names is never reported unused, so
// bundledDeclared refuses a project that declares one of them itself.
val starters =
    mapOf(
        "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc" to listOf(
            "org.apache.tomcat.embed:tomcat-embed-core",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-autoconfigure",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-tomcat",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-web-server",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-webmvc",
            "org.springframework:spring-context",
            "org.springframework:spring-core",
            "org.springframework:spring-web",
            "org.springframework:spring-webmvc",
        ),
        "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-security-oauth2-resource-server" to listOf(
            "com.nimbusds:nimbus-jose-jwt",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-security",
            "org.springframework.security:spring-security-config",
            "org.springframework.security:spring-security-core",
            "org.springframework.security:spring-security-oauth2-core",
            "org.springframework.security:spring-security-oauth2-jose",
            "org.springframework.security:spring-security-oauth2-resource-server",
            "org.springframework.security:spring-security-web",
        ),
        "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test" to listOf(
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-resttestclient",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-test",
            "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-webmvc-test",
            "org.springframework:spring-beans",
            "org.springframework:spring-test",
        ),
        "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-security-test" to listOf(
            "org.springframework.security:spring-security-test",
        ),
    )

configure<com.autonomousapps.DependencyAnalysisExtension> {
    structure {
        starters.forEach { (starter, libraries) ->
            bundle(starter.substringAfter(':')) {
                primary(starter)
                libraries.forEach { includeDependency(it) }
            }
        }
    }
    issues {
        all {
            onAny {
                severity("fail")
            }
        }
    }
}

val bundled = tasks.register("bundledDeclared") {
    description = "No project declares a library that a bundle names."
}

gradle.projectsEvaluated {
    val members = starters.values.flatten().toSet()
    val declared =
        subprojects.flatMap { project ->
            project.configurations.flatMap { configuration ->
                configuration.dependencies
                    .filter { "${it.group}:${it.name}" in members }
                    .map { "${it.group}:${it.name} in ${project.path} ${configuration.name}" }
            }
        }
    bundled.configure {
        doLast {
            if (declared.isNotEmpty()) {
                throw GradleException("a bundle names what a project declares, which it would never report: $declared")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the lock files and the checksums again**

A configuration in strict mode resolves only against its lock state, and an artifact only against its checksum, so a change of the dependencies writes both again, with every task run for real, since a task restored from the build cache resolves nothing.

```sh
./gradlew --console=plain --max-workers=5 --refresh-dependencies --write-locks --write-verification-metadata sha256 --rerun-tasks help spotlessCheck :core:checkLicense
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;
import java.lang.annotation.Retention;
import java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy;
import java.lang.annotation.Target;
import org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.WebMvcTest;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.ComponentScan;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.FilterType;
import org.springframework.core.annotation.AliasFor;
import org.springframework.test.annotation.DirtiesContext;
import org.springframework.test.context.TestPropertySource;

/**
 * A test of the web layer with the errors, the security and the filters of the platform, and no
 * database; the issuer is away, so a bearer token cannot be checked.
 */
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@WebMvcTest(
    includeFilters =
        @ComponentScan.Filter(
            type = FilterType.REGEX,
            pattern = "dev\\.metis\\.core\\.platform\\.(web|security|time|logging)\\..*"))
@TestPropertySource(properties = "metis.security.issuer=http://127.0.0.1:9/issuer")
// Each class starts its own context, so mutation testing runs every bean method under its mutant.
@DirtiesContext(classMode = DirtiesContext.ClassMode.BEFORE_CLASS)
public @interface WebLayerTest {

  /** The controllers under test. */
  @AliasFor(annotation = WebMvcTest.class, attribute = "controllers")
  Class<?>[] value() default {};
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import com.nimbusds.jose.JOSEException;
import com.nimbusds.jose.JWSAlgorithm;
import com.nimbusds.jose.JWSHeader;
import com.nimbusds.jose.crypto.RSASSASigner;
import com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.JWKSet;
import com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.RSAKey;
import com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.gen.RSAKeyGenerator;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.JWTClaimsSet;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.SignedJWT;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpHandler;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Date;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;

/** An issuer of signed tokens on this machine, which serves its key as Keycloak does. */
public final class TestIssuer {

  /** The date the clock of the core is fixed at in the tests, which no token follows. */
  public static final Instant NOW = Instant.parse("2026-09-22T03:00:00Z");

  // The key the issuer signs with and serves.
  private static final RSAKey KEY = key();

  /** The address of the issuer, which the core finds its keys from. */
  public static final String ISSUER = start();

  private TestIssuer() {}

  /** The claims of a token of the issuer for the core, valid from now for five minutes. */
  public static JWTClaimsSet.Builder claims(String subject, @Nullable Object tenant) {
    Instant issued = Instant.now();
    return new JWTClaimsSet.Builder()
        .issuer(ISSUER)
        .audience("metis-core")
        .subject(subject)
        .claim("tenant_id", tenant)
        .issueTime(Date.from(issued))
        .expirationTime(Date.from(issued.plusSeconds(300)));
  }

  /** A token signed with the key of the issuer. */
  public static String token(JWTClaimsSet.Builder claims) {
    return signed(KEY, claims);
  }

  /** A token for the subject in the tenant, as the issuer signs it. */
  public static String token(String subject, Object tenant) {
    return token(claims(subject, tenant));
  }

  // A token signed with the key given.
  private static String signed(RSAKey key, JWTClaimsSet.Builder claims) {
    try {
      SignedJWT jwt =
          new SignedJWT(
              new JWSHeader.Builder(JWSAlgorithm.RS256).keyID(key.getKeyID()).build(),
              claims.build());
      jwt.sign(new RSASSASigner(key));
      return jwt.serialize();
    } catch (JOSEException unsigned) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(unsigned);
    }
  }

  // A new key of the same id; the tests sign with one the issuer never serves.
  private static RSAKey key() {
    try {
      return new RSAKeyGenerator(2048).keyID("test").generate();
    } catch (JOSEException ungenerated) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(ungenerated);
    }
  }

  private static String start() {
    try {
      HttpServer server =
          HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress(), 0), 0);
      String issuer = "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort() + "/issuer";
      server.createContext(
          "/issuer/.well-known/openid-configuration",
          answer("{\"issuer\":\"" + issuer + "\",\"jwks_uri\":\"" + issuer + "/keys\"}"));
      server.createContext("/issuer/keys", answer(new JWKSet(KEY.toPublicJWK()).toString()));
      server.start();
      return issuer;
    } catch (IOException unstarted) {
      throw new UncheckedIOException(unstarted);
    }
  }

  private static HttpHandler answer(String json) {
    byte[] body = json.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    return exchange -> {
      exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", "application/json");
      exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, body.length);
      try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) {
        out.write(body);
      }
    };
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import static java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletRequest;
import org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletResponse;
import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;

class ProblemsTest {

  private final Problems problems = new Problems(JsonMapper.builder().build());

  @ParameterizedTest
  @CsvSource({
    "400, validation",
    "401, unauthenticated",
    "403, forbidden",
    "404, notFound",
    "405, validation",
    "499, validation",
    "500, server",
    "502, server",
    "503, unavailable"
  })
  void eachStatusHasTheKindTheAppReads(int status, String kind) {
    assertThat(Problems.kindOf(status)).isEqualTo(kind);
  }

  @ParameterizedTest
  @CsvSource({"404, Not Found", "503, Service Unavailable", "599, Error"})
  void aBodyHoldsTheTypeTheTitleTheStatusTheKindAndTheCorrelationIdAndNothingElse(
      int status, String title) {
    assertThat(Problems.body(status, "id"))
        .isEqualTo(new Problem("about:blank", title, status, Problems.kindOf(status), "id"));
  }

  @Test
  void anAnswerWrittenWhereNoControllerRunsSetsItsStatusItsTypeAndItsBody() throws Exception {
    MockHttpServletRequest request = new MockHttpServletRequest();
    request.setAttribute(Problems.REQUEST_ID, "id");
    MockHttpServletResponse response = new MockHttpServletResponse();
    problems.write(403, request, response);
    assertThat(response.getStatus()).isEqualTo(403);
    assertThat(response.getContentType()).isEqualTo(MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON_VALUE);
    assertThat(response.getContentAsString(UTF_8))
        .isEqualTo(
            "{\"type\":\"about:blank\",\"title\":\"Forbidden\",\"status\":403,"
                + "\"kind\":\"forbidden\",\"correlationId\":\"id\"}");
  }

  @Test
  void theErrorPageAnswersWithTheStatusTheServerSetBeforeItSentTheRequestThere() {
    MockHttpServletRequest request = new MockHttpServletRequest();
    MockHttpServletResponse response = new MockHttpServletResponse();
    response.setStatus(400);
    ResponseEntity<Problem> answer = new ErrorEndpoint(problems).error(request, response);
    assertThat(answer.getStatusCode().value()).isEqualTo(400);
    assertThat(answer.getHeaders().getContentType()).isEqualTo(MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON);
    assertThat(answer.getBody()).isEqualTo(Problems.body(400, "null"));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import static java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.jwt;

import dev.metis.core.WebLayerTest;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;
import org.slf4j.MDC;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.CapturedOutput;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.OutputCaptureExtension;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.MockMvcTester;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.MvcTestResult;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@WebLayerTest(ProblemAdviceTest.Failing.class)
@Import(ProblemAdviceTest.Failing.class)
@ExtendWith(OutputCaptureExtension.class)
class ProblemAdviceTest {

  private final MockMvcTester mvc;

  ProblemAdviceTest(@Autowired MockMvcTester mvc) {
    this.mvc = mvc;
  }

  /** Endpoints of the test, each failing in its own way. */
  @RestController
  static class Failing {

    @GetMapping("/test/defect")
    String defect() throws SQLException {
      throw new SQLException(
          "select secret from inside", new IllegalStateException("inner secret"));
    }
  }

  @ParameterizedTest
  @CsvSource({"/test/defect, 500", "/test/no-such-path, 404", "/error, 404"})
  void anErrorIsProblemDetailsWithItsKindAndTheIdOfTheRequestAndNothingInternal(
      String path, int status) throws Exception {
    MvcTestResult answer = mvc.get().uri(path).with(jwt()).exchange();
    assertThat(answer).hasStatus(status).hasContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON);
    Map<String, Object> body = bodyOf(answer);
    assertThat(body)
        .containsOnlyKeys("type", "title", "status", "kind", "correlationId")
        .containsEntry("status", status)
        .containsEntry("kind", Problems.kindOf(status));
    assertThat(String.valueOf(body.get("correlationId")))
        .matches("[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}");
    assertThat(answer.getResponse().getHeader(HttpHeaders.CACHE_CONTROL)).isEqualTo("no-store");
  }

  @Test
  void aMethodThePathDoesNotTakeIsAValidationError() throws Exception {
    MvcTestResult answer = mvc.post().uri("/test/defect").with(jwt()).exchange();
    assertThat(answer).hasStatus(405);
    assertThat(bodyOf(answer)).containsEntry("kind", "validation");
  }

  @Test
  void aDefectIsLoggedWithItsRequestByTheTypesAndFramesOfItsCausesAndNoMessage(
      CapturedOutput output) throws Exception {
    Object id = bodyOf(mvc.get().uri("/test/defect").with(jwt()).exchange()).get("correlationId");
    assertThat(output.getOut())
        .contains("a request failed: java.sql.SQLException")
        .contains("caused by java.lang.IllegalStateException")
        .contains("ProblemAdviceTest$Failing.defect")
        .contains("\"requestId\":\"" + id + "\"")
        .doesNotContain("select secret from inside")
        .doesNotContain("inner secret");
    assertThat(MDC.get(RequestFilter.LOG_KEY)).isNull();
  }

  @Test
  void aCauseThatLeadsBackIsWrittenOnce() {
    Exception first = new Exception("first");
    first.initCause(new Exception("second", first));
    assertThat(ProblemAdvice.trace(first).lines().filter(line -> !line.startsWith("\tat ")))
        .containsExactly("java.lang.Exception", "caused by java.lang.Exception");
  }

  @Test
  void eachRequestHasAnIdOfItsOwn() throws Exception {
    Object first =
        bodyOf(mvc.get().uri("/test/no-such-path").with(jwt()).exchange()).get("correlationId");
    Object second =
        bodyOf(mvc.get().uri("/test/no-such-path").with(jwt()).exchange()).get("correlationId");
    assertThat(first).isNotEqualTo(second);
  }

  private static Map<String, Object> bodyOf(MvcTestResult answer) throws Exception {
    return JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser()
        .parseMap(answer.getResponse().getContentAsString(UTF_8));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.apache.catalina.connector.Connector;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.boot.tomcat.servlet.TomcatServletWebServerFactory;

class EncodedSlashTest {

  @Test
  void tomcatHandsAnEncodedSlashOnToTheFirewall() {
    TomcatServletWebServerFactory factory = new TomcatServletWebServerFactory();
    new EncodedSlash().customize(factory);
    Connector connector = new Connector();
    factory.getConnectorCustomizers().forEach(customizer -> customizer.customize(connector));
    assertThat(connector.getEncodedSolidusHandling()).isEqualTo("passthrough");
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.security.internal;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import dev.metis.core.TestIssuer;
import dev.metis.core.platform.security.CurrentUser;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.core.OAuth2TokenValidatorResult;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.BadJwtException;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtClaimNames;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtDecoder;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtDecoderInitializationException;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtException;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.InvalidBearerTokenException;

class TokensTest {

  private static final String ISSUER = "http://issuer.test/realms/metis";
  private static final Instant NOW = Instant.parse("2026-09-22T03:00:00Z");
  private static final Clock CLOCK = Clock.fixed(NOW, ZoneOffset.UTC);
  private static final UUID TENANT = UUID.fromString("0b0e5a4e-7c5a-4f43-9d7e-1f2a3b4c5d6e");

  private static Jwt.Builder token() {
    return Jwt.withTokenValue("token")
        .header("alg", "RS256")
        .issuer(ISSUER)
        .audience(List.of(Tokens.AUDIENCE))
        .subject("subject")
        .claim(Tokens.TENANT, TENANT.toString())
        .issuedAt(NOW.minusSeconds(60))
        .expiresAt(NOW.plusSeconds(60));
  }

  private static OAuth2TokenValidatorResult check(Jwt.Builder token) {
    return Tokens.validator(ISSUER, CLOCK).validate(token.build());
  }

  @Test
  void aTokenOfTheIssuerForTheCoreAndValidByTheClockOfTheCorePasses() {
    assertThat(check(token()).hasErrors()).isFalse();
  }

  @Test
  void theTimeOfATokenIsReadFromTheClockItIsGiven() {
    Instant longAgo = Instant.parse("2001-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    Jwt.Builder fromThen = token().issuedAt(longAgo).expiresAt(longAgo.plusSeconds(60));
    assertThat(
            Tokens.validator(ISSUER, Clock.fixed(longAgo, ZoneOffset.UTC))
                .validate(fromThen.build())
                .hasErrors())
        .isFalse();
  }

  @Test
  void anExpiredTokenFails() {
    assertThat(
            check(token().issuedAt(NOW.minusSeconds(600)).expiresAt(NOW.minusSeconds(120)))
                .hasErrors())
        .isTrue();
  }

  @Test
  void aTokenWithoutAnExpiryFails() {
    assertThat(check(token().claims(claims -> claims.remove(JwtClaimNames.EXP))).hasErrors())
        .isTrue();
  }

  @Test
  void aTokenOfAnotherIssuerFails() {
    assertThat(check(token().issuer("http://other.test")).hasErrors()).isTrue();
  }

  @Test
  void aTokenForAnotherAudienceFails() {
    assertThat(check(token().audience(List.of("another-service"))).hasErrors()).isTrue();
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 the user of a token is its subject and the one tenant it names")
  void theUserOfAToken() {
    UserToken user = Tokens.user(token().build());
    assertThat(user.getPrincipal()).isEqualTo(new CurrentUser("subject", TENANT));
    assertThat(user.getName()).isEqualTo("subject");
    assertThat(user.isAuthenticated()).isTrue();
    assertThat(user.getCredentials()).isNull();
    assertThat(user.getAuthorities()).isEmpty();
  }

  @ParameterizedTest
  @ValueSource(strings = {"", "not-a-uuid", "1-1-1-1-1"})
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 a tenant that is not one UUID written in full is not trusted")
  void aTenantThatIsNotOneUuid(String tenant) {
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> Tokens.user(token().claim(Tokens.TENANT, tenant).build()))
        .isInstanceOf(InvalidBearerTokenException.class);
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 a tenant written in capitals is the same UUID")
  void aTenantInCapitals() {
    String capitals = TENANT.toString().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    assertThat(Tokens.user(token().claim(Tokens.TENANT, capitals).build()).getPrincipal())
        .isEqualTo(new CurrentUser("subject", TENANT));
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 a tenant sent as a list of one, as a multivalued mapper of Keycloak sends it, is that tenant")
  void aTenantInAListOfOne() {
    assertThat(
            Tokens.user(token().claim(Tokens.TENANT, List.of(TENANT.toString())).build())
                .getPrincipal())
        .isEqualTo(new CurrentUser("subject", TENANT));
    for (List<?> notOne : List.of(List.of(), List.of(42))) {
      assertThatThrownBy(() -> Tokens.user(token().claim(Tokens.TENANT, notOne).build()))
          .as(notOne.toString())
          .isInstanceOf(InvalidBearerTokenException.class);
    }
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 a token without a tenant, or with two, is not trusted")
  void aTokenWithoutATenantOrWithTwo() {
    assertThatThrownBy(
            () -> Tokens.user(token().claims(claims -> claims.remove(Tokens.TENANT)).build()))
        .isInstanceOf(InvalidBearerTokenException.class);
    List<String> two = List.of(TENANT.toString(), UUID.randomUUID().toString());
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> Tokens.user(token().claim(Tokens.TENANT, two).build()))
        .isInstanceOf(InvalidBearerTokenException.class);
  }

  @Test
  void aTokenWithoutASubjectIsNotTrusted() {
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> Tokens.user(token().subject(" ").build()))
        .isInstanceOf(InvalidBearerTokenException.class);
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> Tokens.user(token().claims(claims -> claims.remove("sub")).build()))
        .isInstanceOf(InvalidBearerTokenException.class);
  }

  @Test
  void theDecoderReadsTheKeysOfTheIssuerAndHoldsTheTokenToTheRulesOfTheCore() {
    JwtDecoder decoder = Tokens.decoder(TestIssuer.ISSUER, Clock.systemUTC());
    String token = TestIssuer.token("subject", TENANT.toString());
    assertThat(decoder.decode(token).getSubject()).isEqualTo("subject");
    String elsewhere =
        TestIssuer.token(TestIssuer.claims("subject", TENANT.toString()).audience("other"));
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> decoder.decode(elsewhere)).isInstanceOf(BadJwtException.class);
  }

  @Test
  void aDecoderWhoseIssuerIsAwayRejectsTheToken() {
    JwtDecoder decoder = Tokens.decoder("http://127.0.0.1:9/issuer", CLOCK);
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> decoder.decode(TestIssuer.token("subject", TENANT.toString())))
        .isInstanceOf(BadJwtException.class)
        .hasCauseInstanceOf(JwtDecoderInitializationException.class);
  }

  @Test
  void keysThatCannotBeReadRejectTheTokenSoTheAnswerIs401AndNot500() {
    JwtDecoder unreachable =
        Tokens.unauthenticatedOnFailure(
            token -> {
              throw new JwtDecoderInitializationException("no issuer", new IllegalStateException());
            });
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> unreachable.decode("token"))
        .isInstanceOf(BadJwtException.class)
        .hasCauseInstanceOf(JwtDecoderInitializationException.class);
    JwtDecoder noKeys =
        Tokens.unauthenticatedOnFailure(
            token -> {
              throw new JwtException("no keys");
            });
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> noKeys.decode("token"))
        .isInstanceOf(BadJwtException.class)
        .hasCauseInstanceOf(JwtException.class);
  }

  @Test
  void aBadTokenStaysBadAndAGoodOneIsDecoded() {
    BadJwtException bad = new BadJwtException("bad");
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> decodedBy(bad).decode("token")).isSameAs(bad);
    Jwt good = token().build();
    assertThat(Tokens.unauthenticatedOnFailure(token -> good).decode("token")).isSameAs(good);
  }

  private static JwtDecoder decodedBy(@Nullable RuntimeException failure) {
    return Tokens.unauthenticatedOnFailure(
        token -> {
          throw java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(failure);
        });
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.security.internal;

import static java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.jwt;

import dev.metis.core.WebLayerTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.MockMvcTester;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.MvcTestResult;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@WebLayerTest(SecurityTest.Open.class)
@Import(SecurityTest.Open.class)
class SecurityTest {

  private final MockMvcTester mvc;

  SecurityTest(@Autowired MockMvcTester mvc) {
    this.mvc = mvc;
  }

  /** An endpoint of the test behind the security of the core. */
  @RestController
  static class Open {

    @GetMapping("/test/open")
    String open() {
      return "open";
    }

    @PostMapping("/test/open")
    String write() {
      return "written";
    }
  }

  @Test
  void aRequestWithoutATokenIs401AsProblemDetailsAndAsksForABearerToken() throws Exception {
    MvcTestResult answer = mvc.get().uri("/test/open").exchange();
    assertThat(answer)
        .hasStatus(401)
        .hasContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON)
        .hasHeader(HttpHeaders.CACHE_CONTROL, "no-store");
    assertThat(answer.getResponse().getHeader(HttpHeaders.WWW_AUTHENTICATE)).startsWith("Bearer");
    assertThat(
            JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser()
                .parseMap(answer.getResponse().getContentAsString(UTF_8)))
        .containsEntry("kind", "unauthenticated");
  }

  @Test
  void aTokenWhoseKeysCannotBeReadIs401AndNot500() {
    MvcTestResult answer =
        mvc.get().uri("/test/open").header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer a.b.c").exchange();
    assertThat(answer).hasStatus(401).hasContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON);
  }

  @Test
  void aWriteNeedsNoCsrfTokenAndAnAnswerSetsNoCookieAndNoSession() {
    MvcTestResult answer = mvc.post().uri("/test/open").with(jwt()).exchange();
    assertThat(answer).hasStatus(200);
    assertThat(answer.getResponse().getHeader(HttpHeaders.SET_COOKIE)).isNull();
    assertThat(answer.getRequest().getSession(false)).isNull();
  }

  @Test
  void theMetadataOfTheResourceNamesTheIssuerAndClaimsNoBindingToACertificate() throws Exception {
    MvcTestResult answer = mvc.get().uri("/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource").exchange();
    assertThat(answer).hasStatusOk();
    assertThat(
            JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser()
                .parseMap(answer.getResponse().getContentAsString(UTF_8)))
        .containsEntry("authorization_servers", java.util.List.of("http://127.0.0.1:9/issuer"))
        .containsEntry("tls_client_certificate_bound_access_tokens", false);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.security.internal;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import dev.metis.core.TestIssuer;
import dev.metis.core.WebLayerTest;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.MockMvcTester;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.MvcTestResult;

// A date of the core in the past, as a demo has, and an issuer whose keys can be read.
@WebLayerTest(SecurityTest.Open.class)
@Import(SecurityTest.Open.class)
@ActiveProfiles("test")
class TokenTimeTest {

  private static final String TENANT = UUID.randomUUID().toString();

  private final MockMvcTester mvc;

  TokenTimeTest(@Autowired MockMvcTester mvc) {
    this.mvc = mvc;
  }

  @DynamicPropertySource
  static void issuerAndDate(DynamicPropertyRegistry registry) {
    registry.add("metis.security.issuer", () -> TestIssuer.ISSUER);
    registry.add("metis.time.fixed", TestIssuer.NOW::toString);
  }

  private MvcTestResult open(String token) {
    return mvc.get()
        .uri("/test/open")
        .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + token)
        .exchange();
  }

  @Test
  void aTokenFollowsTheTimeOfTheMachineWhateverTheDateOfTheCore() {
    assertThat(open(TestIssuer.token("subject", TENANT))).hasStatus(200);
    Instant hourAgo = Instant.now().minusSeconds(3600);
    String expired =
        TestIssuer.token(
            TestIssuer.claims("subject", TENANT)
                .issueTime(Date.from(hourAgo))
                .expirationTime(Date.from(hourAgo.plusSeconds(300))));
    assertThat(open(expired)).hasStatus(401);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.time.internal;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import dev.metis.core.TestIssuer;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.mock.env.MockEnvironment;

class ClockConfigurationTest {

  private static final Instant FIXED = TestIssuer.NOW;

  private static MockEnvironment profiles(String... active) {
    MockEnvironment environment = new MockEnvironment();
    environment.setActiveProfiles(active);
    return environment;
  }

  private static void followsTheTimeInUtc(Clock clock) {
    assertThat(Duration.between(clock.instant(), Instant.now()).abs())
        .isLessThan(Duration.ofMinutes(1));
    assertThat(clock.getZone()).isEqualTo(ZoneOffset.UTC);
  }

  @Test
  void aFixedInstantGivesAClockStoppedThereInUtcUnderTheDemoOrTheTestProfile() {
    for (String profile : new String[] {"demo", "test"}) {
      Clock clock = new ClockConfiguration().clock(new TimeSettings(FIXED), profiles(profile));
      assertThat(clock.instant()).as(profile).isEqualTo(FIXED);
      assertThat(clock.getZone()).as(profile).isEqualTo(ZoneOffset.UTC);
    }
  }

  @Test
  void aFixedInstantUnderAnyOtherProfileStopsTheStart() {
    assertThatThrownBy(
            () -> new ClockConfiguration().clock(new TimeSettings(FIXED), profiles("staging")))
        .isInstanceOf(IllegalStateException.class)
        .hasMessage("metis.time.fixed needs the profile demo or test");
  }

  @Test
  void withoutAFixedInstantTheClockFollowsTheTimeInUtcUnderAnyProfile() {
    followsTheTimeInUtc(new ClockConfiguration().clock(new TimeSettings(null), profiles()));
  }

  @Test
  void theTimeOfTheMachineFollowsTheTimeInUtc() {
    followsTheTimeInUtc(ClockConfiguration.machine());
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.logging.internal;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import dev.metis.core.platform.security.CurrentUser;
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.slf4j.MDC;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.CapturedOutput;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.OutputCaptureExtension;
import org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletRequest;
import org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletResponse;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.TestingAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerMapping;

@ExtendWith(OutputCaptureExtension.class)
class TenantLogFilterTest {

  private static final UUID TENANT = UUID.fromString("0b0e5a4e-7c5a-4f43-9d7e-1f2a3b4c5d6e");

  private final List<@Nullable String> seen = new ArrayList<>();

  // A value an earlier test left on the thread would stand in for the one the filter must set.
  @BeforeEach
  void startWithoutAContext() {
    MDC.clear();
  }

  @AfterEach
  void forgetTheUser() {
    SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
  }

  private void serve(MockHttpServletRequest request) throws Exception {
    MockHttpServletResponse response = new MockHttpServletResponse();
    FilterChain chain =
        (servletRequest, servletResponse) -> {
          seen.add(MDC.get(TenantLogFilter.LOG_KEY));
          servletRequest.setAttribute(
              HandlerMapping.BEST_MATCHING_PATTERN_ATTRIBUTE, "/workspaces/{workspaceId}/shell");
          response.setStatus(403);
        };
    new TenantLogFilter().doFilter(request, response, chain);
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 the lines of a request carry the tenant of its user, and the next request starts without it")
  void theTenantOfTheUser(CapturedOutput output) throws Exception {
    SecurityContextHolder.getContext()
        .setAuthentication(
            new TestingAuthenticationToken(new CurrentUser("subject", TENANT), null));
    serve(new MockHttpServletRequest("GET", "/workspaces/creative-studio/shell"));
    assertThat(seen).containsExactly(TENANT.toString());
    assertThat(MDC.get(TenantLogFilter.LOG_KEY)).isNull();
    assertThat(output.getOut())
        .contains("served GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/shell with 403")
        .doesNotContain("creative-studio");
  }

  @Test
  void aRequestWithoutAUserIsServedWithoutATenant() throws Exception {
    SecurityContextHolder.getContext()
        .setAuthentication(new TestingAuthenticationToken("someone", null));
    serve(new MockHttpServletRequest("GET", "/actuator/health/liveness"));
    SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
    serve(new MockHttpServletRequest("GET", "/actuator/health/liveness"));
    assertThat(seen).containsExactly(null, null);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.as;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import org.assertj.core.api.InstanceOfAssertFactories;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplicationRunListener;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.CapturedOutput;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.OutputCaptureExtension;
import org.springframework.context.ConfigurableApplicationContext;

@ExtendWith(OutputCaptureExtension.class)
class CoreApplicationTest {

  @Test
  void mainStartsTheCoreAndEveryLineItPrintsIsAJsonObject(CapturedOutput output) {
    List<ConfigurableApplicationContext> ready = new ArrayList<>();
    SpringApplication.withHook(
        application ->
            new SpringApplicationRunListener() {
              @Override
              public void ready(ConfigurableApplicationContext context, @Nullable Duration taken) {
                ready.add(context);
              }
            },
        () ->
            CoreApplication.main(
                new String[] {
                  "--server.port=0",
                  "--server.address=127.0.0.1",
                  "--metis.security.issuer=" + TestIssuer.ISSUER
                }));
    try (ConfigurableApplicationContext context = ready.getFirst()) {
      assertThat(context.isRunning()).isTrue();
    }
    assertThat(output.getOut().lines())
        .isNotEmpty()
        .allSatisfy(
            line ->
                assertThat(JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser().parseMap(line))
                    .containsKeys("@timestamp", "message")
                    .extractingByKey("service", as(InstanceOfAssertFactories.MAP))
                    .containsEntry("name", "metis-core"));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.assertj.core.api.InstanceOfAssertFactories;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.boot.resttestclient.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureRestTestClient;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client.RestTestClient;

// On the loopback address alone, where no other program on this machine can hold the same port.
@SpringBootTest(
    webEnvironment = WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT,
    properties = "server.address=127.0.0.1")
@AutoConfigureRestTestClient
class ProbesTest {

  // A token of the issuer of the tests; the probes alone need none.
  private static final String TOKEN =
      "Bearer " + TestIssuer.token("probe", "0b0e5a4e-7c5a-4f43-9d7e-1f2a3b4c5d6e");

  private final RestTestClient client;

  ProbesTest(@Autowired RestTestClient client) {
    this.client = client;
  }

  @DynamicPropertySource
  static void issuer(DynamicPropertyRegistry registry) {
    registry.add("metis.security.issuer", () -> TestIssuer.ISSUER);
  }

  @ParameterizedTest
  @ValueSource(strings = {"liveness", "readiness"})
  void aProbeAnswersWithoutATokenOnThePortOfTheApiWithoutDetail(String probe) {
    client
        .get()
        .uri("/actuator/health/" + probe)
        .exchange()
        .expectStatus()
        .isOk()
        .expectBody(String.class)
        .isEqualTo("{\"status\":\"UP\"}");
  }

  @ParameterizedTest
  @ValueSource(strings = {"/actuator", "/actuator/health", "/actuator/env"})
  void everyOtherPathOfTheActuatorNeedsAToken(String path) {
    client.get().uri(path).exchange().expectStatus().isUnauthorized();
  }

  @Test
  void theDiscoveryPageNamesTheHealthEndpointAndNothingElse() {
    String page =
        client
            .get()
            .uri("/actuator")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, TOKEN)
            .exchange()
            .expectStatus()
            .isOk()
            .expectBody(String.class)
            .returnResult()
            .getResponseBody();
    assertThat(JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser().parseMap(String.valueOf(page)))
        .extractingByKey("_links", InstanceOfAssertFactories.MAP)
        .containsOnlyKeys("self", "health", "health-path");
  }

  @Test
  void aRequestIsServedOnAVirtualThread() {
    client
        .get()
        .uri(TestEndpoints.THREAD)
        .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, TOKEN)
        .exchange()
        .expectBody(String.class)
        .isEqualTo("true");
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.awaitility.Awaitility.await;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.CapturedOutput;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.OutputCaptureExtension;
import org.springframework.context.ConfigurableApplicationContext;

@ExtendWith(OutputCaptureExtension.class)
class ShutdownTest {

  @Test
  void aRequestInFlightFinishesWhenTheCoreStops(CapturedOutput output) throws Exception {
    ConfigurableApplicationContext context =
        SpringApplication.run(
            CoreApplication.class,
            "--server.port=0",
            "--server.address=127.0.0.1",
            "--metis.security.issuer=" + TestIssuer.ISSUER);
    TestEndpoints endpoints = context.getBean(TestEndpoints.class);
    int port = context.getEnvironment().getRequiredProperty("local.server.port", Integer.class);
    HttpRequest hold =
        HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create("http://localhost:" + port + TestEndpoints.HOLD))
            .header(
                "Authorization",
                "Bearer " + TestIssuer.token("shutdown", "0b0e5a4e-7c5a-4f43-9d7e-1f2a3b4c5d6e"))
            .build();
    try (HttpClient http = HttpClient.newHttpClient()) {
      CompletableFuture<HttpResponse<String>> answer =
          http.sendAsync(hold, BodyHandlers.ofString());
      // A request answered before it reaches the endpoint would otherwise leave this wait for ever.
      assertThat(endpoints.entered.await(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
          .as(() -> "the request reached the endpoint; its answer so far: " + answer.getNow(null))
          .isTrue();
      Thread stopping = Thread.ofPlatform().start(context::close);
      await()
          .atMost(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
          .until(() -> output.getOut().contains("Commencing graceful shutdown"));
      endpoints.release.countDown();
      assertThat(answer.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS).body()).isEqualTo(TestEndpoints.HELD);
      assertThat(stopping.join(Duration.ofSeconds(40))).isTrue();
    } finally {
      // A failed step still frees the held request and stops the core, for the tests after it.
      endpoints.release.countDown();
      context.close();
    }
    assertThat(output.getOut()).contains("Graceful shutdown complete");
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static com.tngtech.archunit.base.DescribedPredicate.not;
import static com.tngtech.archunit.core.domain.JavaCall.Predicates.target;
import static com.tngtech.archunit.core.domain.properties.HasName.Predicates.nameMatching;
import static com.tngtech.archunit.core.domain.properties.HasOwner.Predicates.With.owner;
import static com.tngtech.archunit.core.domain.properties.HasParameterTypes.Predicates.rawParameterTypes;
import static com.tngtech.archunit.lang.syntax.ArchRuleDefinition.noClasses;

import com.tngtech.archunit.base.DescribedPredicate;
import com.tngtech.archunit.core.domain.JavaClass;
import com.tngtech.archunit.core.importer.ImportOption;
import com.tngtech.archunit.junit.AnalyzeClasses;
import com.tngtech.archunit.junit.ArchTag;
import com.tngtech.archunit.junit.ArchTest;
import com.tngtech.archunit.lang.ArchRule;
import com.tngtech.archunit.library.GeneralCodingRules;
import dev.metis.testsupport.ArchitectureRules;
import java.time.Clock;

@ArchTag("architecture")
@AnalyzeClasses(packages = "dev.metis.core", importOptions = ImportOption.DoNotIncludeTests.class)
class ArchitectureTest {

  // The calls of java.time and of System that read the time or the zone of the machine.
  private static final DescribedPredicate<JavaClass> TIME =
      DescribedPredicate.describe(
          "java.time or java.lang.System",
          type -> type.getPackageName().equals("java.time") || type.isEquivalentTo(System.class));

  @ArchTest
  static final ArchRule constructorInjectionOnly =
      GeneralCodingRules.NO_CLASSES_SHOULD_USE_FIELD_INJECTION;

  @ArchTest
  static final ArchRule logsGoThroughTheLogger =
      GeneralCodingRules.NO_CLASSES_SHOULD_ACCESS_STANDARD_STREAMS;

  // The clock bean is the only time the core reads, so a profile and a test can fix the date.
  @ArchTest
  static final ArchRule noSystemClock =
      noClasses()
          .that()
          .resideOutsideOfPackage("dev.metis.core.platform.time.internal")
          .should()
          .callMethodWhere(
              target(owner(TIME))
                  .and(target(nameMatching("now|currentTimeMillis|system.*")))
                  .and(not(target(rawParameterTypes(Clock.class)))))
          .as("no classes should read the system clock or the system time zone");

  @ArchTest static final ArchRule nullMarked = ArchitectureRules.NULL_MARKED;

  @ArchTest static final ArchRule noLegacyDates = ArchitectureRules.LEGACY_DATES;
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.mutation;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import dev.metis.tools.Facts;
import dev.metis.tools.Processes;
import dev.metis.tools.TestContext;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class MutationsTest {

  private static final String SCOPE = "build/mutation/scope.properties";
  private static final String TOOLS = "tools/build/reports/pitest/mutations.xml";
  private static final String CORE = "core/build/reports/pitest/mutations.xml";
  private static final String CORE_RAN = "core/build/reports/pitest/ran";
  private static final String TOOLS_RAN = "tools/build/reports/pitest/ran";

  @TempDir Path root;

  private TestContext run(String command, String... args) throws IOException {
    TestContext test =
        new TestContext(root)
            .run(
                (dir, git) ->
                    switch (git.getLast()) {
                      case "origin/gone...HEAD" -> new Processes.Result(128, "fatal: bad revision");
                      case "origin/wide...HEAD" ->
                          new Processes.Result(
                              0, "tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/BTest.java\0");
                      default ->
                          new Processes.Result(
                              0, "tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/ATest.java\0");
                    });
    test.exit =
        command.equals("scope")
            ? Mutations.scope(test.context(), List.of(args))
            : Mutations.judge(test.context(), List.of(args));
    return test;
  }

  private void write(String path, String text) throws IOException {
    Files.createDirectories(root.resolve(path).getParent());
    Files.writeString(root.resolve(path), text);
  }

  private static String mutation(boolean detected, String status, String method, int line) {
    return """
        <mutation detected='%s' status='%s' numberOfTestsRun='1'><sourceFile>A.java</sourceFile>\
        <mutatedClass>dev.metis.tools.A</mutatedClass><mutatedMethod>%s</mutatedMethod>\
        <methodDescription>()I</methodDescription><lineNumber>%d</lineNumber>\
        <mutator>org.pitest.Math</mutator><description>replaced addition</description></mutation>
        """
        .formatted(detected, status, method, line);
  }

  @Test
  void theScopeIsWrittenForTheMutationTasksAndAReportOfAnEarlierRunIsRemoved() throws IOException {
    write(TOOLS, "<mutations/>");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    TestContext full = run("scope", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(full.exit).isZero();
    assertThat(full.printed()).isEqualTo("mutation: full\n");
    assertThat(root.resolve(SCOPE))
        .hasContent("label=full\ncore=dev.metis.core.*\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*");
    assertThat(root.resolve(TOOLS)).doesNotExist();
    assertThat(root.resolve(TOOLS_RAN)).doesNotExist();
    run("scope", "--given", "dev.metis.tools.A*", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(root.resolve(SCOPE))
        .hasContent("label=given dev.metis.tools.A*\ncore=\ntools=dev.metis.tools.A*");
    write("tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/A.java", "class A {}\n");
    run("scope", "--base", "origin/main", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(root.resolve(SCOPE))
        .hasContent(
            "label=partial since origin/main: 1 classes\ncore=\ntools=dev.metis.tools.A,dev.metis.tools.A$*");
    run("scope", "--base", "origin/wide", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(root.resolve(SCOPE))
        .hasContent(
            "label=partial since origin/wide: 0 classes, and every class of tools\ncore=\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*");
  }

  @Test
  void aBaseGitCannotDiffAgainstOrNoProjectStopsTheScope() throws IOException {
    TestContext gone = run("scope", "--base", "origin/gone", "core");
    assertThat(gone.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(gone.printed())
        .isEqualTo("mutation: cannot list the changes since origin/gone: fatal: bad revision\n");
    assertThat(run("scope", "--given", "x").exit).isEqualTo(2);
    TestContext none = run("scope");
    assertThat(none.exit).isEqualTo(2);
    assertThat(none.printed())
        .isEqualTo("usage: mutation-scope [--given <globs> | --base <ref>] <project> ...\n");
  }

  @Test
  void everyMutantDetectedIsGreenAndTheFactsNameTheScopeAndEachProject() throws IOException {
    write(SCOPE, "label=full\ncore=dev.metis.core.*\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*\n");
    // The task of PIT leaves its trace, and no mutations.xml, for classes that hold no mutant.
    write(CORE_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(
        TOOLS,
        "<mutations>\n"
            + mutation(true, "KILLED", "a", 3)
            + mutation(true, "TIMED_OUT", "b", 4)
            + "</mutations>\n");
    write(CORE, "<mutations>\n" + mutation(true, "KILLED", "c", 5) + "</mutations>\n");
    TestContext test = run("judge", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(test.exit).isZero();
    String facts = "full: 3 mutants, 3 killed (core 1, tools 2)";
    assertThat(test.printed()).isEqualTo("mutation: " + facts + "\n");
    assertThat(Facts.read(root, "mutation")).hasValue(facts);
  }

  @Test
  void aMutantThatSurvivedOrThatNoTestRanIsRedAndNamedWhereItLives() throws IOException {
    write(SCOPE, "label=given dev.metis.tools.A*\ncore=\ntools=dev.metis.tools.A*\n");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(
        TOOLS,
        "<mutations>\n"
            + mutation(false, "SURVIVED", "a", 3)
            + mutation(false, "NO_COVERAGE", "b", 9)
            + mutation(true, "KILLED", "c", 12)
            + "</mutations>\n");
    TestContext test = run("judge", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed().lines())
        .containsExactly(
            "mutation: SURVIVED dev.metis.tools.A.a line 3: replaced addition",
            "mutation: NO_COVERAGE dev.metis.tools.A.b line 9: replaced addition",
            "mutation: given dev.metis.tools.A*: 3 mutants, 1 killed (tools 3)");
  }

  @Test
  void aProjectOfTheScopeThatPitLeftNoReportForIsRedRatherThanCountedAsNoMutant()
      throws IOException {
    write(SCOPE, "label=full\ncore=dev.metis.core.*\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*\n");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(TOOLS, "<mutations>\n" + mutation(true, "KILLED", "a", 3) + "</mutations>\n");
    TestContext test = run("judge", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed().lines())
        .containsExactly(
            "mutation: core: PIT did not run for the classes of the scope",
            "mutation: full: 1 mutants, 1 killed (core none, tools 1)");
  }

  @Test
  void aFullRunWithoutAMutantProvesNothingButAPartialOneThatTouchedNoClassIsGreen()
      throws IOException {
    write(SCOPE, "label=full\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*\n");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    TestContext empty = run("judge", "tools");
    assertThat(empty.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(empty.printed())
        .isEqualTo(
            "mutation: full: 0 mutants, 0 killed (tools 0): no mutant in tools, so nothing was"
                + " proven\n");
    write(SCOPE, "label=partial since origin/main: 0 classes\ntools=\n");
    TestContext partial = run("judge", "tools");
    assertThat(partial.exit).isZero();
    assertThat(partial.printed())
        .isEqualTo("mutation: partial since origin/main: 0 classes: 0 mutants, 0 killed\n");
    // A changed class that holds no mutant, such as one of constants alone.
    write(SCOPE, "label=partial since origin/main: 1 classes\ntools=dev.metis.tools.Names\n");
    TestContext constants = run("judge", "tools");
    assertThat(constants.exit).isZero();
    assertThat(constants.printed())
        .isEqualTo(
            "mutation: partial since origin/main: 1 classes: 0 mutants, 0 killed (tools 0)\n");
  }

  @Test
  void aFullRunWhereOneProjectHasNoMutantIsRedForThatProject() throws IOException {
    write(SCOPE, "label=full\ncore=dev.metis.core.*\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*\n");
    write(CORE_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(TOOLS, "<mutations>\n" + mutation(true, "KILLED", "a", 3) + "</mutations>\n");
    TestContext test = run("judge", "core", "tools");
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed())
        .isEqualTo(
            "mutation: full: 1 mutants, 1 killed (core 0, tools 1): no mutant in core, so nothing"
                + " was proven\n");
  }

  @Test
  void aMissingScopeIsRedAndAMalformedReportIsRed() throws IOException {
    TestContext noScope = run("judge", "tools");
    assertThat(noScope.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(noScope.printed())
        .isEqualTo("mutation: no scope in " + SCOPE + ": run the mutation scope first\n");
    write(SCOPE, "label=full\ntools=dev.metis.tools.*\n");
    write(TOOLS_RAN, "PIT ran\n");
    write(TOOLS, "<mutations");
    TestContext broken = run("judge", "tools");
    assertThat(broken.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(broken.printed()).startsWith("mutation: mutations.xml is no XML: ");
    TestContext usage = run("judge");
    assertThat(usage.exit).isEqualTo(2);
    assertThat(usage.printed()).isEqualTo("usage: mutation <project> ...\n");
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;

/**
 * Writes every error answer: Problem Details with the kind and the correlation id, nothing else.
 */
@Component
public class Problems {

  /** The request attribute that holds the id of the request, which an error body carries. */
  static final String REQUEST_ID = "dev.metis.core.requestId";

  private final JsonMapper json;

  Problems(JsonMapper json) {
    this.json = json;
  }

  /** The kind the app reads beside the status. */
  static String kindOf(int status) {
    return switch (status) {
      case 401 -> "unauthenticated";
      case 403 -> "forbidden";
      case 404 -> "notFound";
      case 503 -> "unavailable";
      default -> status >= 500 ? "server" : "validation";
    };
  }

  /** The body of an error answer with the status. */
  static Problem body(int status, String correlationId) {
    HttpStatus known = HttpStatus.resolve(status);
    String title = known == null ? "Error" : known.getReasonPhrase();
    return new Problem("about:blank", title, status, kindOf(status), correlationId);
  }

  /** The answer the web layer returns for the status. */
  ResponseEntity<Problem> answer(int status, HttpServletRequest request) {
    return ResponseEntity.status(status)
        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON)
        .body(body(status, idOf(request)));
  }

  /** Writes the answer for the status where no controller runs, as a filter does. */
  public void write(int status, HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
      throws IOException {
    response.setStatus(status);
    response.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON_VALUE);
    json.writeValue(response.getOutputStream(), body(status, idOf(request)));
  }

  private static String idOf(HttpServletRequest request) {
    return String.valueOf(request.getAttribute(REQUEST_ID));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
import java.util.Set;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatusCode;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.ServletWebRequest;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.WebRequest;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.ResponseEntityExceptionHandler;

/** Turns every exception that leaves a controller, Spring's own included, into Problem Details. */
@RestControllerAdvice
class ProblemAdvice extends ResponseEntityExceptionHandler {

  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ProblemAdvice.class);

  private final Problems problems;

  ProblemAdvice(Problems problems) {
    this.problems = problems;
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
  ResponseEntity<Problem> defect(Exception failure, HttpServletRequest request) {
    LOG.error("a request failed: {}", trace(failure));
    return problems.answer(500, request);
  }

  // The type and the frames of each cause and never a message, which may hold a value of a record.
  static String trace(Throwable failure) {
    StringBuilder trace = new StringBuilder();
    Set<Throwable> seen = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
    for (Throwable cause = failure; cause != null && seen.add(cause); cause = cause.getCause()) {
      trace.append(trace.isEmpty() ? "" : "caused by ").append(cause.getClass().getName());
      for (StackTraceElement frame : cause.getStackTrace()) {
        trace.append("\n\tat ").append(frame);
      }
      trace.append('\n');
    }
    return trace.toString();
  }

  // Every exception of Spring MVC ends here, with the body it chose, which is replaced.
  @Override
  protected ResponseEntity<Object> createResponseEntity(
      @Nullable Object body, HttpHeaders headers, HttpStatusCode status, WebRequest request) {
    ResponseEntity<Problem> answer =
        problems.answer(status.value(), ((ServletWebRequest) request).getRequest());
    return ResponseEntity.status(status)
        .headers(headers)
        .headers(answer.getHeaders())
        .<Object>body(answer.getBody());
  }
}
```
