`core/src/main/java/dev/metis/core/platform/web/internal/RequestFilter.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.slf4j.MDC;
import org.springframework.core.Ordered;
import org.springframework.core.annotation.Order;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;

/** First on every request: its id, for the logs and the error body, and no cache in front. */
@Component
@Order(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE)
class RequestFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {

  /** The key of the request id in the context of the log lines. */
  static final String LOG_KEY = "requestId";

  @Override
  protected void doFilterInternal(
      HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, FilterChain chain)
      throws ServletException, IOException {
    String id = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
    request.setAttribute(Problems.REQUEST_ID, id);
    // An answer belongs to one person, and Cloudflare in front of the core must not keep it.
    response.setHeader(HttpHeaders.CACHE_CONTROL, "no-store");
    MDC.put(LOG_KEY, id);
    try {
      chain.doFilter(request, response);
    } finally {
      MDC.remove(LOG_KEY);
    }
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import org.springframework.boot.webmvc.error.ErrorController;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

/** The page the server sends an error to that no controller answered, as Problem Details too. */
@RestController
class ErrorEndpoint implements ErrorController {

  private final Problems problems;

  ErrorEndpoint(Problems problems) {
    this.problems = problems;
  }

  // An error keeps the status the server set; a request for this page itself finds nothing.
  @RequestMapping("/error")
  ResponseEntity<Problem> error(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) {
    int status = response.getStatus();
    return problems.answer(status < 400 ? 404 : status, request);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import org.apache.tomcat.util.buf.EncodedSolidusHandling;
import org.springframework.boot.tomcat.servlet.TomcatServletWebServerFactory;
import org.springframework.boot.web.server.WebServerFactoryCustomizer;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * Tomcat hands an encoded slash on, so the firewall refuses it and the answer is Problem Details.
 */
@Component
class EncodedSlash implements WebServerFactoryCustomizer<TomcatServletWebServerFactory> {

  @Override
  public void customize(TomcatServletWebServerFactory factory) {
    factory.addConnectorCustomizers(
        connector ->
            connector.setEncodedSolidusHandling(EncodedSolidusHandling.PASS_THROUGH.getValue()));
  }
}
```

```java
/** Where the tokens come from; an environment names it, so a start without it stops at once. */

record SecuritySettings(URI issuer) {

  SecuritySettings(@Nullable URI issuer) {
    this.issuer =
        Objects.requireNonNull(
            issuer, "metis.security.issuer is not set: give METIS_SECURITY_ISSUER");
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.security.internal;

import dev.metis.core.platform.security.CurrentUser;
import java.util.List;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AbstractAuthenticationToken;

/** A checked token, as the person it names, which a controller receives as CurrentUser. */
final class UserToken extends AbstractAuthenticationToken {

  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;

  private final CurrentUser user;

  UserToken(CurrentUser user) {
    super(List.of());
    this.user = user;
    setAuthenticated(true);
  }

  @Override
  public CurrentUser getPrincipal() {
    return user;
  }

  // Spring names the person by the subject alone, not by every value of the user.
  @Override
  public String getName() {
    return user.subject();
  }

  // The token was checked and is not kept.
  @Override
  public @Nullable Object getCredentials() {
    return null;
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.security.internal;

import dev.metis.core.platform.security.CurrentUser;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.core.DelegatingOAuth2TokenValidator;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.core.OAuth2TokenValidator;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.BadJwtException;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtAudienceValidator;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtDecoder;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtDecoderInitializationException;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtException;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtIssuerValidator;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtTimestampValidator;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.NimbusJwtDecoder;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.SupplierJwtDecoder;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.InvalidBearerTokenException;

/** The rules a token must pass before the core trusts the person it names. */
final class Tokens {

  /** The audience every token of the core carries. */
  static final String AUDIENCE = "metis-core";

  /** The claim that holds the one tenant of the person. */
  static final String TENANT = "tenant_id";

  private Tokens() {}

  /** Issuer, audience and time, the time read from the clock of the core. */
  static OAuth2TokenValidator<Jwt> validator(String issuer, Clock clock) {
    JwtTimestampValidator time = new JwtTimestampValidator();
    time.setClock(clock);
    // A token without an expiry would stay valid for ever.
    time.setAllowEmptyExpiryClaim(false);
    return new DelegatingOAuth2TokenValidator<>(
        time, new JwtIssuerValidator(issuer), new JwtAudienceValidator(AUDIENCE));
  }

  /** The person of a checked token; a token without a subject or one tenant is not trusted. */
  static UserToken user(Jwt jwt) {
    String subject = jwt.getSubject();
    Object tenant = single(jwt.getClaims().get(TENANT));
    if (subject == null || subject.isBlank() || !(tenant instanceof String text) || !uuid(text)) {
      throw new InvalidBearerTokenException("the token names no subject or no single tenant");
    }
    return new UserToken(new CurrentUser(subject, UUID.fromString(text)));
  }

  // A multivalued mapper sends every tenant as a list, so a list of one is that one tenant.
  private static @Nullable Object single(@Nullable Object tenant) {
    return tenant instanceof List<?> values && values.size() == 1 ? values.getFirst() : tenant;
  }

  // UUID.fromString accepts short groups, so the text must read back the same, in either case.
  private static boolean uuid(String text) {
    try {
      return UUID.fromString(text).toString().equalsIgnoreCase(text);
    } catch (IllegalArgumentException notOne) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /** The decoder of the tokens of the issuer, which reads its keys at the first token it sees. */
  static JwtDecoder decoder(String issuer, Clock clock) {
    return unauthenticatedOnFailure(
        new SupplierJwtDecoder(
            () -> {
              NimbusJwtDecoder decoder = NimbusJwtDecoder.withIssuerLocation(issuer).build();
              decoder.setJwtValidator(validator(issuer, clock));
              return decoder;
            }));
  }

  /** A decoder whose keys cannot be read rejects the token, so the answer is 401 and not 500. */
  static JwtDecoder unauthenticatedOnFailure(JwtDecoder decoder) {
    return token -> {
      try {
        return decoder.decode(token);
      } catch (BadJwtException bad) {
        throw bad;
      } catch (JwtException | JwtDecoderInitializationException unreadable) {
        throw new BadJwtException("the keys of the issuer cannot be read", unreadable);
      }
    };
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.security.internal;

import dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal.Problems;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import org.springframework.security.core.AuthenticationException;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.web.BearerTokenAuthenticationEntryPoint;
import org.springframework.security.web.AuthenticationEntryPoint;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/** The 401 of a missing or failed token: the header a client reads, then Problem Details. */
@Component
class ProblemEntryPoint implements AuthenticationEntryPoint {

  private final AuthenticationEntryPoint bearer = new BearerTokenAuthenticationEntryPoint();
  private final Problems problems;

  ProblemEntryPoint(Problems problems) {
    this.problems = problems;
  }

  @Override
  public void commence(
      HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, AuthenticationException failure)
      throws IOException, ServletException {
    bearer.commence(request, response, failure);
    problems.write(401, request, response);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.security.internal;

import dev.metis.core.platform.time.internal.ClockConfiguration;
import jakarta.servlet.DispatcherType;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnWebApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.EnableConfigurationProperties;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtDecoder;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;

/** Bearer tokens only: no session, no cookie, no CSRF token, and every path behind a token. */
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
@ConditionalOnWebApplication
@EnableConfigurationProperties(SecuritySettings.class)
class SecurityConfiguration {

  @Bean
  SecurityFilterChain api(
      HttpSecurity http, ProblemEntryPoint unauthenticated, SecuritySettings settings) {
    http.authorizeHttpRequests(
            requests ->
                requests
                    .requestMatchers("/actuator/health/liveness", "/actuator/health/readiness")
                    .permitAll()
                    // The error page writes the status an earlier step chose.
                    .dispatcherTypeMatchers(DispatcherType.ERROR)
                    .permitAll()
                    .anyRequest()
                    .authenticated())
        .sessionManagement(
            session -> session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
        .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
        // The request filter sets no-store on every answer.
        .headers(headers -> headers.cacheControl(cache -> cache.disable()))
        .oauth2ResourceServer(
            server ->
                server
                    .jwt(jwt -> jwt.jwtAuthenticationConverter(Tokens::user))
                    // Spring Security serves this metadata to anyone, so it says only what holds.
                    .protectedResourceMetadata(
                        metadata ->
                            metadata.protectedResourceMetadataCustomizer(
                                about ->
                                    about
                                        .authorizationServer(settings.issuer().toString())
                                        .tlsClientCertificateBoundAccessTokens(false)))
                    .authenticationEntryPoint(unauthenticated))
        .exceptionHandling(exceptions -> exceptions.authenticationEntryPoint(unauthenticated));
    return http.build();
  }

  // The keys come with the first request, so the core starts without the issuer; time is real time.
  @Bean
  JwtDecoder decoder(SecuritySettings settings) {
    return Tokens.decoder(settings.issuer().toString(), ClockConfiguration.machine());
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.time.internal;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.EnableConfigurationProperties;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;

/** The clocks of the core: the business date, which the demo and the tests fix, and real time. */
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
@EnableConfigurationProperties(TimeSettings.class)
public class ClockConfiguration {

  /** The time of the machine, which a token follows whatever the date of the core. */
  public static Clock machine() {
    return Clock.systemUTC();
  }

  // Only the demo and the tests may fix the date, so a fixed date anywhere else stops the start.
  @Bean
  Clock clock(TimeSettings settings, Environment environment) {
    Instant fixed = settings.fixed();
    if (fixed == null) {
      return machine();
    }
    if (!environment.matchesProfiles("demo | test")) {
      throw new IllegalStateException("metis.time.fixed needs the profile demo or test");
    }
    return Clock.fixed(fixed, ZoneOffset.UTC);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.logging.internal;

import dev.metis.core.platform.security.CurrentUser;
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.slf4j.MDC;
import org.springframework.boot.security.autoconfigure.web.servlet.SecurityFilterProperties;
import org.springframework.core.annotation.Order;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerMapping;

/** After the token is checked: the tenant on every log line of the request, and one line served. */
@Component
@Order(SecurityFilterProperties.DEFAULT_FILTER_ORDER + 1)
class TenantLogFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {

  /** The key of the tenant id in the context of the log lines. */
  static final String LOG_KEY = "tenantId";

  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TenantLogFilter.class);

  @Override
  protected void doFilterInternal(
      HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, FilterChain chain)
      throws ServletException, IOException {
    Authentication authentication = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
    if (authentication != null && authentication.getPrincipal() instanceof CurrentUser user) {
      MDC.put(LOG_KEY, user.tenant().toString());
    }
    try {
      chain.doFilter(request, response);
    } finally {
      // The pattern of the route and never the path, which holds the ids of records.
      Object route = request.getAttribute(HandlerMapping.BEST_MATCHING_PATTERN_ATTRIBUTE);
      LOG.info("served {} {} with {}", request.getMethod(), route, response.getStatus());
      MDC.remove(LOG_KEY);
    }
  }
}
```

`tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/mutation/Mutations.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.tools.mutation;

import dev.metis.tools.Context;
import dev.metis.tools.Facts;
import dev.metis.tools.Xml;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Properties;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import org.w3c.dom.Element;
import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;

/** The scope of a PIT run, written before it, and the judge that wants every mutant detected. */
public final class Mutations {

  private static final String SCOPE = "build/mutation/scope.properties";
  private static final String REPORTS = "/build/reports/pitest/";

  private Mutations() {}

  /** Writes the scope of the run: the classes given, the classes changed since a base, or all. */
  public static int scope(Context context, List<String> args) throws IOException {
    PrintStream out = context.out();
    boolean option = !args.isEmpty() && args.getFirst().startsWith("--");
    List<String> projects = args.subList(Math.min(args.size(), option ? 2 : 0), args.size());
    if (projects.isEmpty()) {
      out.println("usage: mutation-scope [--given <globs> | --base <ref>] <project> ...");
      return 2;
    }
    Path root = context.root();
    Scope scope;
    if (!option) {
      scope = Scope.full(projects);
    } else if (args.getFirst().equals("--given")) {
      scope = Scope.given(args.get(1), projects);
    } else {
      try {
        List<String> changed = context.git().changedSince(args.get(1));
        scope =
            Scope.since(
                args.get(1), changed, projects, path -> Files.isRegularFile(root.resolve(path)));
      } catch (IOException noDiff) {
        out.println("mutation: " + noDiff.getMessage());
        return 1;
      }
    }
    StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder("label=" + scope.label() + "\n");
    for (String project : projects) {
      text.append(project)
          .append('=')
          .append(String.join(",", scope.globs().get(project)))
          .append('\n');
      // A report an earlier run left behind must not speak for this run.
      Files.deleteIfExists(root.resolve(project + REPORTS + "mutations.xml"));
      Files.deleteIfExists(root.resolve(project + REPORTS + "ran"));
    }
    Files.createDirectories(root.resolve(SCOPE).getParent());
    Files.writeString(root.resolve(SCOPE), text);
    out.println("mutation: " + scope.label());
    return 0;
  }

  /** Judges the report PIT left in each project of the scope on its own, and leaves the facts. */
  public static int judge(Context context, List<String> args) throws IOException {
    PrintStream out = context.out();
    if (args.isEmpty()) {
      out.println("usage: mutation <project> ...");
      return 2;
    }
    Path root = context.root();
    if (!Files.exists(root.resolve(SCOPE))) {
      out.println("mutation: no scope in " + SCOPE + ": run the mutation scope first");
      return 1;
    }
    Properties scope = new Properties();
    try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(root.resolve(SCOPE))) {
      scope.load(reader);
    }
    List<Report> reports = new ArrayList<>();
    for (String project : args) {
      if (!scope.getProperty(project, "").isEmpty()) {
        try {
          reports.add(reportOf(root, project));
        } catch (IOException malformed) {
          out.println("mutation: " + malformed.getMessage());
          return 1;
        }
      }
    }
    return verdict(root, out, scope.getProperty("label", ""), reports);
  }

  /** The mutants of one project of the scope, or that PIT left it no report. */
  private record Report(String project, int mutants, List<String> live, boolean missing) {}

  // PIT writes mutations.xml only for classes that hold a mutant, and its task leaves a trace.
  private static Report reportOf(Path root, String project) throws IOException {
    Path folder = root.resolve(project + REPORTS);
    if (!Files.exists(folder.resolve("ran"))) {
      return new Report(project, 0, List.of(), true);
    }
    Path xml = folder.resolve("mutations.xml");
    if (!Files.exists(xml)) {
      return new Report(project, 0, List.of(), false);
    }
    NodeList found = Xml.read(xml).getElementsByTagName("mutation");
    return new Report(project, found.getLength(), liveIn(found), false);
  }

  private static int verdict(Path root, PrintStream out, String label, List<Report> reports)
      throws IOException {
    int mutants = reports.stream().mapToInt(Report::mutants).sum();
    List<String> live = reports.stream().flatMap(report -> report.live().stream()).toList();
    List<String> missing =
        reports.stream()
            .filter(Report::missing)
            .map(
                report ->
                    "mutation: "
                        + report.project()
                        + ": PIT did not run for the classes of the scope")
            .toList();
    String each =
        reports.stream()
            .map(report -> report.project() + " " + (report.missing() ? "none" : report.mutants()))
            .collect(Collectors.joining(", "));
    // A project with code and no mutant in a full run means the wiring broke for it.
    List<String> empty =
        label.startsWith("partial")
            ? List.of()
            : reports.stream()
                .filter(report -> !report.missing() && report.mutants() == 0)
                .map(Report::project)
                .toList();
    String facts =
        "%s: %d mutants, %d killed%s%s"
            .formatted(
                label,
                mutants,
                mutants - live.size(),
                each.isEmpty() ? "" : " (" + each + ")",
                empty.isEmpty()
                    ? ""
                    : ": no mutant in " + String.join(" and ", empty) + ", so nothing was proven");
    missing.forEach(out::println);
    live.forEach(out::println);
    out.println("mutation: " + facts);
    Facts.write(root, "mutation", facts);
    return live.isEmpty() && missing.isEmpty() && empty.isEmpty() ? 0 : 1;
  }

  private static List<String> liveIn(NodeList mutations) {
    List<String> live = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int at = 0; at < mutations.getLength(); at++) {
      Element mutation = (Element) mutations.item(at);
      if (!mutation.getAttribute("detected").equals("true")) {
        live.add(
            "mutation: %s %s.%s line %s: %s"
                .formatted(
                    mutation.getAttribute("status"),
                    text(mutation, "mutatedClass"),
                    text(mutation, "mutatedMethod"),
                    text(mutation, "lineNumber"),
                    text(mutation, "description")));
      }
    }
    return live;
  }

  private static String text(Element mutation, String tag) {
    return mutation.getElementsByTagName(tag).item(0).getTextContent();
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;

/** The counter-tests of the mutation check. */
final class MutationCanaries {

  // The core and one package of the tool, which keeps a run of a counter-test short.
  private static final String SMALL = "-Pmutate=dev.metis.core.*,dev.metis.tools.canary.*";

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          // A test of the core that asserts nothing of the result, so PIT is seen to reach the
          // core.
          Canary.of("mutation-weak-test", "mutation", "SURVIVED dev.metis.core.CanaryWeak")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryWeak.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  final class CanaryWeak {
                    private CanaryWeak() {}

                    static int twice(int number) {
                      return number * 2;
                    }
                  }
                  """)
              .writing(
                  "core/src/test/java/dev/metis/core/CanaryWeakTest.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

                  import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

                  class CanaryWeakTest {
                    @Test
                    void runs() {
                      assertThat(CanaryWeak.twice(2)).isInstanceOf(Integer.class);
                    }
                  }
                  """)
              .arguments(SMALL),
          // A project of the scope whose PIT never ran, which must not count as one without
          // mutants.
          Canary.of("mutation-no-report", "mutation", "core: PIT did not run")
              .appending("core/build.gradle.kts", "\ntasks.named(\"pitest\") { enabled = false }\n")
              .arguments(SMALL));

  private MutationCanaries() {}
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

/** The counter-tests of the lint check. */
final class LintCanaries {

  // Built from pieces, so that this file holds no mark of its own.
  private static final String SUPPRESS = "@Suppress" + "Warnings(\"unused\")";

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          // Ten branches over the one path of a method pass the ceiling of 10.
          Canary.of("lint-complexity", "lint", "[CyclomaticComplexity]")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryComplex.java",
                  classOf(
                      "CanaryComplex",
                      "  static int grade(int n) {\n"
                          + IntStream.range(0, 10)
                              .mapToObj(
                                  i ->
                                      "    if (n > %d) {\n      return %d;\n    }\n"
                                          .formatted(i, i))
                              .collect(Collectors.joining())
                          + "    return -1;\n  }\n")),
          // A file of 301 lines passes the ceiling of 300.
          Canary.of("lint-file-length", "lint", "[FileLength]")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryLong.java",
                  classOf(
                      "CanaryLong",
                      IntStream.range(0, 295)
                          .mapToObj(i -> "  static final int N%d = %d;\n".formatted(i, i))
                          .collect(Collectors.joining()))),
          Canary.of("lint-no-reason", "lint", "no-reason")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanarySuppressed.java",
                  classOf("CanarySuppressed", "  " + SUPPRESS + "\n  private int idle;\n")),
          // A mark with its reason still has to be counted in the debt file.
          Canary.of("lint-debt", "lint", "debt-grew")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryCounted.java",
                  classOf(
                      "CanaryCounted",
                      "  " + SUPPRESS + " // read by reflection\n  private int idle;\n")),
          // A mark on a parameter, which no line starts with.
          Canary.of("lint-parameter-suppression", "lint", "no-reason: static int twice(")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryParameter.java",
                  classOf(
                      "CanaryParameter",
                      "  static int twice("
                          + SUPPRESS
                          + " int number) {\n    return number * 2;\n  }\n")),
          // JaCoCo and PIT leave out a class so marked, so the mark is counted like the others.
          Canary.of("lint-generated", "lint", "debt-grew: 1 Generated")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryGenerated.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  @org.springframework.aot.generate.Generated
                  final class CanaryGenerated {
                    private CanaryGenerated() {}
                  }
                  """),
          // A mark in a package named like the record of ./verify, which only the root holds.
          Canary.of("lint-nested-reports", "lint", "reports/CanaryReports.java:6: no-reason")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "reports/CanaryReports.java",
                  classOf("CanaryReports", "  " + SUPPRESS + "\n  private int idle;\n")
                      .replace("package dev.metis.core;", "package dev.metis.core.reports;")),
          // A project whose every class the list leaves out, which would leave it unmeasured.
          Canary.of("lint-whole-project-excluded", "lint", "every class of extra is left out")
              .writing(
                  "extra/src/main/java/dev/metis/extra/Only.java",
                  "package dev.metis.extra;\n\nfinal class Only {}\n")
              .appending("config/coverage-exclusions.txt", "dev.metis.extra.Only: a canary\n"));

  private LintCanaries() {}

  // A class of the core with the body given, and a private constructor before it.
  private static String classOf(String name, String body) {
    return """
        package dev.metis.core;

        final class %s {
          private %s() {}

        %s}
        """
        .formatted(name, name, body);
  }
}
```

### Task 4: The database, the migration job and the stack that runs them

PostgreSQL 18.6 in the stack, its init script creating the two roles, and the first migration: the registry the shell reads (`tenant`, `person`, `workspace`, `workspace_member`, `portfolio`, `program`, and the registry part of `project`), each table with its tenant column and its default, row-level security enabled and forced, one policy, a foreign key that names the tenant, and the grant to read. The image runs as the migration job with the profile `migrate`, as the owner of the tables, and exits; the API validates the migrations at its start and refuses a database that is behind, while one ahead passes. Readiness follows the database, and an unreachable database answers 503. The integration tests start the stack's own image of PostgreSQL with its own init script, migrate it with the real migration job, and read the catalog and the roles; the three tests that start the whole core move to them. The role test reads the rights the role of the API holds however it holds them, granted to it, to PUBLIC or on one column, and its membership of no role; the catalog test requires every relation the API can read to be a table that forces row-level security. The tests start the core under the profile `test`, the one that may fix its date, with a driver that leaves read-only to the core. Every core a test starts listens on `127.0.0.1` alone, and every container of the tests publishes its ports there alone, since macOS gives the traffic of `127.0.0.1` to a program bound there before one bound to every address. The image check gives the stack its passwords for each run, starts the API alone on the empty database and requires it to refuse, then runs the migration job and the API, waiting for each a bounded time, and reads the environment of the API: its own role, and no password of the owner of the tables or of the superuser. Every process the tool runs ends at a deadline with every process it started, and a check past it is red as timed out.

```kotlin
plugins {
```

```kotlin
dependencyLocking {

spotless {
    java {
        target("core/src/**/*.java", "tools/src/**/*.java", "test-support/**/*.java")

        removeUnusedImports()
    }
    format("misc") {
        target(
            "**/*.kts", "**/*.md", "**/*.yml", "**/*.yaml", "**/*.toml", "**/*.properties",
            "**/*.json", "**/*.xml", "**/*.txt", "**/Dockerfile", "**/.gitignore", ".dockerignore",
            "verify", "canary",
        )

        trimTrailingWhitespace()
        endWithNewline()

// A scanner that is no Gradle plugin, run as its pinned image in the tree, which it reads only.
fun scanner(name: String, image: Provider<String>, options: List<String>, vararg arguments: String) =
    tasks.register<Exec>(name) {
        val tree = rootDir.absolutePath
        commandLine(
            listOf("docker", "run", "--rm", "--volume", "$tree:/work:ro", "--workdir", "/work") +
                options + listOf(image.get()) + arguments,
        )
    }

// Trivy keeps its database in a volume of its own, so a scan downloads it once a day at most.
val trivy = listOf("--volume", "metis-trivy-cache:/root/.cache")

scanner(
    "depsVulnerabilities", libs.versions.image.trivy, trivy,
    "fs", "--scanners", "vuln", "--exit-code", "1", "--quiet",
    "--skip-dirs", "/work/build", "--skip-dirs", "/work/**/build", "--skip-dirs", "/work/.gradle", "/work",
)

// A relative folder, so the paths the allow-list of .gitleaks.toml matches start at the root.
scanner(
    "secretsScan", libs.versions.image.gitleaks, listOf(),
    "dir", ".", "--no-banner", "--redact", "--verbose", "--config", ".gitleaks.toml",
)

// actionlint finds the workflows through .git, which the copy of a canary lacks, so each is named.
val workflows = file(".github/workflows").list().orEmpty().sorted().map { ".github/workflows/$it" }

scanner("workflowLint", libs.versions.image.actionlint, listOf(), "-color", *workflows.toTypedArray())

// The image the image check builds from the sources, with Docker alone, as any platform would.
tasks.register<Exec>("imageBuild") {
    commandLine("docker", "build", "--file", "core/Dockerfile", "--tag", "metis-core:check", ".")
}

tasks.register<Exec>("imageLint") {
    val dockerfile = file("core/Dockerfile")
    commandLine("docker", "run", "--rm", "--interactive", libs.versions.image.hadolint.get(), "hadolint", "-")
    doFirst {
        standardInput = dockerfile.inputStream()
    }
}

// Trivy reads the image from an archive in the tree, so it needs no hand on the Docker daemon.
tasks.register<Exec>("imageSave") {
    dependsOn("imageBuild")
    val archive = layout.buildDirectory.file("image/core.tar")
    doFirst {
        archive.get().asFile.parentFile.mkdirs()
    }
    commandLine("docker", "save", "--output", archive.get().asFile.path, "metis-core:check")
}

scanner(
    "imageScan", libs.versions.image.trivy, trivy,
    "image", "--input", "/work/build/image/core.tar", "--scanners", "vuln", "--exit-code", "1", "--quiet",
).configure { dependsOn("imageSave") }

// The checks of ./verify, which runs them in the order of the list of the tool, Checks.ORDER.

tasks.register("checkFormat") {
    description = "Every source file is formatted."
    dependsOn("spotlessCheck")
}

tasks.register("checkCompile") {

tasks.register("checkLint") {

tasks.register("checkLanguage") {

tasks.register("checkArchitecture") {

tasks.register("checkDeadcode") {

    )
}

tasks.register("checkTooling") {
    description = "The tests of the tool pass, every check has a counter-test, the workflow passes its linter."
    dependsOn(":tools:test", ":tools:judgeTooling", "workflowLint")
}

tasks.register("checkUnit") {
    description = "The tests of the core that need no container pass, none skipped, as many as the floor."
    dependsOn(":core:test", ":tools:judgeUnit")
}

tasks.register("checkIntegration") {
    description = "The tests on a real PostgreSQL and a real Keycloak pass, none skipped, as many as the floor."

}

tasks.register("checkCoverage") {
    description = "Every line and every branch of the core and the tool runs in a test."

// A check whose judge did not run would pass on the exit of its tasks alone, so a check that owes
// facts fails without them; ./verify and ./canary clear the facts before each run of a check.
val factFree = setOf("checkFormat", "checkCompile", "checkDeps", "checkSecrets")
tasks.matching { it.name.matches(Regex("check[A-Z]\\w*")) && it.name !in factFree }.configureEach {
    val check = name.removePrefix("check").replaceFirstChar(Char::lowercase)
    val facts = layout.buildDirectory.file("facts/$check.txt")
    doLast {
        if (!facts.get().asFile.exists()) {
            throw GradleException("$name: its judge left no facts in build/facts/$check.txt")
        }
    }
}

// A starter stands for the libraries of it that the code uses, named one by one, which the plugin
// would otherwise ask to declare; a library a bundle names is never reported unused, so

val starters =
    mapOf(
        "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc" to listOf(
            "org.apache.tomcat.embed:tomcat-embed-core",

            "org.springframework.security:spring-security-core",

            "org.springframework.security:spring-security-oauth2-resource-server",
            "org.springframework.security:spring-security-web",

        "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test" to listOf(

        "org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-security-test" to listOf(
            "org.springframework.security:spring-security-test",
        ),

configure<com.autonomousapps.DependencyAnalysisExtension> {
    structure {
        starters.forEach { (starter, libraries) ->
            bundle(starter.substringAfter(':')) {
                primary(starter)
                libraries.forEach { includeDependency(it) }

        }
    }

val bundled = tasks.register("bundledDeclared") {
    description = "No project declares a library that a bundle names."
}

gradle.projectsEvaluated {
    val members = starters.values.flatten().toSet()
    val declared =
        subprojects.flatMap { project ->
            project.configurations.flatMap { configuration ->
                configuration.dependencies
                    .filter { "${it.group}:${it.name}" in members }
                    .map { "${it.group}:${it.name} in ${project.path} ${configuration.name}" }
```

A configuration in strict mode resolves only against its lock state, and an artifact only against its checksum, so a change of the dependencies writes both again, with every task run for real, since a task restored from the build cache resolves nothing.

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the roles and the stack**

`stack/postgres/roles.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Creates the owner of the tables and the role of the API; a migration grants, it never creates a role.
set -eu
psql --variable=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username "$POSTGRES_USER" --dbname "$POSTGRES_DB" \
    --set=migrator="$METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD" --set=app="$METIS_APP_PASSWORD" <<'SQL'
create role metis_migrator login password :'migrator';
create role metis_app login password :'app';
alter database :"DBNAME" owner to metis_migrator;
SQL
```

`stack/compose.yaml`:

```yaml
# The local stack runs the image as a deployment runs it: docker compose -f stack/compose.yaml up --build --wait
# Every password comes from the environment and from no file here; the README says how to give them.
name: metis

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18.6@sha256:74935e72241653ca55e0414067e6d8763aceb8a810eb51b452253ec3dcfc4336
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_DB: metis
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${METIS_POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?the password of the superuser of the database}
      METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD: ${METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD:?the password of the owner of the tables}
      METIS_APP_PASSWORD: ${METIS_APP_PASSWORD:?the password of the role of the API}
    volumes:
      - ./postgres/roles.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/roles.sh:ro
      - database:/var/lib/postgresql/18/docker
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "--username=postgres", "--dbname=metis"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 30
  core:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: core/Dockerfile
    image: ${METIS_IMAGE:-metis-core:local}
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${METIS_PORT-8080}:8080"
    environment:
      TZ: ${METIS_TIME_ZONE:-UTC}
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/metis
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: metis_app
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: ${METIS_APP_PASSWORD:?the password of the role of the API}
      METIS_SECURITY_ISSUER: http://keycloak:8080/realms/metis
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cpus: 1
    mem_limit: 2g
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "--fail", "--silent", "http://localhost:8080/actuator/health/readiness"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 30


  migrate:
    image: ${METIS_IMAGE:-metis-core:local}
    pull_policy: never
    environment:
      SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE: migrate
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/metis
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: metis_migrator
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: ${METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD:?the password of the owner of the tables}
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

volumes:
  database:
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.awaitility.Awaitility.await;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.DriverManagerDataSource;
import org.testcontainers.containers.GenericContainer;
import org.testcontainers.postgresql.PostgreSQLContainer;
import org.testcontainers.utility.DockerImageName;
import org.testcontainers.utility.MountableFile;
import org.yaml.snakeyaml.Yaml;

/** The services of the local stack for the tests, made from the files the stack itself runs. */
final class Stack {

  /** The password of the role of the API, made anew for each run. */
  static final String APP_PASSWORD = UUID.randomUUID().toString();

  /** The password of the owner of the tables, made anew for each run. */
  static final String MIGRATOR_PASSWORD = UUID.randomUUID().toString();

  private static final String ADMIN_PASSWORD = UUID.randomUUID().toString();

  /** The database most tests share, migrated by the migration job. */
  static final PostgreSQLContainer DATABASE = migrated(database());

  private Stack() {}

  /** A new database of the stack with its two roles, which nothing migrated yet. */
  static PostgreSQLContainer database() {
    PostgreSQLContainer database =
        new PostgreSQLContainer(
                DockerImageName.parse(image("postgres")).asCompatibleSubstituteFor("postgres"))
            .withDatabaseName("metis")
            .withUsername("postgres")
            .withPassword(ADMIN_PASSWORD)
            .withEnv("METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD", MIGRATOR_PASSWORD)
            .withEnv("METIS_APP_PASSWORD", APP_PASSWORD)
            .withCopyFileToContainer(
                MountableFile.forHostPath("stack/postgres/roles.sh", 0755),
                "/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/roles.sh");
    publishOnLoopback(database);
    database.start();
    // The module waits for a line of the log alone; a first connection proves the forwarded port.
    await()
        .atMost(Duration.ofMinutes(1))
        // In the calling thread, since the first database is made while this class initializes.
        .pollInSameThread()
        .ignoreExceptions()
        .until(() -> admin(database).sql("select 1").query(Integer.class).single() == 1);
    return database;
  }

  /** Publishes each port the container exposes on the loopback address alone. */
  static void publishOnLoopback(GenericContainer<?> container) {
    // On macOS a program on 127.0.0.1 takes the traffic of a port published on every address.
    container.setPortBindings(
        container.getExposedPorts().stream().map(port -> "127.0.0.1::" + port).toList());
  }

  /** Runs the migration job on the database, as the stack does before the API starts. */
  static PostgreSQLContainer migrated(PostgreSQLContainer database) {
    SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, migrationJob(database)).close();
    return database;
  }

  /** The arguments that start the core as the migration job of the database. */
  static String[] migrationJob(PostgreSQLContainer database) {
    return new String[] {
      "--spring.profiles.active=migrate",
      "--spring.datasource.url=" + database.getJdbcUrl(),
      "--spring.datasource.username=metis_migrator",
      "--spring.datasource.password=" + MIGRATOR_PASSWORD
    };
  }

  /** The arguments that start the core as the API on the database, with the issuer given. */
  static String[] api(PostgreSQLContainer database, String issuer) {
    // On the loopback address alone, where no other program on this machine can hold the same port.
    return new String[] {
      "--server.port=0",
      "--server.address=127.0.0.1",
      "--spring.profiles.active=test",
      "--spring.datasource.url=" + url(database),
      "--spring.datasource.username=metis_app",
      "--spring.datasource.password=" + APP_PASSWORD,
      "--metis.security.issuer=" + issuer,
      "--metis.time.fixed=" + TestIssuer.NOW
    };
  }

  /** The address of the database for the API, whose driver leaves read-only to the core. */
  static String url(PostgreSQLContainer database) {
    return database.getJdbcUrl() + "&readOnlyMode=ignore";
  }

  /** The superuser of the database, which no policy binds: it seeds rows and reads the catalog. */
  static JdbcClient admin(PostgreSQLContainer database) {
    return JdbcClient.create(
        new DriverManagerDataSource(database.getJdbcUrl(), "postgres", ADMIN_PASSWORD));
  }

  /** The image of a service of stack/compose.yaml, which pins it by its digest. */
  static String image(String service) {
    try (Reader compose = Files.newBufferedReader(Path.of("stack/compose.yaml"))) {
      Map<?, ?> services = (Map<?, ?>) new Yaml().<Map<?, ?>>load(compose).get("services");
      Map<?, ?> named = (Map<?, ?>) Objects.requireNonNull(services).get(service);
      return String.valueOf(Objects.requireNonNull(named, service).get("image"));
    } catch (IOException unreadable) {
      throw new UncheckedIOException(unreadable);
    }
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class StackTest {

  @Test
  @DisplayName("the database of the tests is published on the loopback address alone")
  void theDatabaseIsPublishedOnTheLoopbackAddressAlone() throws IOException, InterruptedException {
    Process port =
        new ProcessBuilder("docker", "port", Stack.DATABASE.getContainerId())
            .redirectErrorStream(true)
            .start();
    // The answer is a line per port, far less than the pipe holds, so it is read once docker ends.
    assertThat(port.waitFor(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)).isTrue();
    assertThat(new String(port.getInputStream().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8).lines())
        .isNotEmpty()
        .allMatch(line -> line.contains(" -> 127.0.0.1:"));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

/** The rows the tests read: two tenants with people, workspaces and a tree, written once. */
final class Seed {

  /** Every text of a record holds it, so that the log test can find a value of a record. */
  static final String MARK = "m4rk";

  /** A tenant of the seed. */
  record Tenant(UUID id, String name) {}

  /** A person of a tenant. */
  record Person(UUID id, Tenant tenant, String subject, String name, String initials) {}

  /** A workspace of a tenant, with the people who are its members. */
  record Workspace(
      UUID id, Tenant tenant, String key, String name, int position, List<Person> members) {}

  /** A level of the tree, by its parent and its position. */
  record Node(UUID id, UUID parent, String name, int position) {}

  /** A project of the tree, by its program and its position. */
  record Project(UUID program, String key, String name, int position) {}

  static final Tenant TENANT = new Tenant(uuid(1), "Tenant one " + MARK);
  static final Tenant OTHER_TENANT = new Tenant(uuid(2), "Tenant two " + MARK);

  /** A member of both workspaces of the tenant. */
  static final Person MEMBER =
      new Person(uuid(11), TENANT, "member-" + MARK, "Member " + MARK, "ME");

  /** A person of the tenant who is no member of ALPHA. */
  static final Person OUTSIDER =
      new Person(uuid(12), TENANT, "outsider-" + MARK, "Outsider " + MARK, "OU");

  /** A person of the other tenant. */
  static final Person RIVAL =
      new Person(uuid(13), OTHER_TENANT, "rival-" + MARK, "Rival " + MARK, "RI");

  /** Second in position order though it comes first here. */
  static final Workspace ALPHA =
      new Workspace(uuid(21), TENANT, "alpha-" + MARK, "Alpha " + MARK, 2, List.of(MEMBER));

  static final Workspace BETA =
      new Workspace(uuid(22), TENANT, "beta-" + MARK, "Beta " + MARK, 1, List.of(MEMBER, OUTSIDER));

  /**
   * A workspace of the other tenant under the key of ALPHA, on purpose: TEN-02 asks it of a test of
   * isolation.
   */
  static final Workspace RIVAL_ALPHA =
      new Workspace(uuid(23), OTHER_TENANT, ALPHA.key(), "Rival alpha " + MARK, 1, List.of(RIVAL));

  /** A workspace of the other tenant whose key no workspace of the tenant has. */
  static final Workspace DELTA =
      new Workspace(uuid(24), OTHER_TENANT, "delta-" + MARK, "Delta " + MARK, 2, List.of(RIVAL));

  /**
   * The tree of ALPHA, written empty level first: at each level the order of the positions is the
   * reverse of the order of the names, the ids and the writes, so only the positions can give it.
   */
  static final Node EMPTY_PORTFOLIO = new Node(uuid(31), ALPHA.id(), "Empty portfolio " + MARK, 1);

  static final Node PORTFOLIO = new Node(uuid(32), ALPHA.id(), "Portfolio " + MARK, 0);
  static final Node EMPTY_PROGRAM = new Node(uuid(41), PORTFOLIO.id(), "Empty program " + MARK, 1);
  static final Node PROGRAM = new Node(uuid(42), PORTFOLIO.id(), "Program " + MARK, 0);

  /** Second in position order though it comes first here. */
  static final Project LATER = new Project(PROGRAM.id(), "later-" + MARK, "Later " + MARK, 2);

  static final Project SOONER = new Project(PROGRAM.id(), "sooner-" + MARK, "Sooner " + MARK, 1);

  private static boolean written;

  /** The header of a request of the person, with a token of the test issuer. */
  static String bearer(Person person) {
    return "Bearer " + TestIssuer.token(person.subject(), person.tenant().id().toString());
  }

  private Seed() {}

  /** Writes the rows once into the shared database, as its superuser, whom no policy binds. */
  static synchronized void write() {
    if (written) {
      return;
    }
    JdbcClient admin = Stack.admin(Stack.DATABASE);
    for (Tenant tenant : List.of(TENANT, OTHER_TENANT)) {
      admin
          .sql("insert into tenant (tenant_id, name) values (:id, :name)")
          .param("id", tenant.id())
          .param("name", tenant.name())
          .update();
    }
    for (Person person : List.of(MEMBER, OUTSIDER, RIVAL)) {
      admin
          .sql(
              "insert into person (id, tenant_id, subject, name, initials)"
                  + " values (:id, :tenant, :subject, :name, :initials)")
          .param("id", person.id())
          .param("tenant", person.tenant().id())
          .param("subject", person.subject())
          .param("name", person.name())
          .param("initials", person.initials())
          .update();
    }
    for (Workspace workspace : List.of(ALPHA, BETA, RIVAL_ALPHA, DELTA)) {
      admin
          .sql(
              "insert into workspace (id, tenant_id, key, name, position)"
                  + " values (:id, :tenant, :key, :name, :position)")
          .param("id", workspace.id())
          .param("tenant", workspace.tenant().id())
          .param("key", workspace.key())
          .param("name", workspace.name())
          .param("position", workspace.position())
          .update();
      for (Person member : workspace.members()) {
        admin
            .sql(
                "insert into workspace_member (tenant_id, workspace_id, person_id)"
                    + " values (:tenant, :workspace, :person)")
            .param("tenant", workspace.tenant().id())
            .param("workspace", workspace.id())
            .param("person", member.id())
            .update();
      }
    }
    for (Node portfolio : List.of(EMPTY_PORTFOLIO, PORTFOLIO)) {
      admin
          .sql(
              "insert into portfolio (id, tenant_id, workspace_id, name, position)"
                  + " values (:id, :tenant, :parent, :name, :position)")
          .paramSource(node(portfolio))
          .update();
    }
    for (Node program : List.of(EMPTY_PROGRAM, PROGRAM)) {
      admin
          .sql(
              "insert into program (id, tenant_id, portfolio_id, name, position)"
                  + " values (:id, :tenant, :parent, :name, :position)")
          .paramSource(node(program))
          .update();
    }
    for (Project project : List.of(LATER, SOONER)) {
      admin
          .sql(
              "insert into project (tenant_id, program_id, key, name, position)"
                  + " values (:tenant, :program, :key, :name, :position)")
          .param("tenant", TENANT.id())
          .param("program", project.program())
          .param("key", project.key())
          .param("name", project.name())
          .param("position", project.position())
          .update();
    }
    written = true;
  }

  private static Map<String, Object> node(Node node) {
    return Map.of(
        "id",
        node.id(),
        "tenant",
        TENANT.id(),
        "parent",
        node.parent(),
        "name",
        node.name(),
        "position",
        node.position());
  }

  private static UUID uuid(int number) {
    return UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-7000-8000-%012d".formatted(number));
  }
}
```

```java
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration;

      registry.add("spring.datasource.username", () -> "metis_app");

      registry.add("metis.security.issuer", () -> TestIssuer.ISSUER);

    };
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;
import java.lang.annotation.Retention;
import java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy;
import java.lang.annotation.Target;
import org.springframework.boot.resttestclient.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureRestTestClient;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;
import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles;

/** A test of the whole core over HTTP, which every API test shares, so Spring starts it once. */
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
// On the loopback address alone, where no other program on this machine can hold the same port.
@SpringBootTest(
    webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT,
    properties = "server.address=127.0.0.1")
@AutoConfigureRestTestClient
@Import(Api.class)
// The date of the core is fixed, which the test profile alone allows.
@ActiveProfiles("test")
@interface ApiTest {}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

// The tests of how the core serves any request bring these, beside the endpoints of the core.
@RestController
class TestEndpoints {

  static final String THREAD = "/test/thread";
  static final String HOLD = "/test/hold";
  static final String FAIL = "/test/fail";
  static final String HELD = "held";

  final CountDownLatch entered = new CountDownLatch(1);
  final CountDownLatch release = new CountDownLatch(1);

  @GetMapping(THREAD)
  boolean servedOnAVirtualThread() {
    return Thread.currentThread().isVirtual();
  }

  // A defect whose message holds a value of a record, which no line of the log may repeat.
  @GetMapping(FAIL)
  String fail() {
    throw new IllegalStateException("failed on " + Seed.MARK);
  }

  @GetMapping(HOLD)
  String hold() throws InterruptedException {
    entered.countDown();
    release.await();
    return HELD;
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.as;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import org.assertj.core.api.InstanceOfAssertFactories;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplicationRunListener;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.CapturedOutput;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.OutputCaptureExtension;
import org.springframework.context.ConfigurableApplicationContext;

@ExtendWith(OutputCaptureExtension.class)
class CoreApplicationTest {

  @Test
  void mainStartsTheApiAndEveryLineItPrintsIsAJsonObject(CapturedOutput output) {
    // The shared database starts and is migrated first, so what follows is the API alone.
    String[] api = Stack.api(Stack.DATABASE, TestIssuer.ISSUER);
    int before = output.getOut().length();
    List<ConfigurableApplicationContext> ready = new ArrayList<>();
    SpringApplication.withHook(
        application ->
            new SpringApplicationRunListener() {
              @Override
              public void ready(ConfigurableApplicationContext context, @Nullable Duration taken) {
                ready.add(context);
              }
            },
        () -> CoreApplication.main(api));
    try (ConfigurableApplicationContext context = ready.getFirst()) {
      assertThat(context.isRunning()).isTrue();
    }
    assertThat(output.getOut().substring(before).lines())
        .isNotEmpty()
        .allSatisfy(
            line ->
                assertThat(JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser().parseMap(line))
                    .containsKeys("@timestamp", "message")
                    .extractingByKey("service", as(InstanceOfAssertFactories.MAP))
                    .containsEntry("name", "metis-core"));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.assertj.core.api.InstanceOfAssertFactories;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client.RestTestClient;

@ApiTest
class ProbesTest {

  private final RestTestClient client;

  ProbesTest(@Autowired RestTestClient client) {
    this.client = client;
  }

  @ParameterizedTest
  @ValueSource(strings = {"liveness", "readiness"})
  void aProbeAnswersWithoutATokenOnThePortOfTheApiWithoutDetail(String probe) {
    client
        .get()
        .uri("/actuator/health/" + probe)
        .exchange()
        .expectStatus()
        .isOk()
        .expectBody(String.class)
        .isEqualTo("{\"status\":\"UP\"}");
  }

  @ParameterizedTest
  @ValueSource(strings = {"/actuator", "/actuator/health", "/actuator/env"})
  void everyOtherPathOfTheActuatorNeedsAToken(String path) {
    client.get().uri(path).exchange().expectStatus().isUnauthorized();
  }

  @Test
  void theDiscoveryPageNamesTheHealthEndpointAndNothingElse() {
    String page =
        client
            .get()
            .uri("/actuator")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER))
            .exchange()
            .expectStatus()
            .isOk()
            .expectBody(String.class)
            .returnResult()
            .getResponseBody();
    assertThat(JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser().parseMap(String.valueOf(page)))
        .extractingByKey("_links", InstanceOfAssertFactories.MAP)
        .containsOnlyKeys("self", "health", "health-path");
  }

  @Test
  void aRequestIsServedOnAVirtualThread() {
    client
        .get()
        .uri(TestEndpoints.THREAD)
        .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER))
        .exchange()
        .expectBody(String.class)
        .isEqualTo("true");
  }
}
```

`core/src/integrationTest/java/dev/metis/core/ShutdownTest.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.awaitility.Awaitility.await;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.CapturedOutput;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.OutputCaptureExtension;
import org.springframework.context.ConfigurableApplicationContext;

@ExtendWith(OutputCaptureExtension.class)
class ShutdownTest {

  @Test
  void aRequestInFlightFinishesWhenTheCoreStops(CapturedOutput output) throws Exception {
    ConfigurableApplicationContext context =
        SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, Stack.api(Stack.DATABASE, TestIssuer.ISSUER));
    TestEndpoints endpoints = context.getBean(TestEndpoints.class);
    int port = context.getEnvironment().getRequiredProperty("local.server.port", Integer.class);
    HttpRequest hold =
        HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create("http://localhost:" + port + TestEndpoints.HOLD))
            .header("Authorization", Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER))
            .build();
    try (HttpClient http = HttpClient.newHttpClient()) {
      CompletableFuture<HttpResponse<String>> answer =
          http.sendAsync(hold, BodyHandlers.ofString());
      // A request answered before it reaches the endpoint would otherwise leave this wait for ever.
      assertThat(endpoints.entered.await(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
          .as(() -> "the request reached the endpoint; its answer so far: " + answer.getNow(null))
          .isTrue();
      Thread stopping = Thread.ofPlatform().start(context::close);
      await()
          .atMost(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
          .until(() -> output.getOut().contains("Commencing graceful shutdown"));
      endpoints.release.countDown();
      assertThat(answer.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS).body()).isEqualTo(TestEndpoints.HELD);
      assertThat(stopping.join(Duration.ofSeconds(40))).isTrue();
    } finally {
      // A failed step still frees the held request and stops the core, for the tests after it.
      endpoints.release.countDown();
      context.close();
    }
    assertThat(output.getOut()).contains("Graceful shutdown complete");
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

class RolesTest {

  private final JdbcClient admin = Stack.admin(Stack.DATABASE);

  private Map<String, Object> powersOf(String role) {
    return admin
        .sql(
            """
            select rolsuper, rolbypassrls, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolreplication
            from pg_roles where rolname = :role
            """)
        .param("role", role)
        .query()
        .singleRow();
  }

  private int owned(String role) {
    return admin
        .sql(
            """
            select (select count(*) from pg_class where relowner = role.oid)
                + (select count(*) from pg_namespace where nspowner = role.oid)
                + (select count(*) from pg_database where datdba = role.oid)
            from pg_roles role where rolname = :role
            """)
        .param("role", role)
        .query(Integer.class)
        .single();
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 the role of the API is no superuser, cannot bypass a policy, owns nothing and belongs to no role")
  void theRoleOfTheApi() {
    assertThat(powersOf("metis_app").values()).containsOnly(false);
    assertThat(owned("metis_app")).isZero();
    assertThat(
            admin
                .sql("select count(*) from pg_auth_members where member = 'metis_app'::regrole")
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single())
        .isZero();
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 the role of the API may read the tables of the registry and the history of the migrations, and nothing more")
  void theRightsOfTheApi() {
    // The rights the role holds, however it holds them: granted to it, to PUBLIC or to a role.
    List<String> rights =
        admin
            .sql(
                """
                select class.relname || ' ' || privilege from pg_class class
                cross join unnest(array['SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'TRUNCATE',
                    'REFERENCES', 'TRIGGER', 'MAINTAIN']) privilege
                where class.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
                    and class.relkind in ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'f')
                    and has_table_privilege('metis_app', class.oid, privilege)
                order by 1
                """)
            .query(String.class)
            .list();
    List<String> tables =
        admin
            .sql(
                """
                select tablename || ' SELECT' from pg_tables where schemaname = 'public'
                order by 1
                """)
            .query(String.class)
            .list();
    assertThat(rights).isEqualTo(tables).hasSize(8);
    assertThat(
            admin
                .sql(
                    """
                    select class.relname from pg_class class
                    where class.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
                        and class.relkind in ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'f')
                        and has_any_column_privilege(
                            'metis_app', class.oid, 'INSERT, UPDATE, REFERENCES')
                    """)
                .query(String.class)
                .list())
        .isEmpty();
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 the owner of the tables is no superuser and cannot bypass a policy either")
  void theOwnerOfTheTables() {
    assertThat(powersOf("metis_migrator").values()).containsOnly(false);
    assertThat(owned("metis_migrator")).isPositive();
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

class CatalogTest {

  // The expression PostgreSQL keeps for the tenant of the transaction, in a default or a policy.
  private static final String TENANT_OF_THE_TRANSACTION =
      "(NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid";

  private final JdbcClient admin = Stack.admin(Stack.DATABASE);

  private List<String> tables() {
    return admin
        .sql(
            """
            select tablename from pg_tables
            where schemaname = 'public' and tablename <> 'flyway_schema_history' order by 1
            """)
        .query(String.class)
        .list();
  }

  private List<String> found(String sql) {
    return admin.sql(sql).query(String.class).list();
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 every table holds the tenant of its row, filled from the tenant of the transaction")
  void theTenantColumn() {
    assertThat(
            admin
                .sql(
                    """
                    select table_name from information_schema.columns
                    where table_schema = 'public' and column_name = 'tenant_id'
                        and data_type = 'uuid' and is_nullable = 'NO' and column_default = :tenant
                    order by 1
                    """)
                .param("tenant", TENANT_OF_THE_TRANSACTION)
                .query(String.class)
                .list())
        .isEqualTo(tables())
        .hasSize(7);
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 every table forces row-level security, with one policy on the tenant of the transaction for every command")
  void theForcedPolicy() {
    assertThat(
            found(
                """
                select relname from pg_class
                where relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and relkind = 'r'
                    and relrowsecurity and relforcerowsecurity
                    and relname <> 'flyway_schema_history' order by 1
                """))
        .isEqualTo(tables());
    assertThat(
            found(
                """
                select tablename || ' ' || cmd || ' ' || qual || ' ' || coalesce(with_check, '-')
                from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' order by 1
                """))
        .isEqualTo(
            tables().stream()
                .map(table -> table + " ALL (tenant_id = " + TENANT_OF_THE_TRANSACTION + ") -")
                .toList());
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 every relation the API can read is a table that forces row-level security")
  void everyRelationTheApiCanRead() {
    // The history of the migrations holds no row of a tenant, and the API reads it to validate.
    assertThat(
            found(
                """
                select class.oid::regclass::text from pg_class class
                join pg_namespace namespace on namespace.oid = class.relnamespace
                where namespace.nspname not in ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
                    and class.relkind in ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'f', 'S')
                    and has_table_privilege('metis_app', class.oid, 'select')
                    and not (class.relkind = 'r'
                        and class.relrowsecurity and class.relforcerowsecurity)
                    and class.oid <> 'public.flyway_schema_history'::regclass
                order by 1
                """))
        .isEmpty();
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 every table has a key of one UUID")
  void theKey() {
    assertThat(
            found(
                """
                select class.relname from pg_index index
                join pg_class class on class.oid = index.indrelid
                join pg_attribute attribute
                    on attribute.attrelid = index.indrelid and attribute.attnum = index.indkey[0]
                where index.indisprimary and index.indnkeyatts = 1
                    and attribute.atttypid = 'uuid'::regtype
                    and class.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
                    and class.relname <> 'flyway_schema_history' order by 1
                """))
        .isEqualTo(tables());
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 every foreign key names the tenant and an index leads with its columns")
  void theForeignKeys() {
    assertThat(
            found(
                """
                select conrelid::regclass || ' ' || conname from pg_constraint key
                where contype = 'f' and connamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
                    and (not (select attnum from pg_attribute
                              where attrelid = key.conrelid and attname = 'tenant_id')
                              = any (key.conkey)
                        or not exists (
                            select from pg_index index where index.indrelid = key.conrelid
                                and (index.indkey::int2[])[0:cardinality(key.conkey) - 1]
                                    @> key.conkey
                                and key.conkey
                                    @> (index.indkey::int2[])[0:cardinality(key.conkey) - 1]))
                order by 1
                """))
        .isEmpty();
    assertThat(found("select conname from pg_constraint where contype = 'f'")).hasSize(11);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import org.flywaydb.core.Flyway;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.testcontainers.postgresql.PostgreSQLContainer;

class MigrationTest {

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 the migration job builds the schema from an empty database, and the API validates it")
  void fromAnEmptyDatabase() {
    try (PostgreSQLContainer empty = Stack.database()) {
      Stack.migrated(empty);
      Flyway.configure()
          .dataSource(empty.getJdbcUrl(), "metis_app", Stack.APP_PASSWORD)
          .load()
          .validate();
      assertThat(
              Stack.admin(empty)
                  .sql("select version || ' ' || success from flyway_schema_history order by 1")
                  .query(String.class)
                  .list())
          .containsExactly("1 true");
    }
  }

  @Test
  void theMigrationJobFailsOnAMigrationThatFails(@TempDir Path more) throws Exception {
    Files.writeString(more.resolve("V2__fails.sql"), "select * from no_such_table;\n");
    try (PostgreSQLContainer empty = Stack.database()) {
      assertThatThrownBy(
              () ->
                  SpringApplication.run(
                      CoreApplication.class, withLocation(Stack.migrationJob(empty), more)))
          .hasMessageContaining("no_such_table");
    }
  }

  /** The arguments given, with a second folder of migrations beside those of the core. */
  static String[] withLocation(String[] arguments, Path folder) {
    String[] more = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(arguments, arguments.length + 1);
    more[arguments.length] =
        "--spring.flyway.locations=classpath:db/migration,filesystem:" + folder;
    return more;
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Arrays;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.CapturedOutput;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.OutputCaptureExtension;
import org.springframework.context.ConfigurableApplicationContext;
import org.testcontainers.postgresql.PostgreSQLContainer;

@ExtendWith(OutputCaptureExtension.class)
class StartupTest {

  private static String[] without(String[] arguments, String setting) {
    return Arrays.stream(arguments)
        .filter(argument -> !argument.startsWith("--" + setting + "="))
        .toArray(String[]::new);
  }

  @Test
  void theApiRefusesADatabaseTheMigrationJobNeverMigrated() {
    try (PostgreSQLContainer empty = Stack.database()) {
      assertThatThrownBy(
              () ->
                  SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, Stack.api(empty, TestIssuer.ISSUER)))
          .hasStackTraceContaining("Detected resolved migration not applied to database");
    }
  }

  @Test
  void theApiStartsOnADatabaseAheadOfItsMigrations(@TempDir Path more) throws Exception {
    Files.writeString(more.resolve("V2__ahead.sql"), "comment on table tenant is 'ahead';\n");
    try (PostgreSQLContainer ahead = Stack.database()) {
      SpringApplication.run(
              CoreApplication.class, MigrationTest.withLocation(Stack.migrationJob(ahead), more))
          .close();
      try (ConfigurableApplicationContext api =
          SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, Stack.api(ahead, TestIssuer.ISSUER))) {
        assertThat(api.isRunning()).isTrue();
      }
    }
  }

  @Test
  void aStartWithoutTheDatabaseStopsWithAMessageThatNamesIt(CapturedOutput output) {
    String[] arguments =
        without(Stack.api(Stack.DATABASE, TestIssuer.ISSUER), "spring.datasource.url");
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, arguments));
    assertThat(output.getOut()).contains("'url' attribute is not specified");
  }

  @Test
  void aStartWithoutTheIssuerStopsWithAMessageThatNamesIt() {
    String[] arguments =
        without(Stack.api(Stack.DATABASE, TestIssuer.ISSUER), "metis.security.issuer");
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, arguments))
        .hasStackTraceContaining("metis.security.issuer is not set: give METIS_SECURITY_ISSUER");
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers;
import java.util.Arrays;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.context.ConfigurableApplicationContext;
import org.testcontainers.postgresql.PostgreSQLContainer;

class FailureTest {

  private static HttpResponse<String> get(
      ConfigurableApplicationContext api, String path, String bearer) throws Exception {
    int port = api.getEnvironment().getRequiredProperty("local.server.port", Integer.class);
    HttpRequest request =
        HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create("http://localhost:" + port + path))
            .header("Authorization", bearer)
            .build();
    try (HttpClient http = HttpClient.newHttpClient()) {
      return http.send(request, BodyHandlers.ofString());
    }
  }

  @Test
  void whenTheDatabaseIsGoneTheCoreIsNotReadyButAlive() throws Exception {
    Seed.write();
    try (PostgreSQLContainer own = Stack.migrated(Stack.database())) {
      String[] given = Stack.api(own, TestIssuer.ISSUER);
      String[] arguments = Arrays.copyOf(given, given.length + 1);
      // A request waits a second for a connection, so the test does not wait for half a minute.
      arguments[given.length] = "--spring.datasource.hikari.connection-timeout=1000";
      try (ConfigurableApplicationContext api =
          SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, arguments)) {
        String member = Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER);
        assertThat(get(api, "/actuator/health/readiness", member).statusCode()).isEqualTo(200);
        own.stop();
        assertThat(get(api, "/actuator/health/readiness", member).body())
            .isEqualTo("{\"status\":\"DOWN\"}");
        assertThat(get(api, "/actuator/health/liveness", member).body())
            .isEqualTo("{\"status\":\"UP\"}");
      }
    }
  }

  @Test
  void whenTheKeysOfTheIssuerCannotBeReadATokenIsAnswered401AndNever500() throws Exception {
    String gone = "http://127.0.0.1:9/realms/gone";
    // The token names the issuer the core trusts, so the keys alone stand in its way.
    String bearer =
        "Bearer "
            + TestIssuer.token(
                TestIssuer.claims(Seed.MEMBER.subject(), Seed.TENANT.id().toString()).issuer(gone));
    try (ConfigurableApplicationContext api =
        SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, Stack.api(Stack.DATABASE, gone))) {
      HttpResponse<String> read = get(api, "/actuator", bearer);
      assertThat(read.statusCode()).isEqualTo(401);
      assertThat(read.body()).contains("\"kind\":\"unauthenticated\"");
    }
  }
}
```
