```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import static java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.jwt;

import dev.metis.core.WebLayerTest;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;
import org.slf4j.MDC;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.CapturedOutput;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.OutputCaptureExtension;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;
import org.springframework.dao.DataAccessResourceFailureException;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.MockMvcTester;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.MvcTestResult;
import org.springframework.transaction.CannotCreateTransactionException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@WebLayerTest(ProblemAdviceTest.Failing.class)
@Import(ProblemAdviceTest.Failing.class)
@ExtendWith(OutputCaptureExtension.class)
class ProblemAdviceTest {

  private final MockMvcTester mvc;

  ProblemAdviceTest(@Autowired MockMvcTester mvc) {
    this.mvc = mvc;
  }

  /** Endpoints of the test, each failing in its own way. */
  @RestController
  static class Failing {

    @GetMapping("/test/no-transaction")
    String noTransaction() {
      throw new CannotCreateTransactionException("no connection");
    }

    @GetMapping("/test/database-gone")
    String databaseGone() {
      throw new DataAccessResourceFailureException("gone");
    }

    @GetMapping("/test/defect")
    String defect() throws SQLException {
      throw new SQLException(
          "select secret from inside", new IllegalStateException("inner secret"));
    }
  }

  @ParameterizedTest
  @CsvSource({
    "/test/no-transaction, 503",
    "/test/database-gone, 503",
    "/test/defect, 500",
    "/test/no-such-path, 404",
    "/error, 404"
  })
  void anErrorIsProblemDetailsWithItsKindAndTheIdOfTheRequestAndNothingInternal(
      String path, int status) throws Exception {
    MvcTestResult answer = mvc.get().uri(path).with(jwt()).exchange();
    assertThat(answer).hasStatus(status).hasContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON);
    Map<String, Object> body = bodyOf(answer);
    assertThat(body)
        .containsOnlyKeys("type", "title", "status", "kind", "correlationId")
        .containsEntry("status", status)
        .containsEntry("kind", Problems.kindOf(status));
    assertThat(String.valueOf(body.get("correlationId")))
        .matches("[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}");
    assertThat(answer.getResponse().getHeader(HttpHeaders.CACHE_CONTROL)).isEqualTo("no-store");
  }

  @Test
  void aMethodThePathDoesNotTakeIsAValidationError() throws Exception {
    MvcTestResult answer = mvc.post().uri("/test/defect").with(jwt()).exchange();
    assertThat(answer).hasStatus(405);
    assertThat(bodyOf(answer)).containsEntry("kind", "validation");
  }

  @Test
  void aDefectIsLoggedWithItsRequestByTheTypesAndFramesOfItsCausesAndNoMessage(
      CapturedOutput output) throws Exception {
    Object id = bodyOf(mvc.get().uri("/test/defect").with(jwt()).exchange()).get("correlationId");
    assertThat(output.getOut())
        .contains("a request failed: java.sql.SQLException")
        .contains("caused by java.lang.IllegalStateException")
        .contains("ProblemAdviceTest$Failing.defect")
        .contains("\"requestId\":\"" + id + "\"")
        .doesNotContain("select secret from inside")
        .doesNotContain("inner secret");
    assertThat(MDC.get(RequestFilter.LOG_KEY)).isNull();
  }

  @Test
  void aCauseThatLeadsBackIsWrittenOnce() {
    Exception first = new Exception("first");
    first.initCause(new Exception("second", first));
    assertThat(ProblemAdvice.trace(first).lines().filter(line -> !line.startsWith("\tat ")))
        .containsExactly("java.lang.Exception", "caused by java.lang.Exception");
  }

  @Test
  void aDatabaseThatCannotBeReachedIsLoggedByTheTypeOfItsFailureAlone(CapturedOutput output) {
    mvc.get().uri("/test/no-transaction").with(jwt()).exchange();
    assertThat(output.getOut())
        .contains(
            "the database cannot be reached: "
                + "org.springframework.transaction.CannotCreateTransactionException")
        .doesNotContain("no connection");
  }

  @Test
  void eachRequestHasAnIdOfItsOwn() throws Exception {
    Object first =
        bodyOf(mvc.get().uri("/test/no-such-path").with(jwt()).exchange()).get("correlationId");
    Object second =
        bodyOf(mvc.get().uri("/test/no-such-path").with(jwt()).exchange()).get("correlationId");
    assertThat(first).isNotEqualTo(second);
  }

  private static Map<String, Object> bodyOf(MvcTestResult answer) throws Exception {
    return JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser()
        .parseMap(answer.getResponse().getContentAsString(UTF_8));
  }
}
```

`core/src/test/java/dev/metis/core/SettingsTest.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.URL;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Properties;
import java.util.Set;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Tag;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.YamlPropertiesFactoryBean;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.core.io.Resource;
import org.springframework.core.io.support.PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver;
import org.springframework.core.io.support.PropertiesLoaderUtils;

// A setting nothing binds would sit in a settings file unseen, so the deadcode check runs this.
@Tag("deadcode")
class SettingsTest {

  @Test
  void everyKeyOfTheSettingsIsOneThatSpringBootOrTheCoreDefines() throws IOException {
    Set<String> known = new HashSet<>();
    Set<String> maps = new HashSet<>();
    ClassLoader loader = getClass().getClassLoader();
    for (URL file :
        Collections.list(loader.getResources("META-INF/spring-configuration-metadata.json"))) {
      try (InputStream in = file.openStream()) {
        String json = new String(in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        Object properties = JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser().parseMap(json).get("properties");
        for (Object property : properties instanceof List<?> list ? list : List.of()) {
          Map<?, ?> setting = (Map<?, ?>) property;
          String name = String.valueOf(setting.get("name"));
          known.add(name);
          String type = String.valueOf(setting.get("type"));
          // Spring Boot binds a map and a Properties alike, key by key.
          if (type.startsWith("java.util.Map") || type.equals("java.util.Properties")) {
            maps.add(name);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    Properties settings = new Properties();
    List<Resource> files = settingsFiles();
    assertThat(files).as("settings files").isNotEmpty();
    for (Resource file : files) {
      if (String.valueOf(file.getFilename()).endsWith(".properties")) {
        settings.putAll(PropertiesLoaderUtils.loadProperties(file));
      } else {
        YamlPropertiesFactoryBean yaml = new YamlPropertiesFactoryBean();
        yaml.setResources(file);
        settings.putAll(Objects.requireNonNull(yaml.getObject()));
      }
    }
    List<String> unknown =
        settings.keySet().stream()
            .map(key -> String.valueOf(key).replaceAll("\\[\\d+]", ""))
            .filter(key -> !known.contains(key))
            .filter(key -> maps.stream().noneMatch(map -> key.startsWith(map + ".")))
            .sorted()
            .toList();
    assertThat(unknown).as("settings that nothing binds").isEmpty();
  }

  // Every file of settings, a profile's own included, since Spring Boot reads them all.
  private static List<Resource> settingsFiles() throws IOException {
    PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver resolver = new PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver();
    List<Resource> files = new ArrayList<>();
    for (String kind : List.of("yml", "yaml", "properties")) {
      files.addAll(List.of(resolver.getResources("classpath*:application*." + kind)));
    }
    return files;
  }
}
```

`tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/image/FakeDocker.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.tools.image;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import dev.metis.tools.Processes;
import dev.metis.tools.TestContext;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

/** Docker for the tests of the image check: each command answers by what tells it apart. */
final class FakeDocker {

  static final String UP = "{\"status\":\"UP\"}";
  static final String LOCKED =
      "true|[\"ALL\"]|[\"no-new-privileges:true\"]|2147483648|1000000000|{\"/tmp\":\"\"}|30"
          + "|null|false|[]";
  static final String INSIDE =
      "10001\nCapEff:\t0000000000000000\nCapBnd:\t0000000000000000\noverlay / overlay ro,relatime 0 0\n";

  /** What Flyway says when the API starts on a database no migration job ran on. */
  static final String BEHIND = "Detected resolved migration not applied to database";

  /** Every command, as it was given. */
  final List<List<String>> calls = new ArrayList<>();

  /** What each command answers, by its key. */
  final Map<String, Processes.Result> answers =
      new HashMap<>(
          Map.ofEntries(
              Map.entry("image inspect", ok("182886790\n")),
              Map.entry("exec probe", ok(INSIDE)),
              Map.entry("compose down", ok("")),
              Map.entry("compose up", ok("")),
              Map.entry("compose up postgres", ok("")),
              Map.entry("compose up core", ok("")),
              Map.entry("compose stop", ok("")),
              Map.entry("compose logs", ok("core-1  | {\"message\":\"Started\"}\n")),
              Map.entry("compose logs core", ok("core-1  | " + BEHIND + ": 1.\n")),
              Map.entry("compose logs migrate", ok("migrate-1  | waiting for the database\n")),
              Map.entry("inspect lockdown", ok(LOCKED + "\n")),
              Map.entry("inspect state", ok("exited 1\n")),
              Map.entry(
                  "inspect env",
                  ok(
                      "[\"SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME=metis_app\",\"SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=x\"]\n")),
              Map.entry("stop --timeout", ok("metis-check-core-1\n")),
              Map.entry("exec readiness", ok(UP)),
              Map.entry("exec liveness", ok(UP)),
              Map.entry("stats --no-stream", ok("123.6MiB / 2GiB\n")),
              Map.entry("inspect exit", ok("143\n"))));

  /** The readiness of the API alone on a database no migration job ran on, asked first. */
  Processes.Result refused = new Processes.Result(1, "Error: container is not running");

  /** The name of a password the check makes, which the environment of the core then holds. */
  String leaked = "";

  static Processes.Result ok(String output) {
    return new Processes.Result(0, output);
  }

  /** A context whose processes this Docker answers, the first readiness with refused. */
  TestContext context(Path root, long step) {
    List<Boolean> first = new ArrayList<>(List.of(true));
    return new TestContext(root)
        .step(step)
        .run(
            (dir, command) -> {
              calls.add(command);
              String key = key(command);
              if (key.equals("exec readiness") && first.getFirst()) {
                first.set(0, false);
                return refused;
              }
              if (key.equals("inspect env") && !leaked.isEmpty()) {
                return ok("[\"SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME=metis_app\",\"X=" + made(leaked) + "\"]");
              }
              return answers.getOrDefault(key, new Processes.Result(99, "unexpected " + key));
            });
  }

  /** Runs the image check with this Docker, beside the realm of the stack. */
  TestContext check(Path root, long step, String... args) throws IOException {
    TestContext test = context(root, step);
    test.exit = ImageCheck.command(test.context(), List.of(args));
    return test;
  }

  // The value the check of this run gave the password, the last one its commands hold.
  private String made(String password) {
    return calls.stream()
        .flatMap(List::stream)
        .filter(word -> word.startsWith(password + "="))
        .reduce((earlier, later) -> later)
        .orElseThrow()
        .substring(password.length() + 1);
  }

  /** The commands, the passwords the check makes for each run left out. */
  List<List<String>> made() {
    return calls.stream()
        .map(
            command ->
                command.stream()
                    .map(word -> word.replaceFirst("^(METIS_\\w+_PASSWORD)=.*", "$1=*"))
                    .toList())
        .toList();
  }

  private static String key(List<String> command) {
    List<String> words =
        command.stream().dropWhile(word -> word.equals("env") || word.contains("=")).toList();
    assertThat(words.getFirst()).isEqualTo("docker");
    return switch (words.get(1)) {
      case "compose" ->
          "compose "
              + words.get(6)
              + (words.contains("--no-deps") || Set.of("core", "migrate").contains(words.getLast())
                  ? " " + words.getLast()
                  : "");
      case "exec" -> exec(words);
      case "inspect" -> inspect(words.get(3));
      default -> words.get(1) + " " + words.get(2);
    };
  }

  private static String inspect(String format) {
    if (format.contains("Env")) {
      return "inspect env";
    }
    return format.contains("Readonly")
        ? "inspect lockdown"
        : format.contains("Status") ? "inspect state" : "inspect exit";
  }

  private static String exec(List<String> words) {
    if (words.contains("psql")) {
      return "exec psql";
    }
    if (!words.contains("curl")) {
      return "exec probe";
    }
    String url = words.getLast();
    return url.endsWith("token")
        ? "exec token"
        : url.endsWith("shell")
            ? "exec shell"
            : url.endsWith("readiness") ? "exec readiness" : "exec liveness";
  }
}
```

`tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/image/ImageCheckTest.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.tools.image;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import dev.metis.tools.Facts;
import dev.metis.tools.Processes;
import dev.metis.tools.TestContext;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class ImageCheckTest {

  private static final String IMAGE = "metis-core:check";
  private static final String UP = FakeDocker.UP;
  private static final String LOCKED = FakeDocker.LOCKED;
  private static final String INSIDE = FakeDocker.INSIDE;
  private static final List<String> COMPOSE =
      List.of(
          "env",
          "METIS_IMAGE=" + IMAGE,
          "METIS_PORT=",
          "METIS_TIME_ZONE=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh",
          "METIS_POSTGRES_PASSWORD=*",
          "METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD=*",
          "METIS_APP_PASSWORD=*",
          "docker",
          "compose",
          "--project-name",
          "metis-check",
          "--file",
          "stack/compose.yaml");

  @TempDir Path root;

  private final FakeDocker docker = new FakeDocker();

  private TestContext check(String... args) throws IOException {
    return check(1_500_000_000L, args);
  }

  private TestContext check(long step, String... args) throws IOException {
    return docker.check(root, step, args);
  }

  private static List<String> compose(String... args) {
    List<String> command = new ArrayList<>(COMPOSE);
    command.addAll(List.of(args));
    return command;
  }

  @Test
  void anImageTheStackRunsLockedDownThatAnswersItsProbesAndStopsIsGreenWithItsMeasures()
      throws IOException {
    TestContext test = check(IMAGE);
    assertThat(test.exit).isZero();
    String facts = "image content 182.9 MB, ready in 1.5 s, memory 123.6MiB";
    assertThat(test.printed()).isEqualTo("image: " + facts + "\n");
    assertThat(Facts.read(root, "image")).hasValue(facts);
    assertThat(docker.made().get(1)).isEqualTo(compose("down", "--volumes"));
    assertThat(docker.made())
        .containsSubsequence(
            compose(
                "up",
                "--detach",
                "--no-build",
                "--no-deps",
                "--wait",
                "--wait-timeout",
                "120",
                "postgres"),
            compose("up", "--detach", "--no-build", "--no-deps", "core"),
            List.of("docker", "stop", "--timeout", "30", "metis-check-core-1"),
            List.of(
                "docker",
                "inspect",
                "--format",
                "{{.State.Status}} {{.State.ExitCode}}",
                "metis-check-core-1"),
            compose("logs", "--no-color", "core"),
            compose("up", "--detach", "--no-build", "--wait-timeout", "120"),
            List.of("docker", "inspect", "--format", "{{json .Config.Env}}", "metis-check-core-1"),
            compose("stop", "core"))
        .contains(
            List.of(
                "docker",
                "stats",
                "--no-stream",
                "--format",
                "{{.MemUsage}}",
                "metis-check-core-1"));
    assertThat(docker.made().getLast()).isEqualTo(compose("down", "--volumes"));
    assertThat(
            docker.calls.stream()
                .flatMap(List::stream)
                .filter(word -> word.startsWith("METIS_") && word.contains("_PASSWORD="))
                .map(word -> word.substring(word.indexOf('=') + 1))
                .distinct())
        .hasSize(3)
        .allSatisfy(password -> assertThat(password).hasSize(36));
  }

  @Test
  void aCoreThatRunsAsRootHoldsACapabilityHasAWritableRootOrABuildToolIsRed() throws IOException {
    docker.answers.put("exec probe", FakeDocker.ok(INSIDE.replaceFirst("10001", "0")));
    assertThat(check(IMAGE).printed()).startsWith("image: the core runs as root\n");
    docker.answers.put(
        "exec probe",
        FakeDocker.ok(INSIDE.replace("CapBnd:\t0000000000000000", "CapBnd:\t0000000000002000")));
    assertThat(check(IMAGE).printed())
        .startsWith(
            "image: the core runs with a capability: CapEff: 0000000000000000, CapBnd:"
                + " 0000000000002000\n");
    docker.answers.put(
        "exec probe",
        FakeDocker.ok(INSIDE.replace("CapEff:\t0000000000000000", "CapEff:\t0000000000000400")));
    assertThat(check(IMAGE).printed()).startsWith("image: the core runs with a capability: ");
    docker.answers.put(
        "exec probe", FakeDocker.ok(INSIDE.replace(" ro,relatime", " rw,relatime,lowerdir=/a:/b")));
    assertThat(check(IMAGE).printed())
        .startsWith("image: the root file system of the core is writable: rw\n");
    docker.answers.put("exec probe", FakeDocker.ok(INSIDE + "/usr/bin/javac\n/usr/bin/jar\n"));
    TestContext tools = check(IMAGE);
    assertThat(tools.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(tools.printed())
        .startsWith("image: the image holds a build tool: /usr/bin/javac /usr/bin/jar\n");
  }

  @Test
  void aProbeOfTheCoreThatFailsOrPrintsNoUserProvesNothingAndIsRed() throws IOException {
    for (Processes.Result probe :
        List.of(
            new Processes.Result(1, "sh: line 1: id: command not found\n"),
            new Processes.Result(1, INSIDE),
            FakeDocker.ok(INSIDE.substring(0, INSIDE.indexOf("overlay"))),
            FakeDocker.ok("x\n" + INSIDE.substring(INSIDE.indexOf('\n') + 1)),
            FakeDocker.ok("10001\nCapEff:\t0000000000000000\n"),
            FakeDocker.ok(INSIDE.replace("overlay / overlay ro,relatime 0 0", "none")))) {
      docker.answers.put("exec probe", probe);
      TestContext test = check(IMAGE);
      assertThat(test.exit).as(probe.output()).isEqualTo(1);
      assertThat(test.printed())
          .as(probe.output())
          .startsWith("image: cannot read the user and the capabilities of the core: ");
    }
  }

  @Test
  void aStackThatDoesNotRunTheCoreLockedDownIsRedWithWhatItRunsWith() throws IOException {
    String writable = LOCKED.replace("null|false", "[\"CAP_NET_RAW\"]|false");
    docker.answers.put("inspect lockdown", FakeDocker.ok(writable + "\n"));
    TestContext test = check(IMAGE);
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed())
        .startsWith("image: the stack does not run the core locked down: " + writable + "\n");
  }

  @Test
  void aContainerThatIsNeverReadyIsRedAndItsLastLinesOfLogShow() throws IOException {
    docker.answers.put(
        "exec readiness", new Processes.Result(1, "Error: container is not running"));
    docker.answers.put(
        "compose logs",
        FakeDocker.ok("core-1  | touch: cannot touch '/started': Read-only file system\n"));
    TestContext test = check(IMAGE);
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed())
        .isEqualTo(
            """
            image: the container was never ready
            image: core-1  | touch: cannot touch '/started': Read-only file system
            image: image content 182.9 MB, never ready
            """);
    assertThat(docker.made().getLast()).isEqualTo(compose("down", "--volumes"));
  }

  @Test
  void anApiThatServesADatabaseNoMigrationJobRanOnIsRed() throws IOException {
    docker.refused = FakeDocker.ok(UP);
    docker.answers.put("inspect state", FakeDocker.ok("running 0\n"));
    TestContext test = check(IMAGE);
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed())
        .startsWith(
            "image: the API did not refuse a database no migration job ran on: running 0\n"
                + "image: core-1  | "
                + FakeDocker.BEHIND
                + ": 1.\n");
    docker.refused = new Processes.Result(1, "Error: container is not running");
    docker.answers.put("inspect state", FakeDocker.ok("exited 0\n"));
    assertThat(check(IMAGE).printed())
        .startsWith("image: the API did not refuse a database no migration job ran on: exited 0\n");
    docker.refused = FakeDocker.ok(UP);
    docker.answers.put("inspect state", FakeDocker.ok("exited 1\n"));
    assertThat(check(IMAGE).printed())
        .startsWith("image: the API did not refuse a database no migration job ran on: exited 1\n");
  }

  @Test
  void anApiThatStopsForAnotherReasonDidNotRefuseAndItsLastLinesShow() throws IOException {
    String lines =
        IntStream.rangeClosed(1, 21)
            .mapToObj(n -> "core-1  | line " + n + "\n")
            .collect(Collectors.joining());
    docker.answers.put("compose logs core", FakeDocker.ok(lines));
    TestContext test = check(IMAGE);
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed())
        .startsWith(
            """
            image: the API did not refuse a database no migration job ran on: exited 1
            image: core-1  | line 2
            """)
        .contains("image: core-1  | line 21\n")
        .doesNotContain("line 1\n");
  }

  @Test
  void aProbeThatAnswersWithDetailOrAStackThatDoesNotStartIsRed() throws IOException {
    docker.answers.put("exec liveness", FakeDocker.ok("{\"status\":\"UP\",\"components\":{}}"));
    assertThat(check(IMAGE).printed())
        .startsWith("image: liveness answered {\"status\":\"UP\",\"components\":{}}\n");
    docker.answers.put("compose up", new Processes.Result(1, "timeout waiting for dependencies\n"));
    TestContext start = check(IMAGE);
    assertThat(start.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(start.printed())
        .isEqualTo(
            """
            image: the stack did not start: timeout waiting for dependencies
            image: migrate-1  | waiting for the database
            image: image content 182.9 MB, never started
            """);
  }

  @Test
  void aReadinessThatFailsOrAnswersAnythingButUpIsNeverReadyAndSixtySecondsAreInTime()
      throws IOException {
    docker.answers.put("exec readiness", FakeDocker.ok("{\"status\":\"DOWN\"}"));
    assertThat(check(IMAGE).printed()).startsWith("image: the container was never ready\n");
    docker.answers.put("exec readiness", new Processes.Result(28, UP));
    assertThat(check(IMAGE).printed()).startsWith("image: the container was never ready\n");
    docker.answers.put("exec readiness", FakeDocker.ok(UP));
    assertThat(check(60_000_000_000L, IMAGE).printed()).doesNotContain("past 60 s");
  }

  @Test
  void aContainerReadyAfterTheMinuteOrStoppedAfterTheGracePeriodIsRed() throws IOException {
    TestContext slow = check(61_000_000_000L, IMAGE);
    assertThat(slow.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(slow.printed())
        .isEqualTo(
            """
            image: ready after 61.0 s, past 60 s
            image: a stop signal did not end the JVM inside the grace period: exit 143 after 61.0 s
            image: image content 182.9 MB, ready in 61.0 s, memory 123.6MiB
            """);
    TestContext grace = check(30_000_000_000L, IMAGE);
    assertThat(grace.printed())
        .startsWith(
            "image: a stop signal did not end the JVM inside the grace period: exit 143 after 30.0 s\n");
  }

  @Test
  void aStopSignalThatDoesNotEndTheJvmInsideTheGracePeriodIsRed() throws IOException {
    docker.answers.put("inspect exit", FakeDocker.ok("137\n"));
    TestContext test = check(IMAGE);
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed())
        .startsWith(
            "image: a stop signal did not end the JVM inside the grace period: exit 137 after 1.5 s\n");
  }

  @Test
  void aMissingImageOrNoImageNamedStopsTheCheck() throws IOException {
    docker.answers.put("image inspect", new Processes.Result(1, "Error: No such image\n"));
    TestContext missing = check(IMAGE);
    assertThat(missing.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(missing.printed())
        .isEqualTo("image: no image metis-core:check: Error: No such image\n");
    TestContext usage = check();
    assertThat(usage.exit).isEqualTo(2);
    assertThat(usage.printed()).isEqualTo("usage: image <image>\n");
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.image;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

// The API connects as its own role and holds nothing of the owner of the tables or the superuser.
class CoreEnvironmentTest {

  private static final String HOLDS =
      "image: the core holds the role or a password of the owner of the tables or of the superuser\n";

  @TempDir Path root;

  private final FakeDocker docker = new FakeDocker();

  private String printed() throws IOException {
    return docker.check(root, 1_500_000_000L, "metis-core:check").printed();
  }

  @Test
  void aCoreThatConnectsAsAnotherRoleIsRed() throws IOException {
    docker.answers.put("inspect env", FakeDocker.ok("[\"SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME=metis\"]\n"));
    assertThat(printed())
        .startsWith("image: the core does not connect as metis_app\n")
        .doesNotContain(HOLDS);
  }

  @Test
  void aCoreThatHoldsTheRoleOrAPasswordOfTheOwnerOrOfTheSuperuserIsRed() throws IOException {
    docker.answers.put(
        "inspect env",
        FakeDocker.ok(
            "[\"SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME=metis_app\",\"SPRING_FLYWAY_USER=metis_migrator\"]\n"));
    assertThat(printed()).startsWith(HOLDS);
    for (String password : List.of("METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD", "METIS_POSTGRES_PASSWORD")) {
      docker.leaked = password;
      assertThat(printed()).as(password).startsWith(HOLDS);
    }
  }
}
```

`tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/ProcessesTest.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.tools;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Timeout;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class ProcessesTest {

  @TempDir Path dir;

  @Test
  void runReturnsTheExitStatusAndBothStreamsInTheOrderTheyWereWritten() {
    Processes.Result result =
        Processes.run(dir, List.of("sh", "-c", "echo out; echo err >&2; exit 3"));
    assertThat(result).isEqualTo(new Processes.Result(3, "out\nerr\n"));
  }

  @Test
  void quietKeepsTheStandardOutputAloneAndAddsTheErrorsOnlyToAFailure() {
    Processes.Result success =
        Processes.quiet(dir, List.of("sh", "-c", "echo out; echo warning >&2"));
    assertThat(success).isEqualTo(new Processes.Result(0, "out\n"));
    Processes.Result failure =
        Processes.quiet(dir, List.of("sh", "-c", "echo out; echo fatal >&2; exit 3"));
    assertThat(failure).isEqualTo(new Processes.Result(3, "out\nfatal\n"));
    assertThat(Processes.quiet(dir, List.of("cat"))).isEqualTo(new Processes.Result(0, ""));
  }

  @Test
  void runStartsTheCommandInTheFolderItIsGiven() throws IOException {
    Files.writeString(dir.resolve("marker.txt"), "here\n");
    assertThat(Processes.run(dir, List.of("cat", "marker.txt")).output()).isEqualTo("here\n");
  }

  @Test
  void runGivesTheCommandNoInputSoACommandThatReadsItEndsAtOnce() {
    assertThat(Processes.run(dir, List.of("cat"))).isEqualTo(new Processes.Result(0, ""));
  }

  @Test
  void inheritReturnsTheExitStatusOfACommandWhoseOutputGoesToThisProcess() throws IOException {
    assertThat(Processes.inherit(dir, List.of("sh", "-c", "exit 4"))).isEqualTo(4);
    assertThat(Processes.inherit(dir, List.of("sh", "-c", "test -f marker.txt"))).isEqualTo(1);
    Files.writeString(dir.resolve("marker.txt"), "");
    assertThat(Processes.inherit(dir, List.of("sh", "-c", "test -f marker.txt"))).isZero();
  }

  @Test
  void aCommandThatCannotStartIsAnError() {
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> Processes.run(dir, List.of("no-such-command-anywhere")))
        .isInstanceOf(UncheckedIOException.class)
        .hasCauseInstanceOf(IOException.class);
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> Processes.quiet(dir, List.of("no-such-command-anywhere")))
        .isInstanceOf(UncheckedIOException.class)
        .hasCauseInstanceOf(IOException.class);
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> Processes.inherit(dir, List.of("no-such-command-anywhere")))
        .isInstanceOf(UncheckedIOException.class)
        .hasCauseInstanceOf(IOException.class);
  }

  @Test
  @Timeout(20)
  void aCommandPastItsDeadlineEndsWithEveryProcessItStartedAndIsTimedOut() {
    Duration second = Duration.ofSeconds(1);
    List<String> parent = List.of("sh", "-c", "echo $$; sleep 30 & echo $!; wait");
    Processes.Result run = Processes.run(dir, parent, second);
    assertThat(run.status()).isEqualTo(Processes.TIMED_OUT);
    List<String> lines = run.output().lines().toList();
    assertThat(lines.getLast()).isEqualTo("timed out after 1 s: " + String.join(" ", parent));
    for (String pid : lines.subList(0, 2)) {
      ProcessHandle.of(Long.parseLong(pid))
          .ifPresent(alive -> alive.onExit().orTimeout(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS).join());
    }
    assertThat(Processes.quiet(dir, List.of("sleep", "30"), second))
        .isEqualTo(new Processes.Result(Processes.TIMED_OUT, "timed out after 1 s: sleep 30\n"));
    assertThat(Processes.inherit(dir, List.of("sleep", "30"), second))
        .isEqualTo(Processes.TIMED_OUT);
  }

  @Test
  void aStreamThatCannotBeReadIsAnError() throws IOException {
    InputStream closed = InputStream.nullInputStream();
    closed.close();
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> Processes.read(closed).join())
        .hasCauseInstanceOf(UncheckedIOException.class);
  }

  @Test
  void anInterruptedWaitIsAnErrorAndKeepsTheInterrupt() {
    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
    try {
      assertThatThrownBy(() -> Processes.inherit(dir, List.of("sleep", "2")))
          .isInstanceOf(UncheckedIOException.class)
          .hasMessageEndingWith("interrupted while sleep 2 ran");
      assertThat(Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()).isTrue();
    } finally {
      Thread.interrupted();
    }
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.verify;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.groups.Tuple.tuple;

import dev.metis.tools.Facts;
import dev.metis.tools.Processes;
import dev.metis.tools.TestContext;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class VerifyTest {

  private static final String TREE = "[0-9a-f]{12} \\(0 uncommitted\\)";

  @TempDir Path root;

  private final List<String> ran = new ArrayList<>();

  // A git that lists one file and no change, and a wrapper whose checks exit as the map says.
  private TestContext gitAndChecks(Map<String, Integer> exits) throws IOException {
    Files.writeString(root.resolve("a.txt"), "a\n");
    return new TestContext(root)
        .run(
            (dir, command) ->
                switch (command.get(1)) {
                  case "ls-files" -> new Processes.Result(0, "a.txt\0");
                  case "rev-parse" -> new Processes.Result(0, "abc123\n");
                  default -> new Processes.Result(0, "");
                })
        .inherit(
            (dir, command) -> {
              assertThat(dir).isEqualTo(root);
              String task = command.get(5);
              ran.add(task);
              return exits.getOrDefault(task, 99);
            });
  }

  @Test
  void runsEveryCheckInOrderEvenAfterARedOneAndEachRowNamesTheTreeAndTheTimeItStartedAt()
      throws IOException {
    TestContext test =
        gitAndChecks(
            Map.of("checkFormat", 0, "checkLint", 1, "checkLanguage", Processes.TIMED_OUT));
    List<Row> rows = Verify.run(test.context(), List.of("format", "lint", "language"));
    assertThat(ran).containsExactly("checkFormat", "checkLint", "checkLanguage");
    assertThat(rows)
        .extracting(Row::check, Row::result, Row::seconds, Row::facts, Row::at)
        .containsExactly(
            tuple("format", Row.GREEN, 1.5, "", "2026-10-14T00:00:00Z"),
            tuple("lint", Row.RED, 1.5, "", "2026-10-14T00:00:01Z"),
            tuple("language", Row.RED, 1.5, "timed out", "2026-10-14T00:00:02Z"));
    assertThat(rows).allSatisfy(row -> assertThat(row.tree()).matches(TREE));
  }

  @Test
  void aRowShowsTheFactsItsCheckLeftAndAFileAnEarlierRunLeftIsGoneBeforeTheCheckRuns()
      throws IOException {
    Facts.write(root, "unit", "stale");
    Facts.write(root, "tooling", "stale");
    TestContext test =
        gitAndChecks(Map.of())
            .inherit(
                (dir, command) -> {
                  ran.add(command.get(5));
                  if (command.get(5).equals("checkUnit")) {
                    writeFacts("unit", "12 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped");
                  }
                  return 0;
                });
    List<Row> rows = Verify.run(test.context(), List.of("unit", "tooling"));
    assertThat(rows)
        .extracting(Row::check, Row::result, Row::facts)
        .containsExactly(
            tuple("unit", Row.GREEN, "12 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped"),
            tuple("tooling", Row.GREEN, ""));
  }

  private void writeFacts(String check, String text) {
    try {
      Facts.write(root, check, text);
    } catch (IOException failed) {
      throw new AssertionError(failed);
    }
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.tenancy.internal;

import org.flywaydb.core.Flyway;
import org.springframework.boot.flyway.autoconfigure.FlywayMigrationStrategy;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Profile;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/** The API never migrates: it starts on a database that holds its migrations, or not at all. */
@Component
@Profile("!migrate")
class MigrationCheck implements FlywayMigrationStrategy {

  // A database ahead of the image is accepted, since a migration never breaks the image before it.
  @Override
  public void migrate(Flyway flyway) {
    flyway.validate();
  }
}
```

```sql
-- The registry the shell reads: the tenant, its people, its workspaces and their tree.
-- Each table holds the tenant of its row, filled from the tenant of the transaction, and a forced
-- policy lets a transaction see and write the rows of its own tenant alone.
-- A foreign key names the tenant too, so a row can never point at a row of another tenant.

create table tenant (
    tenant_id uuid primary key default nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid,
    name text not null
);

create table person (
    id uuid primary key default uuidv7(),
    tenant_id uuid not null default nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
        references tenant,
    subject text not null,
    name text not null,
    initials text not null,
    unique (tenant_id, id),
    unique (tenant_id, subject)
);

create table workspace (
    id uuid primary key default uuidv7(),
    tenant_id uuid not null default nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
        references tenant,
    key text not null,
    name text not null,
    position integer not null,
    unique (tenant_id, id),
    unique (tenant_id, key)
);

create table workspace_member (
    id uuid primary key default uuidv7(),
    tenant_id uuid not null default nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
        references tenant,
    workspace_id uuid not null,
    person_id uuid not null,
    foreign key (tenant_id, workspace_id) references workspace (tenant_id, id),
    foreign key (tenant_id, person_id) references person (tenant_id, id),
    unique (tenant_id, workspace_id, person_id)
);
create index workspace_member_person on workspace_member (tenant_id, person_id);

create table portfolio (
    id uuid primary key default uuidv7(),
    tenant_id uuid not null default nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
        references tenant,
    workspace_id uuid not null,
    name text not null,
    position integer not null,
    foreign key (tenant_id, workspace_id) references workspace (tenant_id, id),
    unique (tenant_id, id)
);
create index portfolio_workspace on portfolio (tenant_id, workspace_id);

create table program (
    id uuid primary key default uuidv7(),
    tenant_id uuid not null default nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
        references tenant,
    portfolio_id uuid not null,
    name text not null,
    position integer not null,
    foreign key (tenant_id, portfolio_id) references portfolio (tenant_id, id),
    unique (tenant_id, id)
);
create index program_portfolio on program (tenant_id, portfolio_id);

create table project (
    id uuid primary key default uuidv7(),
    tenant_id uuid not null default nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
        references tenant,
    program_id uuid not null,
    key text not null,
    name text not null,
    position integer not null,
    foreign key (tenant_id, program_id) references program (tenant_id, id),
    unique (tenant_id, key)
);
create index project_program on project (tenant_id, program_id);

alter table tenant enable row level security;
alter table tenant force row level security;
create policy tenant_rows on tenant
    using (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid);

alter table person enable row level security;
alter table person force row level security;
create policy tenant_rows on person
    using (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid);

alter table workspace enable row level security;
alter table workspace force row level security;
create policy tenant_rows on workspace
    using (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid);

alter table workspace_member enable row level security;
alter table workspace_member force row level security;
create policy tenant_rows on workspace_member
    using (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid);

alter table portfolio enable row level security;
alter table portfolio force row level security;
create policy tenant_rows on portfolio
    using (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid);

alter table program enable row level security;
alter table program force row level security;
create policy tenant_rows on program
    using (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid);

alter table project enable row level security;
alter table project force row level security;
create policy tenant_rows on project
    using (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid);

-- The API reads and never writes yet; it reads the history of the migrations to refuse a
-- database that is behind.
grant select on tenant, person, workspace, workspace_member, portfolio, program, project
    to metis_app;
grant select on flyway_schema_history to metis_app;
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
import java.util.Set;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.dao.DataAccessResourceFailureException;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatusCode;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.transaction.CannotCreateTransactionException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.ServletWebRequest;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.WebRequest;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.ResponseEntityExceptionHandler;

/** Turns every exception that leaves a controller, Spring's own included, into Problem Details. */
@RestControllerAdvice
class ProblemAdvice extends ResponseEntityExceptionHandler {

  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ProblemAdvice.class);

  private final Problems problems;

  ProblemAdvice(Problems problems) {
    this.problems = problems;
  }

  @ExceptionHandler({
    CannotCreateTransactionException.class,
    DataAccessResourceFailureException.class
  })
  ResponseEntity<Problem> unavailable(Exception failure, HttpServletRequest request) {
    LOG.warn("the database cannot be reached: {}", failure.getClass().getName());
    return problems.answer(503, request);
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
  ResponseEntity<Problem> defect(Exception failure, HttpServletRequest request) {
    LOG.error("a request failed: {}", trace(failure));
    return problems.answer(500, request);
  }

  // The type and the frames of each cause and never a message, which may hold a value of a record.
  static String trace(Throwable failure) {
    StringBuilder trace = new StringBuilder();
    Set<Throwable> seen = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
    for (Throwable cause = failure; cause != null && seen.add(cause); cause = cause.getCause()) {
      trace.append(trace.isEmpty() ? "" : "caused by ").append(cause.getClass().getName());
      for (StackTraceElement frame : cause.getStackTrace()) {
        trace.append("\n\tat ").append(frame);
      }
      trace.append('\n');
    }
    return trace.toString();
  }

  // Every exception of Spring MVC ends here, with the body it chose, which is replaced.
  @Override
  protected ResponseEntity<Object> createResponseEntity(
      @Nullable Object body, HttpHeaders headers, HttpStatusCode status, WebRequest request) {
    ResponseEntity<Problem> answer =
        problems.answer(status.value(), ((ServletWebRequest) request).getRequest());
    return ResponseEntity.status(status)
        .headers(headers)
        .headers(answer.getHeaders())
        .<Object>body(answer.getBody());
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.image;

import dev.metis.tools.Context;
import dev.metis.tools.Facts;
import dev.metis.tools.Processes;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/** Runs the image from the compose file of the stack, as a deployment does, and records it. */
public final class ImageCheck {

  // A project of its own on a free port, so a local stack that runs is left alone.
  private static final String PROJECT = "metis-check";
  private static final List<String> COMPOSE =
      List.of("docker", "compose", "--project-name", PROJECT, "--file", "stack/compose.yaml");
  private static final String CONTAINER = PROJECT + "-core-1";
  // The stack reads every password from the environment, and each run makes its own.
  private static final List<String> PASSWORDS =
      List.of("METIS_POSTGRES_PASSWORD", "METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD", "METIS_APP_PASSWORD");
  private static final String LOCKDOWN =
      "{{.HostConfig.ReadonlyRootfs}}|{{json .HostConfig.CapDrop}}|{{json .HostConfig.SecurityOpt}}"
          + "|{{.HostConfig.Memory}}|{{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}}|{{json .HostConfig.Tmpfs}}"
          + "|{{.Config.StopTimeout}}|{{json .HostConfig.CapAdd}}|{{.HostConfig.Privileged}}"
          + "|{{json .Mounts}}";
  // A read-only root with one temporary folder, no capability, no new privilege, 2 GB, one
  // processor, 30 seconds of grace, nothing added, no privileged mode and no mount, as compose
  // must say.
  private static final String LOCKED =
      "true|[\"ALL\"]|[\"no-new-privileges:true\"]|2147483648|1000000000|{\"/tmp\":\"\"}|30"
          + "|null|false|[]";
  private static final String UP = "{\"status\":\"UP\"}";
  // What Flyway says of a database without a migration of the image, the reason to refuse it.
  private static final String BEHIND = "Detected resolved migration not applied to database";
  private static final int READY_SECONDS = 60;
  // Compose waits this long for what a service depends on, so a job that never ends turns red.
  private static final int START_SECONDS = 120;
  private static final int GRACE_SECONDS = 30;
  // The running core itself: its user, its capabilities, its root mount and any build tool.
  private static final String PROBE =
      "id -u || exit 1; grep -E '^Cap(Eff|Bnd):' /proc/1/status || exit 1; grep ' / ' /proc/mounts"
          + " || exit 1; for tool in javac jar gradle mvn; do command -v \"$tool\"; done; exit 0";
  private static final Pattern NO_CAPABILITY = Pattern.compile("Cap(Eff|Bnd):\\s+0+");
  private static final Pattern ROOT_MOUNT = Pattern.compile("\\S+ / \\S+ (\\S+) .*");
  private final Context context;
  private final String image;
  private final List<String> problems = new ArrayList<>();
  private final Map<String, String> passwords = new LinkedHashMap<>();

  private ImageCheck(Context context, String image) {
    this.context = context;
    this.image = image;
    PASSWORDS.forEach(name -> passwords.put(name, UUID.randomUUID().toString()));
  }

  /** Checks the image the argument names and leaves its measures as facts. */
  public static int command(Context context, List<String> args) throws IOException {
    PrintStream out = context.out();
    if (args.size() != 1) {
      out.println("usage: image <image>");
      return 2;
    }
    ImageCheck check = new ImageCheck(context, args.getFirst());
    Processes.Result size = check.docker("image", "inspect", "--format", "{{.Size}}", check.image);
    if (size.status() != 0) {
      out.println("image: no image " + check.image + ": " + size.output().strip());
      return 1;
    }
    String facts =
        String.format(
                Locale.ROOT, "image content %.1f MB, ", Long.parseLong(size.output().strip()) / 1e6)
            + check.run();
    check.problems.forEach(problem -> out.println("image: " + problem));
    out.println("image: " + facts);
    Facts.write(context.root(), "image", facts);
    return check.problems.isEmpty() ? 0 : 1;
  }

  // Runs the stack with the image and gives the facts after the size; each run starts from
  // nothing, the volumes of the project included.
  private String run() {
    compose("down", "--volumes");
    try {
      refused();
      Processes.Result started =
          compose("up", "--detach", "--no-build", "--wait-timeout", String.valueOf(START_SECONDS));
      if (started.status() != 0) {
        problems.add("the stack did not start: " + started.output().strip());
        problems.addAll(last(compose("logs", "--no-color", "migrate").output()));
        return "never started";
      }
      return running();
    } finally {
      compose("down", "--volumes");
    }
  }

  // The API alone, on a database no migration job ran on, must refuse to start, for that reason.
  private void refused() {
    compose(
        "up",
        "--detach",
        "--no-build",
        "--no-deps",
        "--wait",
        "--wait-timeout",
        String.valueOf(START_SECONDS),
        "postgres");
    compose("up", "--detach", "--no-build", "--no-deps", "core");
    boolean ready = probe("readiness", READY_SECONDS).output().strip().equals(UP);
    // The probe ends with the process of a refused start, whose container may still be stopping.
    docker("stop", "--timeout", String.valueOf(GRACE_SECONDS), CONTAINER);
    String state =
        docker("inspect", "--format", "{{.State.Status}} {{.State.ExitCode}}", CONTAINER)
            .output()
            .strip();
    String log = compose("logs", "--no-color", "core").output();
    if (ready || !state.matches("exited [1-9]\\d*") || !log.contains(BEHIND)) {
      problems.add("the API did not refuse a database no migration job ran on: " + state);
      problems.addAll(last(log));
    }
  }

  // The last lines of a log, which say why a container stopped or never ended.
  private static List<String> last(String log) {
    List<String> lines = log.strip().lines().toList();
    return lines.subList(Math.max(0, lines.size() - 20), lines.size());
  }

  private String running() {
    String locked = docker("inspect", "--format", LOCKDOWN, CONTAINER).output().strip();
    if (!locked.equals(LOCKED)) {
      problems.add("the stack does not run the core locked down: " + locked);
    }
    connectsAsTheApi();
    long start = context.nanos().getAsLong();
    Processes.Result ready = probe("readiness", READY_SECONDS);
    double seconds = (context.nanos().getAsLong() - start) / 1e9;
    if (ready.status() != 0 || !ready.output().strip().equals(UP)) {
      problems.add("the container was never ready");
      compose("logs", "--no-color", "--tail", "20").output().strip().lines().forEach(problems::add);
      return "never ready";
    }
    if (seconds > READY_SECONDS) {
      problems.add(
          String.format(Locale.ROOT, "ready after %.1f s, past %d s", seconds, READY_SECONDS));
    }
    inside();
    Processes.Result live = probe("liveness", 0);
    if (!live.output().strip().equals(UP)) {
      problems.add("liveness answered " + live.output().strip());
    }
    String memory =
        docker("stats", "--no-stream", "--format", "{{.MemUsage}}", CONTAINER).output().strip();
    stop();
    return String.format(
        Locale.ROOT, "ready in %.1f s, memory %s", seconds, memory.replaceAll(" /.*", ""));
  }

  // The API connects as its own role and holds nothing that could switch a policy off.
  private void connectsAsTheApi() {
    String environment = docker("inspect", "--format", "{{json .Config.Env}}", CONTAINER).output();
    if (!environment.contains("\"SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME=metis_app\"")) {
      problems.add("the core does not connect as metis_app");
    }
    if (environment.contains("metis_migrator")
        || environment.contains(Objects.requireNonNull(passwords.get("METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD")))
        || environment.contains(Objects.requireNonNull(passwords.get("METIS_POSTGRES_PASSWORD")))) {
      problems.add(
          "the core holds the role or a password of the owner of the tables or of the superuser");
    }
  }

  // Whatever the image or the compose file say, the running core is not the user 0, holds no
  // capability, has a read-only root and no build tool; a probe that fails proves none of it.
  private void inside() {
    Processes.Result probe =
        context
            .quiet()
            .apply(context.root(), List.of("docker", "exec", CONTAINER, "sh", "-c", PROBE));
    List<String> lines = probe.output().strip().lines().toList();
    Matcher mount = ROOT_MOUNT.matcher(lines.size() > 3 ? lines.get(3) : "");
    if (probe.status() != 0 || !lines.getFirst().matches("\\d+") || !mount.matches()) {
      problems.add(
          "cannot read the user and the capabilities of the core: " + probe.output().strip());
      return;
    }
    if (lines.getFirst().equals("0")) {
      problems.add("the core runs as root");
    }
    if (!NO_CAPABILITY.matcher(lines.get(1)).matches()
        || !NO_CAPABILITY.matcher(lines.get(2)).matches()) {
      problems.add(
          "the core runs with a capability: "
              + (lines.get(1) + ", " + lines.get(2)).replaceAll("\\s+", " "));
    }
    // The first option of the mount says how it is mounted; the others name the layers.
    String mode = mount.group(1).replaceFirst(",.*", "");
    if (!mode.equals("ro")) {
      problems.add("the root file system of the core is writable: " + mode);
    }
    if (lines.size() > 4) {
      problems.add(
          "the image holds a build tool: " + String.join(" ", lines.subList(4, lines.size())));
    }
  }

  // The JVM runs as the first process, so the signal reaches it and it exits with 128 and 15.
  private void stop() {
    long start = context.nanos().getAsLong();
    compose("stop", "core");
    double seconds = (context.nanos().getAsLong() - start) / 1e9;
    String exit = docker("inspect", "--format", "{{.State.ExitCode}}", CONTAINER).output().strip();
    if (!exit.equals("143") || seconds >= GRACE_SECONDS) {
      problems.add(
          String.format(
              Locale.ROOT,
              "a stop signal did not end the JVM inside the grace period: exit %s after %.1f s",
              exit,
              seconds));
    }
  }

  // curl waits between its tries inside the container, so the check keeps no clock of its own.
  // ponytail: the time to ready is known to the second; a shorter delay between tries lifts it.
  private Processes.Result probe(String probe, int tries) {
    return docker(
        "exec",
        CONTAINER,
        "curl",
        "--fail",
        "--silent",
        "--max-time",
        "2",
        "--retry",
        String.valueOf(tries),
        "--retry-delay",
        "1",
        "--retry-all-errors",
        "http://localhost:8080/actuator/health/" + probe);
  }

  // The stack runs the image under test, on a free port, in a time zone that is not UTC.
  private Processes.Result compose(String... args) {
    List<String> command =
        new ArrayList<>(
            List.of(
                "env", "METIS_IMAGE=" + image, "METIS_PORT=", "METIS_TIME_ZONE=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh"));
    passwords.forEach((name, value) -> command.add(name + "=" + value));
    command.addAll(COMPOSE);
    command.addAll(List.of(args));
    return context.run().apply(context.root(), command);
  }

  private Processes.Result docker(String... args) {
    List<String> command = new ArrayList<>(List.of("docker"));
    command.addAll(List.of(args));
    return context.run().apply(context.root(), command);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/** Runs a command in a folder and waits for it to end; a command that cannot run is an error. */
public final class Processes {

  /** The status of a command ended at its deadline, the one timeout(1) gives. */
  public static final int TIMED_OUT = 124;

  // Far longer than any check takes, so only a command that would wait for ever reaches it.
  private static final Duration DEADLINE = Duration.ofMinutes(30);

  private Processes() {}

  /** The exit status of a command and everything it wrote, both streams in one text. */
  public record Result(int status, String output) {}

  /** Runs the command with its output captured. */
  public static Result run(Path dir, List<String> command) {
    return run(dir, command, DEADLINE);
  }

  static Result run(Path dir, List<String> command, Duration deadline) {
    try {
      Process process =
          new ProcessBuilder(command).redirectErrorStream(true).directory(dir.toFile()).start();
      process.getOutputStream().close();
      CompletableFuture<String> output = read(process.getInputStream());
      int status = waitFor(process, command, deadline);
      return new Result(status, output.join() + timedOut(status, command, deadline));
    } catch (IOException failed) {
      throw new UncheckedIOException(failed);
    }
  }

  /** Runs the command for a reader of what it prints: its errors are kept for a failure alone. */
  public static Result quiet(Path dir, List<String> command) {
    return quiet(dir, command, DEADLINE);
  }

  static Result quiet(Path dir, List<String> command, Duration deadline) {
    try {
      Process process = new ProcessBuilder(command).directory(dir.toFile()).start();
      process.getOutputStream().close();
      CompletableFuture<String> errors = read(process.getErrorStream());
      CompletableFuture<String> output = read(process.getInputStream());
      int status = waitFor(process, command, deadline);
      String text = status == 0 ? output.join() : output.join() + errors.join();
      return new Result(status, text + timedOut(status, command, deadline));
    } catch (IOException failed) {
      throw new UncheckedIOException(failed);
    }
  }

  /** Runs the command with its output going where the output of this process goes. */
  public static int inherit(Path dir, List<String> command) {
    return inherit(dir, command, DEADLINE);
  }

  static int inherit(Path dir, List<String> command, Duration deadline) {
    try {
      return waitFor(
          new ProcessBuilder(command).directory(dir.toFile()).inheritIO().start(),
          command,
          deadline);
    } catch (IOException failed) {
      throw new UncheckedIOException(failed);
    }
  }

  // Read apart, so a command that fills one stream never waits for the other to be read.
  static CompletableFuture<String> read(InputStream stream) {
    return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(
        () -> {
          try {
            return new String(stream.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
          } catch (IOException failed) {
            throw new UncheckedIOException(failed);
          }
        });
  }

  // At its deadline a command ends with every process it started, since one may hold its output.
  private static int waitFor(Process process, List<String> command, Duration deadline)
      throws IOException {
    try {
      if (process.waitFor(deadline.toMillis(), TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)) {
        return process.exitValue();
      }
      List<ProcessHandle> started = process.descendants().toList();
      process.destroyForcibly();
      started.forEach(ProcessHandle::destroyForcibly);
      process.waitFor();
      return TIMED_OUT;
    } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
      throw new IOException("interrupted while " + String.join(" ", command) + " ran", interrupted);
    }
  }

  private static String timedOut(int status, List<String> command, Duration deadline) {
    return status == TIMED_OUT
        ? "timed out after " + deadline.toSeconds() + " s: " + String.join(" ", command) + "\n"
        : "";
  }
}
```

`tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/verify/Verify.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.tools.verify;

import dev.metis.tools.Context;
import dev.metis.tools.Facts;
import dev.metis.tools.Git;
import dev.metis.tools.Processes;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/** ./verify: runs the checks, one after the other, and keeps the record of the run. */
public final class Verify {

  private Verify() {}

  /** Runs the checks the arguments ask for, writes the record and returns the exit code. */
  public static int command(Context context, List<String> args) throws IOException {
    Path root = context.root();
    PrintStream out = context.out();
    Optional<List<String>> found = checksOf(root, out);
    if (found.isEmpty()) {
      return 1;
    }
    List<String> all = found.get();
    Plan plan;
    try {
      plan = Plan.of(args, all);
    } catch (IllegalArgumentException wrong) {
      out.println("verify: " + wrong.getMessage());
      return 1;
    }
    Optional<Ledger> previous = plan.append() ? previous(root, all) : Optional.empty();
    if (plan.append() && previous.isEmpty()) {
      out.println("verify: reports/verify.json is missing or unreadable, so a new record starts");
    }
    List<Row> rows = run(context, plan.checks());
    Ledger ledger =
        previous
            .map(earlier -> earlier.withReruns(rows))
            .orElseGet(() -> new Ledger(context.git().commit(), rows, List.of()));
    Files.createDirectories(root.resolve("reports"));
    Files.writeString(root.resolve("reports/verify.json"), Ledger.write(ledger));
    String report = Report.of(ledger, all);
    Files.writeString(root.resolve("reports/verify.md"), report);
    out.print("\n" + report);
    // A full run is the record others cite, so one that cannot name its tree fails.
    boolean unbound = plan.full() && rows.stream().anyMatch(row -> row.tree().equals(Git.UNKNOWN));
    if (unbound) {
      out.println("verify: " + Report.UNBOUND);
    }
    return unbound || rows.stream().anyMatch(row -> row.result().equals(Row.RED)) ? 1 : 0;
  }

  // The checks Gradle has, or none when the list is missing, holds a task the tool lacks, or is
  // empty.
  private static Optional<List<String>> checksOf(Path root, PrintStream out) {
    try {
      List<String> all = Checks.of(Checks.tasks(root));
      if (all.isEmpty()) {
        out.println("verify: the build has no check task");
      }
      return Optional.of(all).filter(checks -> !checks.isEmpty());
    } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException unusable) {
      out.println("verify: " + unusable.getMessage());
      return Optional.empty();
    }
  }

  private static Optional<Ledger> previous(Path root, List<String> all) throws IOException {
    Path json = root.resolve("reports/verify.json");
    return Files.exists(json) ? Ledger.read(Files.readString(json), all) : Optional.empty();
  }

  /** Runs each check, even after a red one, and gives its row. */
  static List<Row> run(Context context, List<String> checks) throws IOException {
    Path root = context.root();
    Git git = context.git();
    List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>();
    for (String check : checks) {
      Facts.clear(root, check);
      String tree = git.tree();
      String at = context.now().get().toString();
      long start = context.nanos().getAsLong();
      List<String> command = Checks.command(root, check, context.workers(), List.of());
      int status = context.inherit().applyAsInt(root, command);
      double seconds = (context.nanos().getAsLong() - start) / 1e9;
      String result = status == 0 ? Row.GREEN : Row.RED;
      // A check that never ended left no facts, and its row says why it is red.
      String facts =
          status == Processes.TIMED_OUT ? "timed out" : Facts.read(root, check).orElse("");
      rows.add(new Row(check, result, seconds, facts, tree, at));
    }
    return rows;
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;

/** The counter-tests of the integration check. */
final class IntegrationCanaries {

  private static final String MIGRATION = "core/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__registry.sql";
  private static final String POLICY =
      """
      create policy tenant_rows on program
          using (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid);
      """;

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          // A table a migration left without its policy.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-no-policy",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every table forces row-level security")
              .replacing(MIGRATION, POLICY, ""),
          // A table whose policy does not bind its owner, which the API alone would not show.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-no-force",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every table forces row-level security")
              .replacing(MIGRATION, "alter table program force row level security;\n", ""),
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-no-tenant-column",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every table holds the tenant of its row")
              .appending(
                  MIGRATION, "\ncreate table canary (id uuid primary key default uuidv7());\n"),
          // The role of the API allowed to pass by every policy.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-bypassrls",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API is no superuser")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/postgres/roles.sh",
                  "create role metis_app login password",
                  "create role metis_app login bypassrls password"),
          // The role of the API made a member of the owner, whose rights it then holds.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-app-in-owner-role",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API is no superuser")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/postgres/roles.sh",
                  "alter database",
                  "grant metis_migrator to metis_app;\nalter database"),
          // A write granted to every role, which a list of the grants to the API does not show.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-public-write",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API may read")
              .appending(MIGRATION, "\ngrant insert on person to public;\n"),
          // A right on one column, which a list of the rights on tables does not show.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-column-grant",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API may read")
              .appending(MIGRATION, "\ngrant update (name) on tenant to metis_app;\n"),
          // A materialized view the API can read, which no policy guards and no grant list shows.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-readable-view",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every relation the API can read")
              .appending(
                  MIGRATION,
                  """

                  create materialized view canary as select name from tenant;
                  grant select on canary to metis_app;
                  """),
          // A changed stack under the seed of a green run, which a cached result would answer.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-stack-input",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API is no superuser")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/postgres/roles.sh",
                  "create role metis_app login password",
                  "create role metis_app login bypassrls password")
              .arguments("-PtestSeed=1"),
          // A test deleted without lowering the floor, which only the exact floor notices.
          Canary.of("integration-floor", "integration", "update test-floor.json")
              .deleting("test-support/java/dev/metis/testsupport/LocalHostOnlyTest.java"),
          // A setting of the order lost, which the test of the order runs here too.
          Canary.of("integration-fixed-order", "integration", "TestOrderTest >")
              .replacing(
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;

/** The counter-tests of the unit check. */
final class UnitCanaries {

  private static final String TESTS = "core/src/test/java/dev/metis/core/";

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          Canary.of("unit-failing", "unit", "CanaryFailingTest > one() FAILED")
              .writing(TESTS + "CanaryFailingTest.java", test("CanaryFailingTest", "", "2")),
          Canary.of("unit-disabled", "unit", "skipped tests")
              .writing(
                  TESTS + "CanaryDisabledTest.java",
                  test("CanaryDisabledTest", "  @org.junit.jupiter.api.Disabled\n", "1")),
          // A test deleted without lowering the floor, which only the exact floor notices.
          Canary.of("unit-floor", "unit", "update test-floor.json")
              .deleting(TESTS + "platform/time/internal/ClockConfigurationTest.java"),
          // A test check without its judge, which would pass skipped tests on the exit of Gradle.
          Canary.of("unit-no-judge", "unit", "checkUnit: its judge left no facts")
              .replacing(
                  "build.gradle.kts",
                  "dependsOn(\":core:test\", \":tools:judgeUnit\")",
                  "dependsOn(\":core:test\")"),
          // A setting of the order lost, so the methods would run in one order.
          Canary.of("unit-fixed-order", "unit", "TestOrderTest >")
              .replacing(
                  "build-logic/src/main/kotlin/metis.java-conventions.gradle.kts",
                  "    systemProperty(\"junit.jupiter.testmethod.order.default\","
                      + " \"org.junit.jupiter.api.MethodOrderer\\$Random\")\n",
                  ""));

  private UnitCanaries() {}

  // A test class of the core with one test, which asserts that one parses to the number given.
  private static String test(String name, String annotation, String expected) {
    return """
        package dev.metis.core;

        import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

        import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

        class %s {

          @Test
        %s  void one() {
            assertThat(Integer.parseInt("1")).isEqualTo(%s);
          }
        }
        """
        .formatted(name, annotation, expected);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * The counter-tests of the image check: a line added to the Dockerfile wins, or a change of stack.
 */
final class ImageCanaries {

  private static final String DOCKERFILE = "core/Dockerfile";

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          Canary.of("image-root", "image", "the core runs as root")
              .appending(DOCKERFILE, "USER root\n"),
          // A shell running more than the JVM holds the stop signal back from it until grace ends.
          Canary.of("image-shell-entrypoint", "image", "inside the grace period")
              .appending(DOCKERFILE, "ENTRYPOINT java -jar core.jar && echo stopped\n"),
          Canary.of("image-root-write", "image", "Read-only file system")
              .appending(
                  DOCKERFILE,
                  "ENTRYPOINT [\"sh\", \"-c\", \"touch /started && exec java -jar core.jar\"]\n"),
          // The root user again, which the linter of the Dockerfile names on its own.
          Canary.of("image-hadolint", "image", "DL3002").appending(DOCKERFILE, "USER root\n"),
          // A library with a known vulnerability in the image, which only the scan of the image
          // sees.
          Canary.of("image-scan", "image", "CVE-2021-44228")
              .appending(
                  DOCKERFILE,
                  "ADD https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/apache/logging/log4j/log4j-core/2.14.1/"
                      + "log4j-core-2.14.1.jar /app/lib/\n"),
          // A writable root in the compose file, which the check reads back from the container.
          Canary.of("image-compose-writable", "image", "does not run the core locked down")
              .replacing("stack/compose.yaml", "    read_only: true\n", ""),
          // The root user in the compose file, which the image alone does not show.
          Canary.of("image-compose-root", "image", "the core runs as root")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/compose.yaml",
                  "    read_only: true\n",
                  "    user: \"0\"\n    read_only: true\n"),
          // An API that starts without checking the migrations of its database.
          Canary.of(
                  "image-unchecked-database",
                  "image",
                  "the API did not refuse a database no migration job ran on")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/compose.yaml",
                  "METIS_SECURITY_ISSUER: http://keycloak:8080/realms/metis",
                  "METIS_SECURITY_ISSUER: http://keycloak:8080/realms/metis\n"
                      + "      SPRING_FLYWAY_ENABLED: \"false\""),
          // The password of the owner of the tables given to the API, which then holds that role.
          Canary.of("image-owner-password", "image", "the core holds")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/compose.yaml",
                  "      METIS_SECURITY_ISSUER:",
                  "      SPRING_FLYWAY_PASSWORD: ${METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD:?x}\n"
                      + "      METIS_SECURITY_ISSUER:"),
          // A capability the compose file adds back, which the running core then holds.
          Canary.of("image-compose-capability", "image", "the core runs with a capability")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/compose.yaml",
                  "    cap_drop:\n      - ALL\n",
                  "    cap_add:\n      - NET_RAW\n    cap_drop:\n      - ALL\n"));

  private ImageCanaries() {}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 24: Add the files of this task to the ledger**

Add the files the list above names, the generated ones included, to the ledger of the run. Never run git add, git commit or git push: the owner commits.

### Task 5: The tenant of each transaction

The transaction manager of the core runs `select set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, true)` as the first statement of every transaction, from the `CurrentUser` of the security context, and makes a read-only transaction read-only in the database. The third argument keeps the setting to the transaction, so a pooled connection carries nothing over: PostgreSQL then leaves an empty text, which the policy reads as no tenant, as it reads a setting that was never made. Spring Boot's own transaction manager backs off, so the hook is a bean that takes the settings Spring Boot gives a transaction manager. The driver of the tests leaves read-only to the core, so the read-only test proves the hook itself. The tenant hook and, from the next task, the repositories are the only classes left out of mutation testing, each with its reason in `config/mutation-exclusions.txt`, which the lint check counts as marks; PIT mutates the lines that call a logger too, which it spares unless given a list of its own.
