```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.awaitility.Awaitility.await;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.DriverManagerDataSource;
import org.testcontainers.containers.GenericContainer;
import org.testcontainers.postgresql.PostgreSQLContainer;
import org.testcontainers.utility.DockerImageName;
import org.testcontainers.utility.MountableFile;
import org.yaml.snakeyaml.Yaml;

/** The services of the local stack for the tests, made from the files the stack itself runs. */
final class Stack {

  /** The password of the role of the API, made anew for each run. */
  static final String APP_PASSWORD = UUID.randomUUID().toString();

  /** The password of the owner of the tables, made anew for each run. */
  static final String MIGRATOR_PASSWORD = UUID.randomUUID().toString();

  private static final String ADMIN_PASSWORD = UUID.randomUUID().toString();

  /** The database most tests share, migrated by the migration job. */
  static final PostgreSQLContainer DATABASE = migrated(database());

  private Stack() {}

  /** A new database of the stack with its two roles, which nothing migrated yet. */
  static PostgreSQLContainer database() {
    PostgreSQLContainer database =
        new PostgreSQLContainer(
                DockerImageName.parse(image("postgres")).asCompatibleSubstituteFor("postgres"))
            .withDatabaseName("metis")
            .withUsername("postgres")
            .withPassword(ADMIN_PASSWORD)
            .withEnv("METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD", MIGRATOR_PASSWORD)
            .withEnv("METIS_APP_PASSWORD", APP_PASSWORD)
            .withCopyFileToContainer(
                MountableFile.forHostPath("stack/postgres/roles.sh", 0755),
                "/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/roles.sh");
    publishOnLoopback(database);
    database.start();
    // The module waits for a line of the log alone; a first connection proves the forwarded port.
    await()
        .atMost(Duration.ofMinutes(1))
        // In the calling thread, since the first database is made while this class initializes.
        .pollInSameThread()
        .ignoreExceptions()
        .until(() -> admin(database).sql("select 1").query(Integer.class).single() == 1);
    return database;
  }

  /** Publishes each port the container exposes on the loopback address alone. */
  static void publishOnLoopback(GenericContainer<?> container) {
    // On macOS a program on 127.0.0.1 takes the traffic of a port published on every address.
    container.setPortBindings(
        container.getExposedPorts().stream().map(port -> "127.0.0.1::" + port).toList());
  }

  /** Runs the migration job on the database, as the stack does before the API starts. */
  static PostgreSQLContainer migrated(PostgreSQLContainer database) {
    SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, migrationJob(database)).close();
    return database;
  }

  /** The arguments that start the core as the migration job of the database. */
  static String[] migrationJob(PostgreSQLContainer database) {
    return new String[] {
      "--spring.profiles.active=migrate",
      "--spring.datasource.url=" + database.getJdbcUrl(),
      "--spring.datasource.username=metis_migrator",
      "--spring.datasource.password=" + MIGRATOR_PASSWORD
    };
  }

  /** The arguments that start the core as the API on the database, with the issuer given. */
  static String[] api(PostgreSQLContainer database, String issuer) {
    // On the loopback address alone, where no other program on this machine can hold the same port.
    return new String[] {
      "--server.port=0",
      "--server.address=127.0.0.1",
      "--spring.profiles.active=test",
      "--spring.datasource.url=" + url(database),
      "--spring.datasource.username=metis_app",
      "--spring.datasource.password=" + APP_PASSWORD,
      "--metis.security.issuer=" + issuer,
      "--metis.time.fixed=" + TestIssuer.NOW
    };
  }

  /** The address of the database for the API, whose driver leaves read-only to the core. */
  static String url(PostgreSQLContainer database) {
    return database.getJdbcUrl() + "&readOnlyMode=ignore";
  }

  /** The superuser of the database, which no policy binds: it seeds rows and reads the catalog. */
  static JdbcClient admin(PostgreSQLContainer database) {
    return JdbcClient.create(
        new DriverManagerDataSource(database.getJdbcUrl(), "postgres", ADMIN_PASSWORD));
  }

  /** The role of the API, which every policy binds. */
  static JdbcClient app(PostgreSQLContainer database) {
    return JdbcClient.create(
        new DriverManagerDataSource(database.getJdbcUrl(), "metis_app", APP_PASSWORD));
  }

  /** The image of a service of stack/compose.yaml, which pins it by its digest. */
  static String image(String service) {
    try (Reader compose = Files.newBufferedReader(Path.of("stack/compose.yaml"))) {
      Map<?, ?> services = (Map<?, ?>) new Yaml().<Map<?, ?>>load(compose).get("services");
      Map<?, ?> named = (Map<?, ?>) Objects.requireNonNull(services).get(service);
      return String.valueOf(Objects.requireNonNull(named, service).get("image"));
    } catch (IOException unreadable) {
      throw new UncheckedIOException(unreadable);
    }
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import dev.metis.core.platform.security.CurrentUser;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.List;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.SingleConnectionDataSource;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.TestingAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;

@ApiTest
class TenantTransactionTest {

  private final TransactionTemplate read;
  private final JdbcClient jdbc;

  TenantTransactionTest(@Autowired PlatformTransactionManager manager, @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc) {
    this.read = new TransactionTemplate(manager);
    this.read.setReadOnly(true);
    this.jdbc = jdbc;
  }

  @AfterEach
  void forgetTheUser() {
    SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
  }

  // The tenants a transaction sees, after the process id of its connection.
  private List<String> tenantsSeenBy(Seed.@Nullable Person person) {
    SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
    if (person != null) {
      CurrentUser user = new CurrentUser(person.subject(), person.tenant().id());
      SecurityContextHolder.getContext()
          .setAuthentication(new TestingAuthenticationToken(user, null));
    }
    return read.execute(
        status ->
            jdbc.sql("select pg_backend_pid()::text union all (select name from tenant order by 1)")
                .query(String.class)
                .list());
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 a transaction sees the rows of the tenant of its user alone")
  void theTenantOfTheUser() {
    assertThat(tenantsSeenBy(Seed.MEMBER)).hasSize(2).last().isEqualTo(Seed.TENANT.name());
    assertThat(tenantsSeenBy(Seed.RIVAL)).hasSize(2).last().isEqualTo(Seed.OTHER_TENANT.name());
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 the tenant of a transaction ends with it, so the next one on the pooled connection sees no row")
  void theTenantEndsWithTheTransaction() {
    List<String> before = tenantsSeenBy(Seed.MEMBER);
    // The pool hands a thread the connection it used last, so both run on one connection.
    assertThat(tenantsSeenBy(null)).containsExactly(before.getFirst());
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 without a tenant no row is seen, whether the connection never held one or held one before")
  void noTenantNoRow() throws SQLException {
    JdbcClient fresh = Stack.app(Stack.DATABASE);
    assertThat(
            fresh
                .sql("select current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)")
                .query(String.class)
                .optional())
        .isEmpty();
    assertThat(fresh.sql("select count(*) from tenant").query(Integer.class).single()).isZero();
    try (Connection connection =
        java.sql.DriverManager.getConnection(
            Stack.DATABASE.getJdbcUrl(), "metis_app", Stack.APP_PASSWORD)) {
      JdbcClient same = JdbcClient.create(new SingleConnectionDataSource(connection, true));
      connection.setAutoCommit(false);
      same.sql("select set_config('app.tenant_id', :tenant, true)")
          .param("tenant", Seed.TENANT.id().toString())
          .query(String.class)
          .single();
      assertThat(same.sql("select count(*) from tenant").query(Integer.class).single()).isOne();
      connection.commit();
      assertThat(
              same.sql("select current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)")
                  .query(String.class)
                  .single())
          .isEmpty();
      assertThat(same.sql("select count(*) from tenant").query(Integer.class).single()).isZero();
    }
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 a transaction of a sign-in that names no person of the core sees no row")
  void aSignInWithoutAPerson() {
    SecurityContextHolder.getContext()
        .setAuthentication(new TestingAuthenticationToken("someone", null));
    List<String> seen =
        read.execute(status -> jdbc.sql("select name from tenant").query(String.class).list());
    assertThat(seen).isEmpty();
  }

  @Test
  void aReadOnlyTransactionCannotWriteInTheDatabase() {
    assertThatThrownBy(
            () ->
                read.execute(
                    status -> jdbc.sql("create temporary table scratch (id int)").update()))
        .hasMessageContaining("read-only transaction");
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.tenancy.internal;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;

import javax.sql.DataSource;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfigurations;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.runner.ApplicationContextRunner;
import org.springframework.boot.transaction.autoconfigure.TransactionManagerCustomizationAutoConfiguration;

class TenancyConfigurationTest {

  @Test
  void theSettingsOfSpringBootForATransactionManagerApplyToTheOneThatSetsTheTenant() {
    new ApplicationContextRunner()
        .withConfiguration(
            AutoConfigurations.of(TransactionManagerCustomizationAutoConfiguration.class))
        .withUserConfiguration(TenancyConfiguration.class)
        .withBean(DataSource.class, () -> mock(DataSource.class))
        .withPropertyValues(
            "spring.transaction.default-timeout=7s",
            "spring.transaction.rollback-on-commit-failure=true")
        .run(
            context -> {
              TenantTransactionManager manager = context.getBean(TenantTransactionManager.class);
              assertThat(manager.getDefaultTimeout()).isEqualTo(7);
              assertThat(manager.isRollbackOnCommitFailure()).isTrue();
            });
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.lint;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import dev.metis.tools.Facts;
import dev.metis.tools.TestContext;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class MarksTest {

  // The marks are built from pieces, so that this file holds none of its own.
  private static final String SUPPRESS = "@Suppress" + "Warnings";
  private static final String MUTATE = "@Do" + "NotMutate";
  private static final String GENERATED = "@Gene" + "rated";
  private static final String LANG = "lang-" + "exception:";

  @TempDir Path root;

  @BeforeEach
  void config() throws IOException {
    write("config/coverage-exclusions.txt", "# A class no test can run in process.\n");
    debt(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  }

  private void write(String path, String text) throws IOException {
    Files.createDirectories(root.resolve(path).getParent());
    Files.writeString(root.resolve(path), text);
  }

  private void debt(int... counts) throws IOException {
    write(
        "config/debt.json",
        """
        {"SuppressWarnings": %d, "DoNotMutate": %d, "Generated": %d, "lang-exception": %d,
         "coverage-exclusion": %d, "mutation-exclusion": %d}
        """
            .formatted(counts[0], counts[1], counts[2], counts[3], counts[4], counts[5]));
  }

  private TestContext lint() throws IOException {
    TestContext test = new TestContext(root);
    test.exit = Marks.command(test.context(), List.of());
    return test;
  }

  @Test
  void everyMarkWithItsReasonAndADebtThatHoldsItsCountIsClean() throws IOException {
    write(
        "core/A.java",
        "class A {\n  " + SUPPRESS + "(\"unused\") // read by reflection\n  int a;\n}\n");
    write(
        "core/B.java",
        "class B {\n  " + MUTATE + "(reason = \"no behaviour to observe\")\n  void b() {}\n}\n");
    write(
        "core/C.java",
        GENERATED
            + " // written by a generator\nclass C {\n  int c("
            + SUPPRESS
            + "(\"x\") int x) {"
            + " // read by reflection\n    return x;\n  }\n}\n");
    write("README.md", "<!-- " + LANG + " a native name -->\n");
    write(
        "config/coverage-exclusions.txt", "# Classes.\n\ndev.metis.tools.Main: the process edge\n");
    write(
        "config/mutation-exclusions.txt",
        "# Classes.\n\ndev.metis.core.*.internal.data.*: SQL only a database runs\n");
    debt(2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1);
    TestContext test = lint();
    assertThat(test.exit).isZero();
    assertThat(test.printed()).isEqualTo("lint: clean (7 marks)\n");
    assertThat(Facts.read(root, "lint")).hasValue("7 marks");
  }

  @Test
  void aMarkWithoutItsReasonIsAProblemOfItsLine() throws IOException {
    write(
        "core/A.java",
        "class A {\n  " + SUPPRESS + "(\"unused\")\n  int a;\n  " + SUPPRESS + "(\"x\") //  \n}\n");
    write("core/B.java", "class B {\n  " + MUTATE + "(reason = \" \")\n  void b() {}\n}\n");
    write("core/C.java", "class C {\n  int c(" + SUPPRESS + "(\"x\") int x) { return x; }\n}\n");
    write(
        "core/D.java",
        "@org.springframework.aot.generate" + GENERATED.substring(1) + "\nclass D {}\n");
    write("a.yml", "# " + LANG + "\n");
    write("config/coverage-exclusions.txt", "dev.metis.tools.Main\ndev.metis.tools.Other:\n");
    write("config/mutation-exclusions.txt", "dev.metis.core.*\n");
    debt(3, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1);
    TestContext test = lint();
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed().lines())
        .containsExactly(
            "a.yml:1: no-reason: # " + LANG,
            "config/coverage-exclusions.txt:1: no-reason: dev.metis.tools.Main",
            "config/coverage-exclusions.txt:2: no-reason: dev.metis.tools.Other:",
            "config/mutation-exclusions.txt:1: no-reason: dev.metis.core.*",
            "core/A.java:2: no-reason: " + SUPPRESS + "(\"unused\")",
            "core/A.java:4: no-reason: " + SUPPRESS + "(\"x\") //",
            "core/B.java:2: no-reason: " + MUTATE + "(reason = \" \")",
            "core/C.java:2: no-reason: int c(" + SUPPRESS + "(\"x\") int x) { return x; }",
            "core/D.java:1: no-reason: @org.springframework.aot.generate" + GENERATED.substring(1),
            "lint: 9 problems");
  }

  @Test
  void aCountAboveOrBelowItsDebtIsAProblemSoTheDebtFileChangesInTheSameChange() throws IOException {
    write(
        "core/A.java",
        "class A {\n  " + SUPPRESS + "(\"unused\") // read by reflection\n  int a;\n}\n");
    debt(0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    TestContext test = lint();
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed().lines())
        .containsExactly(
            "config/debt.json: debt-grew: 1 SuppressWarnings, the debt file holds 0",
            "config/debt.json: debt-shrank: 0 DoNotMutate, the debt file holds 1: lower it",
            "lint: 2 problems");
  }

  @Test
  void aMarkInAStringOrACommentIsNoMarkButAMentionOfTheLanguageMarkIsOne() throws IOException {
    write(
        "core/A.java",
        "class A {\n  String s = \""
            + SUPPRESS
            + "\"; // "
            + GENERATED
            + "\n  /* "
            + MUTATE
            + " */\n  String t = \"\"\"\n    "
            + SUPPRESS
            + "(\"x\")\n    \"\"\";\n}\n");
    write("settings.gradle.kts", "rootProject.name = \"x\"\n");
    write("build/C.java", SUPPRESS + "(\"x\")\n");
    write("Notes.kts", SUPPRESS + "(\"x\")\n" + MUTATE + "(reason = \" \")\n");
    write("notes.md", "Write a " + LANG + " reason on the line above.\n");
    Files.write(root.resolve("latin1.properties"), new byte[] {'#', ' ', (byte) 0xe9});
    debt(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    assertThat(lint().printed()).isEqualTo("lint: clean (1 marks)\n");
  }

  @Test
  void anExclusionListThatLeavesOutEveryProductionClassOfAProjectIsAProblem() throws IOException {
    write("core/src/main/java/dev/metis/core/A.java", "class A {}\n");
    write("core/src/main/java/dev/metis/core/B.java", "class B {}\n");
    write("core/src/main/java/dev/metis/core/package-info.java", "package dev.metis.core;\n");
    write("core/src/test/java/dev/metis/core/ATest.java", "class ATest {}\n");
    write("tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/Main.java", "class Main {}\n");
    write("tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/Cli.java", "class Cli {}\n");
    String some = "dev.metis.core.A: a reason\ndev.metis.tools.Main: a reason\n";
    write("config/coverage-exclusions.txt", some);
    debt(0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0);
    assertThat(lint().printed()).isEqualTo("lint: clean (2 marks)\n");
    write("config/coverage-exclusions.txt", some + "dev.metis.core.B: a reason\n");
    debt(0, 0, 0, 0, 3, 0);
    TestContext test = lint();
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed().lines())
        .containsExactly(
            "config/coverage-exclusions.txt: whole-project: every class of core is left out",
            "lint: 1 problems");
  }

  @Test
  void aDebtFileWithoutACountOfAKindIsAProblem() throws IOException {
    write("config/debt.json", "{\"SuppressWarnings\": 0}\n");
    TestContext test = lint();
    assertThat(test.exit).isEqualTo(1);
    assertThat(test.printed().lines())
        .containsExactly(
            "config/debt.json: no-count: DoNotMutate",
            "config/debt.json: no-count: Generated",
            "config/debt.json: no-count: lang-exception",
            "config/debt.json: no-count: coverage-exclusion",
            "config/debt.json: no-count: mutation-exclusion",
            "lint: 5 problems");
  }
}
```

`core/src/main/java/dev/metis/core/platform/tenancy/internal/TenantTransactionManager.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.tenancy.internal;

import dev.metis.core.platform.security.CurrentUser;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import javax.sql.DataSource;
import org.springframework.jdbc.support.JdbcTransactionManager;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.transaction.TransactionDefinition;

/** Sets the tenant of the current user as the first statement of every transaction. */
class TenantTransactionManager extends JdbcTransactionManager {

  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;

  // The third argument keeps the setting to this transaction, so a pooled connection keeps none.
  private static final String SET_TENANT = "select set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, true)";

  TenantTransactionManager(DataSource dataSource) {
    super(dataSource);
    // A read-only transaction is read-only in the database too, so a read cannot write.
    setEnforceReadOnly(true);
  }

  @Override
  protected void prepareTransactionalConnection(
      Connection connection, TransactionDefinition definition) throws SQLException {
    super.prepareTransactionalConnection(connection, definition);
    Authentication authentication = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
    if (authentication != null && authentication.getPrincipal() instanceof CurrentUser user) {
      try (PreparedStatement set = connection.prepareStatement(SET_TENANT)) {
        set.setString(1, user.tenant().toString());
        set.execute();
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.tenancy.internal;

import javax.sql.DataSource;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider;
import org.springframework.boot.transaction.autoconfigure.TransactionManagerCustomizers;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;

/** The transaction manager of the core, which sets the tenant of every transaction. */
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
class TenancyConfiguration {

  // Spring Boot's own manager backs off, so this one takes the settings Boot would have given it.
  @Bean
  TenantTransactionManager transactionManager(
      DataSource dataSource, ObjectProvider<TransactionManagerCustomizers> customizers) {
    TenantTransactionManager manager = new TenantTransactionManager(dataSource);
    customizers.ifAvailable(settings -> settings.customize(manager));
    return manager;
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.lint;

import static java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8;

import dev.metis.tools.Context;
import dev.metis.tools.Facts;
import dev.metis.tools.TextFiles;
import dev.metis.tools.language.Comments;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;

/** Every escape hatch gives its reason, and their counts equal the debt file, so none slips in. */
public final class Marks {

  static final List<String> KINDS =
      List.of(
          "SuppressWarnings",
          "DoNotMutate",
          "Generated",
          "lang-exception",
          "coverage-exclusion",
          "mutation-exclusion");

  private static final String DEBT = "config/debt.json";
  private static final String EXCLUSIONS = "config/coverage-exclusions.txt";
  private static final String MUTATION_EXCLUSIONS = "config/mutation-exclusions.txt";
  // Found anywhere in the code of a line, so a mark on a parameter or after a modifier counts too.
  private static final Pattern SUPPRESSED =
      Pattern.compile("@(?:java\\.lang\\.)?SuppressWarnings\\b");
  private static final Pattern UNMUTATED = Pattern.compile("@(?:[\\w$]+\\.)*\\w*DoNotMutate\\b");
  // JaCoCo leaves out what an annotation whose name holds Generated marks, and PIT CoverageIgnore.
  private static final Pattern GENERATED =
      Pattern.compile("@(?:[\\w$]+\\.)*(?:\\w*Generated\\w*|CoverageIgnore)\\b");
  // Built from pieces, so that this file holds no mark of its own.
  private static final String EXCUSED = "lang-" + "exception:";
  private static final Pattern COMMENT_REASON = Pattern.compile("//\\s*\\S");
  private static final Pattern MUTATION_REASON = Pattern.compile("reason\\s*=\\s*\"\\s*[^\\s\"]");
  private static final Pattern LANGUAGE_REASON = Pattern.compile(EXCUSED + "\\s*\\S");
  private static final Pattern EXCLUSION = Pattern.compile("^[\\w.$]+:\\s*\\S");
  // A pattern of PIT may stand for the classes of a package, in every module.
  private static final Pattern PATTERN_EXCLUSION = Pattern.compile("^[\\w.$*]+:\\s*\\S");
  // A class of a project: the folder of the project, then the path of the class in it.
  private static final Pattern PRODUCTION = Pattern.compile("(.+)/src/main/java/(.+)\\.java");

  private Marks() {}

  /** Checks every mark of the repository against its reason and its debt. */
  public static int command(Context context, List<String> args) throws IOException {
    Path root = context.root();
    PrintStream out = context.out();
    Map<String, Integer> counts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    KINDS.forEach(kind -> counts.put(kind, 0));
    List<String> problems = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Path> files = TextFiles.under(root, root);
    for (Path file : files) {
      String shown = root.relativize(file).toString();
      // Marks are plain ASCII, so a file in another encoding is read for them all the same; the
      // language check reports every file that is not UTF-8.
      List<String> lines = new String(Files.readAllBytes(file), UTF_8).lines().toList();
      List<String> code = Comments.javaCode(lines);
      for (int at = 0; at < lines.size(); at++) {
        String line = lines.get(at);
        for (Mark mark : marksOf(shown, line, code.get(at))) {
          counts.merge(mark.kind(), 1, Integer::sum);
          if (!mark.reasoned()) {
            problems.add(shown + ":" + (at + 1) + ": no-reason: " + line.strip());
          }
        }
      }
    }
    problems.addAll(wholeProjects(root, files));
    problems.addAll(debtProblems(root, counts));
    problems.forEach(out::println);
    int marks = counts.values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum();
    Facts.write(root, "lint", marks + " marks");
    out.println(
        problems.isEmpty()
            ? "lint: clean (" + marks + " marks)"
            : "lint: " + problems.size() + " problems");
    return problems.isEmpty() ? 0 : 1;
  }

  private record Mark(String kind, boolean reasoned) {}

  private static List<Mark> marksOf(String path, String line, String code) {
    List<Mark> marks = new ArrayList<>();
    if (path.endsWith(".java")) {
      boolean commented = COMMENT_REASON.matcher(line).find();
      boolean reasoned = MUTATION_REASON.matcher(line).find();
      SUPPRESSED
          .matcher(code)
          .results()
          .forEach(on -> marks.add(new Mark(KINDS.get(0), commented)));
      UNMUTATED.matcher(code).results().forEach(on -> marks.add(new Mark(KINDS.get(1), reasoned)));
      GENERATED.matcher(code).results().forEach(on -> marks.add(new Mark(KINDS.get(2), commented)));
    }
    if (line.contains(EXCUSED)) {
      marks.add(new Mark(KINDS.get(3), LANGUAGE_REASON.matcher(line).find()));
    }
    boolean listed = !line.isBlank() && !line.startsWith("#");
    if (path.equals(EXCLUSIONS) && listed) {
      marks.add(new Mark(KINDS.get(4), EXCLUSION.matcher(line).find()));
    }
    if (path.equals(MUTATION_EXCLUSIONS) && listed) {
      marks.add(new Mark(KINDS.get(5), PATTERN_EXCLUSION.matcher(line).find()));
    }
    return marks;
  }

  // Coverage and mutation testing measure nothing of a project whose every class the list leaves
  // out, so the list keeps one class of each project at least.
  private static List<String> wholeProjects(Path root, List<Path> files) throws IOException {
    Set<String> excluded = new HashSet<>();
    for (String line : Files.readAllLines(root.resolve(EXCLUSIONS))) {
      excluded.add(line.replaceFirst(":.*", "").strip());
    }
    Map<String, Set<String>> classes = new TreeMap<>();
    for (Path file : files) {
      Matcher production = PRODUCTION.matcher(root.relativize(file).toString());
      if (production.matches() && !production.group(2).endsWith("-info")) {
        classes
            .computeIfAbsent(production.group(1), project -> new HashSet<>())
            .add(production.group(2).replace('/', '.'));
      }
    }
    List<String> problems = new ArrayList<>();
    classes.forEach(
        (project, names) -> {
          if (excluded.containsAll(names)) {
            problems.add(
                EXCLUSIONS + ": whole-project: every class of " + project + " is left out");
          }
        });
    return problems;
  }

  private static List<String> debtProblems(Path root, Map<String, Integer> counts)
      throws IOException {
    JsonNode debt = JsonMapper.builder().build().readTree(Files.readString(root.resolve(DEBT)));
    List<String> problems = new ArrayList<>();
    counts.forEach(
        (kind, count) -> {
          JsonNode held = debt.path(kind);
          if (!held.isIntegralNumber()) {
            problems.add(DEBT + ": no-count: " + kind);
          } else if (count > held.intValue()) {
            problems.add(
                "%s: debt-grew: %d %s, the debt file holds %d"
                    .formatted(DEBT, count, kind, held.intValue()));
          } else if (count < held.intValue()) {
            problems.add(
                "%s: debt-shrank: %d %s, the debt file holds %d: lower it"
                    .formatted(DEBT, count, kind, held.intValue()));
          }
        });
    return problems;
  }
}
```

```kotlin
import net.ltgt.gradle.errorprone.errorprone
import java.util.Properties
import org.gradle.api.tasks.testing.logging.TestExceptionFormat

plugins {
    java
    jacoco
    checkstyle
    id("net.ltgt.errorprone")
    id("info.solidsoft.pitest")
}

val catalog = the<VersionCatalogsExtension>().named("libs")

// Half the cores, so that tests and mutation testing never take the whole machine.
val half = (Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors() / 2).coerceAtLeast(1)

java {
    toolchain {
        languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(25)
        vendor = JvmVendorSpec.AMAZON
    }
}

dependencyLocking {
    lockAllConfigurations()
    lockMode = LockMode.STRICT
}

// Resolving every configuration fails when a lock file or the checksums are not current.
tasks.register("resolveLocked") {
    description = "Resolves every configuration against the lock file and the checksums."
    val resolvable = configurations.filter { it.isCanBeResolved }.map { it.incoming.files }
    doLast {
        resolvable.forEach { it.files }
    }
}

// The tests of both projects share one guard against calls that leave the machine.
sourceSets.named("test") {
    java.srcDir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("test-support/java"))
    resources.srcDir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("test-support/resources"))
}

dependencies {
    implementation(platform(catalog.findLibrary("spring-boot-bom").get()))
    implementation(platform(catalog.findLibrary("jackson-bom").get()))
    constraints {
        for (tomcat in listOf("tomcat-embed-core", "tomcat-embed-el", "tomcat-embed-websocket")) {
            implementation(catalog.findLibrary(tomcat).get())
        }
    }
    compileOnly("org.jspecify:jspecify")
    testCompileOnly("org.jspecify:jspecify")
    errorprone(catalog.findLibrary("errorprone-core").get())
    errorprone(catalog.findLibrary("nullaway").get())
    testImplementation(platform(catalog.findLibrary("junit-bom").get()))
    testImplementation("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-api")
    testImplementation("org.assertj:assertj-core")
    testImplementation(catalog.findLibrary("archunit-junit6-api").get())
    testRuntimeOnly("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-engine")
    testRuntimeOnly(catalog.findLibrary("archunit-junit6-engine").get())
    testRuntimeOnly("org.junit.platform:junit-platform-launcher")
}

tasks.withType<JavaCompile>().configureEach {
    options.compilerArgs.addAll(listOf("-Xlint:all", "-Werror"))
    options.errorprone {
        error("UnusedVariable", "UnusedMethod", "UnusedNestedClass", "NullAway")
        option("NullAway:OnlyNullMarked", "true")
    }
}

// A new seed on every run, printed, so that a test that depends on another one shows, and the run can be repeated.
val testSeed = providers.gradleProperty("testSeed").getOrElse(System.nanoTime().toString())

tasks.withType<Test>().configureEach {
    useJUnitPlatform()
    maxParallelForks = half
    // Every check runs its tests anew and no old report stays; coverage pays by running them again.
    dependsOn("clean${name.replaceFirstChar(Char::uppercase)}")
    systemProperty("junit.jupiter.testclass.order.default", "org.junit.jupiter.api.ClassOrderer\$Random")
    systemProperty("junit.jupiter.testmethod.order.default", "org.junit.jupiter.api.MethodOrderer\$Random")
    systemProperty("junit.jupiter.execution.order.random.seed", testSeed)
    testLogging {
        exceptionFormat = TestExceptionFormat.FULL
    }
    doFirst {
        logger.lifecycle("Test order seed $testSeed: repeat it with -PtestSeed=$testSeed")
    }
}

// The architecture rules and the test of the settings run as test tasks of their own, for their checks.
tasks.test {
    useJUnitPlatform {
        excludeTags("architecture", "deadcode")
    }
}

tasks.register<Test>("architectureTest") {
    description = "Runs the architecture rules."
    testClassesDirs = sourceSets.test.get().output.classesDirs
    classpath = sourceSets.test.get().runtimeClasspath
    useJUnitPlatform {
        includeTags("architecture")
    }
}

jacoco {
    toolVersion = catalog.findVersion("jacoco").get().requiredVersion
}

// The classes of a list, each line a class or a pattern and its reason.
fun listed(file: String) =
    rootProject.file(file).readLines()
        .map { it.trim() }
        .filter { it.isNotEmpty() && !it.startsWith("#") }
        .map { it.substringBefore(":") }

// The classes no test can run in the test process, each with its reason in the list.
val excluded = listed("config/coverage-exclusions.txt")

// The classes only a database runs, which stay in coverage and out of mutation testing.
val unmutated = listed("config/mutation-exclusions.txt")

tasks.jacocoTestReport {
    // A report an earlier run left behind must not speak for a run whose report task did not run.
    dependsOn("cleanJacocoTestReport", tasks.test)
    classDirectories.setFrom(
        sourceSets.main.get().output.classesDirs.asFileTree.matching {
            exclude(excluded.map { it.replace('.', '/') + ".class" })
        },
    )
    reports {
        xml.required = true
    }
}

checkstyle {
    toolVersion = catalog.findVersion("checkstyle").get().requiredVersion
    configDirectory = rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("config/checkstyle")
}

// The classes to mutate come from the scope the tool writes before each run, so CI can mutate a change only.
val scope = rootProject.layout.buildDirectory.file("mutation/scope.properties")

fun scoped(): Set<String> {
    val read = Properties()
    scope.get().asFile.reader().use { read.load(it) }
    return read.getProperty(project.name, "").split(",").filter { it.isNotBlank() }.toSet()
}

pitest {
    pitestVersion = catalog.findVersion("pitest").get().requiredVersion
    junit5PluginVersion = catalog.findVersion("pitest-junit5").get().requiredVersion
    targetClasses = provider { scoped() }
    targetTests = setOf("dev.metis.${project.name}.*")
    excludedClasses = (excluded + unmutated).toSet()
    mutators = setOf("STRONGER")
    // Without a list of its own PIT spares every line that calls a logger; this one names nothing.
    avoidCallsTo = setOf("none")
    threads = half
    outputFormats = setOf("XML", "HTML")
    timestampedReports = false
    failWhenNoMutations = false
    excludedGroups = setOf("architecture", "deadcode")
}

tasks.named("pitest") {
    dependsOn(":tools:mutationScope")
    onlyIf("the scope holds classes of this project") { scoped().isNotEmpty() }
    // PIT writes no report for classes without a mutant, so the run leaves a trace for its judge.
    val ran = layout.buildDirectory.file("reports/pitest/ran")
    doLast {
        ran.get().asFile.writeText("PIT ran\n")
    }
    // A check runs PIT every time, as it runs its tests.
    outputs.upToDateWhen { false }
    outputs.cacheIf { false }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;

/** The counter-tests of the integration check. */
final class IntegrationCanaries {

  private static final String MIGRATION = "core/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__registry.sql";
  private static final String POLICY =
      """
      create policy tenant_rows on program
          using (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid);
      """;

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          // A table a migration left without its policy.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-no-policy",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every table forces row-level security")
              .replacing(MIGRATION, POLICY, ""),
          // A table whose policy does not bind its owner, which the API alone would not show.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-no-force",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every table forces row-level security")
              .replacing(MIGRATION, "alter table program force row level security;\n", ""),
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-no-tenant-column",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every table holds the tenant of its row")
              .appending(
                  MIGRATION, "\ncreate table canary (id uuid primary key default uuidv7());\n"),
          // The role of the API allowed to pass by every policy.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-bypassrls",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API is no superuser")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/postgres/roles.sh",
                  "create role metis_app login password",
                  "create role metis_app login bypassrls password"),
          // The role of the API made a member of the owner, whose rights it then holds.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-app-in-owner-role",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API is no superuser")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/postgres/roles.sh",
                  "alter database",
                  "grant metis_migrator to metis_app;\nalter database"),
          // A write granted to every role, which a list of the grants to the API does not show.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-public-write",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API may read")
              .appending(MIGRATION, "\ngrant insert on person to public;\n"),
          // A right on one column, which a list of the rights on tables does not show.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-column-grant",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API may read")
              .appending(MIGRATION, "\ngrant update (name) on tenant to metis_app;\n"),
          // A materialized view the API can read, which no policy guards and no grant list shows.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-readable-view",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every relation the API can read")
              .appending(
                  MIGRATION,
                  """

                  create materialized view canary as select name from tenant;
                  grant select on canary to metis_app;
                  """),
          // A changed stack under the seed of a green run, which a cached result would answer.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-stack-input",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API is no superuser")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/postgres/roles.sh",
                  "create role metis_app login password",
                  "create role metis_app login bypassrls password")
              .arguments("-PtestSeed=1"),
          // The tenant set for the session, so it outlives its transaction on a pooled connection.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-session-tenant",
                  "integration",
                  "TenantTransactionTest > TEN-02 the tenant of a transaction ends with it")
              .replacing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "platform/tenancy/internal/TenantTransactionManager.java",
                  "set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, true)",
                  "set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, false)"),
          // A read-only transaction left to the driver, which the tests tell to leave it alone.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-read-only",
                  "integration",
                  "TenantTransactionTest > aReadOnlyTransactionCannotWriteInTheDatabase")
              .replacing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "platform/tenancy/internal/TenantTransactionManager.java",
                  "    setEnforceReadOnly(true);\n",
                  ""),
          // A test deleted without lowering the floor, which only the exact floor notices.
          Canary.of("integration-floor", "integration", "update test-floor.json")
              .deleting("test-support/java/dev/metis/testsupport/LocalHostOnlyTest.java"),
          // A setting of the order lost, which the test of the order runs here too.
          Canary.of("integration-fixed-order", "integration", "TestOrderTest >")
              .replacing(
                  "build-logic/src/main/kotlin/metis.java-conventions.gradle.kts",
                  "    systemProperty(\"junit.jupiter.testmethod.order.default\","
                      + " \"org.junit.jupiter.api.MethodOrderer\\$Random\")\n",
                  ""),
          // An endpoint of the actuator more than health, which the API must not answer.
          Canary.of("integration-exposed-endpoint", "integration", "ProbesTest > theDiscoveryPage")
              .replacing(
                  "core/src/main/resources/application.yml",
                  "management:\n",
                  "management:\n  endpoints:\n    web:\n      exposure:\n        include: health,env\n"));

  private IntegrationCanaries() {}
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

/** The counter-tests of the lint check. */
final class LintCanaries {

  // Built from pieces, so that this file holds no mark of its own.
  private static final String SUPPRESS = "@Suppress" + "Warnings(\"unused\")";

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          // Ten branches over the one path of a method pass the ceiling of 10.
          Canary.of("lint-complexity", "lint", "[CyclomaticComplexity]")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryComplex.java",
                  classOf(
                      "CanaryComplex",
                      "  static int grade(int n) {\n"
                          + IntStream.range(0, 10)
                              .mapToObj(
                                  i ->
                                      "    if (n > %d) {\n      return %d;\n    }\n"
                                          .formatted(i, i))
                              .collect(Collectors.joining())
                          + "    return -1;\n  }\n")),
          // A file of 301 lines passes the ceiling of 300.
          Canary.of("lint-file-length", "lint", "[FileLength]")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryLong.java",
                  classOf(
                      "CanaryLong",
                      IntStream.range(0, 295)
                          .mapToObj(i -> "  static final int N%d = %d;\n".formatted(i, i))
                          .collect(Collectors.joining()))),
          Canary.of("lint-no-reason", "lint", "no-reason")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanarySuppressed.java",
                  classOf("CanarySuppressed", "  " + SUPPRESS + "\n  private int idle;\n")),
          // A mark with its reason still has to be counted in the debt file.
          Canary.of("lint-debt", "lint", "debt-grew")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryCounted.java",
                  classOf(
                      "CanaryCounted",
                      "  " + SUPPRESS + " // read by reflection\n  private int idle;\n")),
          // A mark on a parameter, which no line starts with.
          Canary.of("lint-parameter-suppression", "lint", "no-reason: static int twice(")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryParameter.java",
                  classOf(
                      "CanaryParameter",
                      "  static int twice("
                          + SUPPRESS
                          + " int number) {\n    return number * 2;\n  }\n")),
          // JaCoCo and PIT leave out a class so marked, so the mark is counted like the others.
          Canary.of("lint-generated", "lint", "debt-grew: 1 Generated")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryGenerated.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  @org.springframework.aot.generate.Generated
                  final class CanaryGenerated {
                    private CanaryGenerated() {}
                  }
                  """),
          // A mark in a package named like the record of ./verify, which only the root holds.
          Canary.of("lint-nested-reports", "lint", "reports/CanaryReports.java:6: no-reason")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "reports/CanaryReports.java",
                  classOf("CanaryReports", "  " + SUPPRESS + "\n  private int idle;\n")
                      .replace("package dev.metis.core;", "package dev.metis.core.reports;")),
          // A project whose every class the list leaves out, which would leave it unmeasured.
          Canary.of("lint-whole-project-excluded", "lint", "every class of extra is left out")
              .writing(
                  "extra/src/main/java/dev/metis/extra/Only.java",
                  "package dev.metis.extra;\n\nfinal class Only {}\n")
              .appending("config/coverage-exclusions.txt", "dev.metis.extra.Only: a canary\n"),
          Canary.of("lint-mutation-exclusion", "lint", "no-reason: dev.metis.core.CoreApplication")
              .appending("config/mutation-exclusions.txt", "dev.metis.core.CoreApplication\n"));

  private LintCanaries() {}

  // A class of the core with the body given, and a private constructor before it.
  private static String classOf(String name, String body) {
    return """
        package dev.metis.core;

        final class %s {
          private %s() {}

        %s}
        """
        .formatted(name, name, body);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;

/** The counter-tests of the mutation check. */
final class MutationCanaries {

  // The core and one package of the tool, which keeps a run of a counter-test short.
  private static final String SMALL = "-Pmutate=dev.metis.core.*,dev.metis.tools.canary.*";

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          // A test of the core that asserts nothing of the result, so PIT is seen to reach the
          // core.
          Canary.of("mutation-weak-test", "mutation", "SURVIVED dev.metis.core.CanaryWeak")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryWeak.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  final class CanaryWeak {
                    private CanaryWeak() {}

                    static int twice(int number) {
                      return number * 2;
                    }
                  }
                  """)
              .writing(
                  "core/src/test/java/dev/metis/core/CanaryWeakTest.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

                  import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

                  class CanaryWeakTest {
                    @Test
                    void runs() {
                      assertThat(CanaryWeak.twice(2)).isInstanceOf(Integer.class);
                    }
                  }
                  """)
              .arguments(SMALL),
          // A project of the scope whose PIT never ran, which must not count as one without
          // mutants.
          Canary.of("mutation-no-report", "mutation", "core: PIT did not run")
              .appending("core/build.gradle.kts", "\ntasks.named(\"pitest\") { enabled = false }\n")
              .arguments(SMALL),
          // Every class of the core left out of mutation testing, which would prove nothing of it.
          Canary.of("mutation-no-core-mutant", "mutation", "no mutant in core")
              .appending("config/mutation-exclusions.txt", "dev.metis.core.*: a canary\n")
              .arguments(SMALL));

  private MutationCanaries() {}
}
```

### Task 6: The shell of a workspace

The module `workspace` and `GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/shell`, WSP-02, WSP-06 and REG-03. The controller calls one use case, the transaction boundary, read only: the person the subject of the token names, or 403; the workspace the key names, or 404; the workspaces the person is a member of, in position order, or 403 when that one is not among them; the tree of portfolios, programs and projects of the workspace, in position order at each level, empty levels included. Pure functions of `domain` build the answer: the person, the tenant, the workspace by its key, the workspaces, the fixed sidebar of fifteen destinations in three groups with every badge `null`, the tree, and `notifications` 0. Each repository is a text block of SQL with named parameters and no decision, and every order by of a level ends with its key, so two equal positions keep one order. The integration tests read the shell over HTTP with signed tokens and every repository against real rows; the seed's positions give, at every level, the reverse of the order of names, ids and writes, so only the positions can give the order. The tests of a boundary walk one list, `Endpoints`, which a test holds to the handler mappings of the core: each endpoint with the ids of another tenant, with as many statements as a missing record, every line it logs, a defect whose message holds a value of a record included, and every case without a token, which is answered 401.

```kotlin
import java.time.Duration

plugins {
    id("metis.java-conventions")
    alias(libs.plugins.spring.boot)
    alias(libs.plugins.license.report)
}

// What the tests of both kinds share, such as the issuer of their tokens.
val shared = layout.projectDirectory.dir("src/testShared/java")
sourceSets.test {
    java.srcDir(shared)
}

// The tests on a real PostgreSQL and a real Keycloak, apart from the tests that need no container.
val integrationTest = sourceSets.create("integrationTest") {
    java.srcDir(shared)
    java.srcDir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("test-support/java"))
    // The architecture rules run with the unit tests alone, and need ArchUnit, which these lack.
    java.exclude("**/ArchitectureRules.java")
    resources.srcDir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("test-support/resources"))
    compileClasspath += sourceSets.main.get().output
    runtimeClasspath += sourceSets.main.get().output
}

// As the unit tests do, so the versions and the libraries of the core hold for them too.
configurations[integrationTest.implementationConfigurationName].extendsFrom(configurations.implementation.get())
configurations[integrationTest.runtimeOnlyConfigurationName].extendsFrom(configurations.runtimeOnly.get())

dependencies {
    implementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc")
    implementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-jdbc")
    implementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-flyway")
    implementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-security-oauth2-resource-server")
    implementation("org.slf4j:slf4j-api")
    implementation("tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind")
    runtimeOnly("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-actuator")
    runtimeOnly("org.flywaydb:flyway-database-postgresql")
    runtimeOnly("org.postgresql:postgresql")
    testImplementation(libs.archunit)
    testImplementation("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-params")
    testImplementation("org.mockito:mockito-core")
    testImplementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-security-test")
    testImplementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test")
    "integrationTestImplementation"(platform(libs.junit.bom))
    "integrationTestImplementation"("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-api")
    "integrationTestImplementation"("org.assertj:assertj-core")
    "integrationTestImplementation"("org.awaitility:awaitility")
    "integrationTestImplementation"("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-params")
    "integrationTestImplementation"("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test")
    "integrationTestImplementation"("org.testcontainers:testcontainers")
    "integrationTestImplementation"("org.testcontainers:testcontainers-postgresql")
    "integrationTestImplementation"("org.yaml:snakeyaml")
    "integrationTestImplementation"(libs.datasource.proxy)
    "integrationTestCompileOnly"("org.jspecify:jspecify")
    "integrationTestRuntimeOnly"("org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter-engine")
    "integrationTestRuntimeOnly"("org.junit.platform:junit-platform-launcher")
}

// Mockito joins each test JVM as an agent from the start, since the JDK will refuse a late one.
val mockitoAgent = configurations.create("mockitoAgent")
dependencies {
    mockitoAgent(platform(libs.spring.boot.bom))
    mockitoAgent("org.mockito:mockito-core") { isTransitive = false }
}
val agent = mockitoAgent.elements.map { "-javaagent:" + it.single().asFile.path }
tasks.withType<Test>().configureEach { jvmArgumentProviders.add(CommandLineArgumentProvider { listOf(agent.get()) }) }
pitest {
    jvmArgs.add(agent)
}

val integrationTestTask = tasks.register<Test>("integrationTest") {
    description = "Runs the tests on a real PostgreSQL and a real Keycloak."
    testClassesDirs = integrationTest.output.classesDirs
    classpath = integrationTest.runtimeClasspath
    // One JVM, so the containers and the contexts of Spring start once for every class.
    maxParallelForks = 1
    // The tests read the stack's own files, so the stack and the tests share one source.
    workingDir = rootDir
    // Those files are inputs, so a changed stack runs the tests again and no cached result stands in.
    inputs.dir(rootProject.layout.projectDirectory.dir("stack")).withPathSensitivity(PathSensitivity.RELATIVE)
    // A test that would wait for ever fails the check after this instead of holding it.
    timeout = Duration.ofMinutes(20)
}

// Coverage counts the lines both test tasks run, since only a database runs a repository.
tasks.jacocoTestReport {
    dependsOn(integrationTestTask)
    executionData(tasks.test.get(), integrationTestTask.get())
}

tasks.register<Test>("deadcodeTest") {
    description = "Runs the test that every setting of application.yml is one that something defines."
    testClassesDirs = sourceSets.test.get().output.classesDirs
    classpath = sourceSets.test.get().runtimeClasspath
    useJUnitPlatform {
        includeTags("deadcode")
    }
}

licenseReport {
    configurations = arrayOf("runtimeClasspath")
    filters = arrayOf(com.github.jk1.license.filter.SpdxLicenseBundleNormalizer())
    allowedLicensesFile = rootProject.file("config/allowed-licenses.json")
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class NavTest {

  private static List<String> codes(List<Nav.Item> items) {
    return items.stream().map(Nav.Item::code).toList();
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "WSP-06 the sidebar holds fifteen destinations in three groups, in the order the app draws")
  void theDestinations() {
    assertThat(codes(Nav.FIXED.home())).containsExactly("myFocus", "approvals");
    assertThat(codes(Nav.FIXED.portfolio()))
        .containsExactly(
            "cockpit",
            "dashboard",
            "registry",
            "roadmap",
            "capacity",
            "risk",
            "investment",
            "scenarios",
            "steerco",
            "copilot");
    assertThat(codes(Nav.FIXED.workspace())).containsExactly("frameworks", "templates", "settings");
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("WSP-06 no destination has a badge, and the four of a later release name it")
  void theBadgesAndTheReleases() {
    List<Nav.Item> all =
        Stream.of(Nav.FIXED.home(), Nav.FIXED.portfolio(), Nav.FIXED.workspace())
            .flatMap(List::stream)
            .toList();
    assertThat(all).allSatisfy(item -> assertThat(item.badge()).isNull());
    assertThat(all.stream().filter(item -> item.planned() != null))
        .extracting(Nav.Item::code, Nav.Item::planned)
        .containsExactly(
            org.assertj.core.groups.Tuple.tuple("investment", "V2"),
            org.assertj.core.groups.Tuple.tuple("scenarios", "V2"),
            org.assertj.core.groups.Tuple.tuple("steerco", "V2"),
            org.assertj.core.groups.Tuple.tuple("copilot", "V3"));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class ShellTest {

  private static final Person PERSON = new Person(UUID.randomUUID(), "Person", "PE", "Tenant");
  private static final Space HERE = new Space(UUID.randomUUID(), "here", "Here");
  private static final Space THERE = new Space(UUID.randomUUID(), "there", "There");

  private static Shell of(List<TreeRow> tree) {
    return Shell.of(PERSON, HERE, List.of(THERE, HERE), tree);
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "WSP-02 the shell names the person, the tenant, the workspace by its public id, and the workspaces in the order given")
  void thePersonTheTenantAndTheWorkspaces() {
    Shell shell = of(List.of());
    assertThat(shell.user()).isEqualTo(new Shell.User("Person", "PE"));
    assertThat(shell.tenant()).isEqualTo(new Shell.Tenant("Tenant"));
    assertThat(shell.workspace()).isEqualTo(new Shell.Place("here", "Here"));
    assertThat(shell.workspaces())
        .containsExactly(new Shell.Place("there", "There"), new Shell.Place("here", "Here"));
    assertThat(shell.nav()).isSameAs(Nav.FIXED);
    assertThat(shell.tree()).isEmpty();
    assertThat(shell.notifications()).isZero();
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "WSP-06 REG-03 the tree groups the projects under their programs and the programs under their portfolios, in the order of the rows")
  void theTree() {
    UUID empty = UUID.randomUUID();
    UUID full = UUID.randomUUID();
    UUID bare = UUID.randomUUID();
    UUID busy = UUID.randomUUID();
    List<TreeRow> rows =
        List.of(
            new TreeRow(empty, "Empty", null, null, null, null),
            new TreeRow(full, "Full", bare, "Bare", null, null),
            new TreeRow(full, "Full", busy, "Busy", "first", "First"),
            new TreeRow(full, "Full", busy, "Busy", "second", "Second"));
    assertThat(of(rows).tree())
        .containsExactly(
            new Shell.Portfolio("Empty", List.of()),
            new Shell.Portfolio(
                "Full",
                List.of(
                    new Shell.Program("Bare", List.of()),
                    new Shell.Program(
                        "Busy",
                        List.of(
                            new Shell.Project("first", "First"),
                            new Shell.Project("second", "Second"))))));
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "REG-03 two portfolios or programs of one name stay apart, since the rows name them by their keys")
  void namesNeedNotBeUnique() {
    UUID one = UUID.randomUUID();
    UUID two = UUID.randomUUID();
    UUID program = UUID.randomUUID();
    UUID twin = UUID.randomUUID();
    List<TreeRow> rows =
        List.of(
            new TreeRow(one, "Same", program, "Twin", "a", "A"),
            new TreeRow(one, "Same", twin, "Twin", "b", "B"),
            new TreeRow(two, "Same", null, null, null, null));
    assertThat(of(rows).tree())
        .extracting(Shell.Portfolio::name, portfolio -> portfolio.programs().size())
        .containsExactly(
            org.assertj.core.groups.Tuple.tuple("Same", 2),
            org.assertj.core.groups.Tuple.tuple("Same", 0));
  }
}
```

```java
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import dev.metis.core.platform.security.CurrentUser;
import dev.metis.core.platform.web.Forbidden;
import dev.metis.core.platform.web.NotFound;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data.People;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data.Trees;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data.Workspaces;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.Person;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.Shell;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.Space;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.TreeRow;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class ShellReaderTest {

  private static final CurrentUser USER = new CurrentUser("subject", UUID.randomUUID());
  private static final Person PERSON = new Person(UUID.randomUUID(), "Person", "PE", "Tenant");
  private static final Space WORKSPACE = new Space(UUID.randomUUID(), "here", "Here");
  private static final Space OTHER = new Space(UUID.randomUUID(), "there", "There");

  private final People people = mock(People.class);
  private final Workspaces workspaces = mock(Workspaces.class);
  private final Trees trees = mock(Trees.class);
  private final ShellReader reader = new ShellReader(people, workspaces, trees);

  @Test
  @DisplayName("WSP-02 a person the tenant does not know may not open a workspace")
  void anUnknownPerson() {
    when(people.bySubject(USER.subject())).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> reader.read(USER, WORKSPACE.key())).isInstanceOf(Forbidden.class);
    verifyNoInteractions(workspaces, trees);
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "WSP-02 TEN-02 a workspace the tenant does not have is missing, as one that does not exist")
  void aMissingWorkspace() {
    when(people.bySubject(USER.subject())).thenReturn(Optional.of(PERSON));
    when(workspaces.byKey(WORKSPACE.key())).thenReturn(Optional.empty());
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> reader.read(USER, WORKSPACE.key())).isInstanceOf(NotFound.class);
    verifyNoInteractions(trees);
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("WSP-02 a person who is no member of the workspace may not open it")
  void aPersonWhoIsNoMember() {
    when(people.bySubject(USER.subject())).thenReturn(Optional.of(PERSON));
    when(workspaces.byKey(WORKSPACE.key())).thenReturn(Optional.of(WORKSPACE));
    when(workspaces.of(PERSON.id())).thenReturn(List.of(OTHER));
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> reader.read(USER, WORKSPACE.key())).isInstanceOf(Forbidden.class);
    verifyNoInteractions(trees);
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "WSP-02 a member gets the shell of the workspace, with the workspaces the person is a member of")
  void aMember() {
    List<TreeRow> tree =
        List.of(new TreeRow(UUID.randomUUID(), "Portfolio", null, null, null, null));
    when(people.bySubject(USER.subject())).thenReturn(Optional.of(PERSON));
    when(workspaces.byKey(WORKSPACE.key())).thenReturn(Optional.of(WORKSPACE));
    when(workspaces.of(PERSON.id())).thenReturn(List.of(OTHER, WORKSPACE));
    when(trees.of(WORKSPACE.id())).thenReturn(tree);
    assertThat(reader.read(USER, WORKSPACE.key()))
        .isEqualTo(Shell.of(PERSON, WORKSPACE, List.of(OTHER, WORKSPACE), tree));
  }
}
```

```java
@WebLayerTest(ShellController.class)
class ShellControllerTest {

      new CurrentUser("subject", UUID.fromString("0b0e5a4e-7c5a-4f43-9d7e-1f2a3b4c5d6e"));

  @MockitoBean private ShellReader reader;

  ShellControllerTest(@Autowired MockMvcTester mvc) {

  private MvcTestResult get(String workspace) {
    return mvc.get()
        .uri("/workspaces/{workspaceId}/shell", workspace)
        .with(authentication(new TestingAuthenticationToken(USER, null, List.of())))
        .exchange();
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "WSP-02 WSP-06 REG-03 the shell is JSON with every field the app reads, and no cache keeps it")
  void theShellAsJson() throws Exception {
    UUID portfolio = UUID.randomUUID();
    Shell shell =
        Shell.of(
            new Person(UUID.randomUUID(), "Person", "PE", "Tenant"),
            new Space(UUID.randomUUID(), "here", "Here"),

    when(reader.read(USER, "here")).thenReturn(shell);
    MvcTestResult answer = get("here");
    assertThat(answer)
        .hasStatusOk()
        .hasContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
        .hasHeader(HttpHeaders.CACHE_CONTROL, "no-store");
    assertThat(answer.getResponse().getContentAsString(UTF_8))
        .isEqualTo(
            "{\"user\":{\"name\":\"Person\",\"initials\":\"PE\"},\"tenant\":{\"name\":\"Tenant\"},"
                + "\"workspace\":{\"id\":\"here\",\"name\":\"Here\"},"
                + "\"workspaces\":[{\"id\":\"here\",\"name\":\"Here\"}],"
                + "\"nav\":{\"home\":[{\"code\":\"myFocus\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":null},"
                + "{\"code\":\"approvals\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":null}],"
                + "\"portfolio\":[{\"code\":\"cockpit\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":null},"
                + "{\"code\":\"dashboard\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":null},"
                + "{\"code\":\"registry\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":null},"
                + "{\"code\":\"roadmap\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":null},"
                + "{\"code\":\"capacity\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":null},"
                + "{\"code\":\"risk\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":null},"
                + "{\"code\":\"investment\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":\"V2\"},"
                + "{\"code\":\"scenarios\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":\"V2\"},"
                + "{\"code\":\"steerco\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":\"V2\"},"
                + "{\"code\":\"copilot\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":\"V3\"}],"
                + "\"workspace\":[{\"code\":\"frameworks\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":null},"
                + "{\"code\":\"templates\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":null},"
                + "{\"code\":\"settings\",\"badge\":null,\"planned\":null}]},"
                + "\"tree\":[{\"name\":\"Portfolio\",\"programs\":[{\"name\":\"Program\","
                + "\"projects\":[{\"id\":\"project\",\"name\":\"Project\"}]}]}],"
                + "\"notifications\":0}");
  }

  @Test
  void anIdWithADotReachesTheUseCaseWhole() {
    when(reader.read(USER, "creative.studio")).thenThrow(new NotFound());
    assertThat(get("creative.studio")).hasStatus(404);
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("WSP-02 a person who may not open the workspace is answered 403")
  void forbidden() {
    when(reader.read(USER, "here")).thenThrow(new Forbidden());
    assertThat(get("here")).hasStatus(403).hasContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON);
  }

  @Test
  void aRequestWithoutATokenNeverReachesTheUseCase() {
    assertThat(mvc.get().uri("/workspaces/here/shell").exchange()).hasStatus(401);
    verifyNoInteractions(reader);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import static java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.jwt;

import dev.metis.core.WebLayerTest;
import dev.metis.core.platform.web.Forbidden;
import dev.metis.core.platform.web.NotFound;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;
import org.slf4j.MDC;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.CapturedOutput;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.OutputCaptureExtension;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;
import org.springframework.dao.DataAccessResourceFailureException;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.MockMvcTester;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.MvcTestResult;
import org.springframework.transaction.CannotCreateTransactionException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@WebLayerTest(ProblemAdviceTest.Failing.class)
@Import(ProblemAdviceTest.Failing.class)
@ExtendWith(OutputCaptureExtension.class)
class ProblemAdviceTest {

  private final MockMvcTester mvc;

  ProblemAdviceTest(@Autowired MockMvcTester mvc) {
    this.mvc = mvc;
  }

  /** Endpoints of the test, each failing in its own way. */
  @RestController
  static class Failing {

    @GetMapping("/test/not-found")
    String notFound() {
      throw new NotFound();
    }

    @GetMapping("/test/forbidden")
    String forbidden() {
      throw new Forbidden();
    }

    @GetMapping("/test/no-transaction")
    String noTransaction() {
      throw new CannotCreateTransactionException("no connection");
    }

    @GetMapping("/test/database-gone")
    String databaseGone() {
      throw new DataAccessResourceFailureException("gone");
    }

    @GetMapping("/test/defect")
    String defect() throws SQLException {
      throw new SQLException(
          "select secret from inside", new IllegalStateException("inner secret"));
    }
  }

  @ParameterizedTest
  @CsvSource({
    "/test/not-found, 404",
    "/test/forbidden, 403",
    "/test/no-transaction, 503",
    "/test/database-gone, 503",
    "/test/defect, 500",
    "/test/no-such-path, 404",
    "/error, 404"
  })
  void anErrorIsProblemDetailsWithItsKindAndTheIdOfTheRequestAndNothingInternal(
      String path, int status) throws Exception {
    MvcTestResult answer = mvc.get().uri(path).with(jwt()).exchange();
    assertThat(answer).hasStatus(status).hasContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON);
    Map<String, Object> body = bodyOf(answer);
    assertThat(body)
        .containsOnlyKeys("type", "title", "status", "kind", "correlationId")
        .containsEntry("status", status)
        .containsEntry("kind", Problems.kindOf(status));
    assertThat(String.valueOf(body.get("correlationId")))
        .matches("[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}");
    assertThat(answer.getResponse().getHeader(HttpHeaders.CACHE_CONTROL)).isEqualTo("no-store");
  }

  @Test
  void aMethodThePathDoesNotTakeIsAValidationError() throws Exception {
    MvcTestResult answer = mvc.post().uri("/test/defect").with(jwt()).exchange();
    assertThat(answer).hasStatus(405);
    assertThat(bodyOf(answer)).containsEntry("kind", "validation");
  }

  @Test
  void aDefectIsLoggedWithItsRequestByTheTypesAndFramesOfItsCausesAndNoMessage(
      CapturedOutput output) throws Exception {
    Object id = bodyOf(mvc.get().uri("/test/defect").with(jwt()).exchange()).get("correlationId");
    assertThat(output.getOut())
        .contains("a request failed: java.sql.SQLException")
        .contains("caused by java.lang.IllegalStateException")
        .contains("ProblemAdviceTest$Failing.defect")
        .contains("\"requestId\":\"" + id + "\"")
        .doesNotContain("select secret from inside")
        .doesNotContain("inner secret");
    assertThat(MDC.get(RequestFilter.LOG_KEY)).isNull();
  }

  @Test
  void aCauseThatLeadsBackIsWrittenOnce() {
    Exception first = new Exception("first");
    first.initCause(new Exception("second", first));
    assertThat(ProblemAdvice.trace(first).lines().filter(line -> !line.startsWith("\tat ")))
        .containsExactly("java.lang.Exception", "caused by java.lang.Exception");
  }

  @Test
  void aDatabaseThatCannotBeReachedIsLoggedByTheTypeOfItsFailureAlone(CapturedOutput output) {
    mvc.get().uri("/test/no-transaction").with(jwt()).exchange();
    assertThat(output.getOut())
        .contains(
            "the database cannot be reached: "
                + "org.springframework.transaction.CannotCreateTransactionException")
        .doesNotContain("no connection");
  }

  @Test
  void eachRequestHasAnIdOfItsOwn() throws Exception {
    Object first =
        bodyOf(mvc.get().uri("/test/no-such-path").with(jwt()).exchange()).get("correlationId");
    Object second =
        bodyOf(mvc.get().uri("/test/no-such-path").with(jwt()).exchange()).get("correlationId");
    assertThat(first).isNotEqualTo(second);
  }

  private static Map<String, Object> bodyOf(MvcTestResult answer) throws Exception {
    return JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser()
        .parseMap(answer.getResponse().getContentAsString(UTF_8));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import com.nimbusds.jose.JOSEException;
import com.nimbusds.jose.JWSAlgorithm;
import com.nimbusds.jose.JWSHeader;
import com.nimbusds.jose.crypto.RSASSASigner;
import com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.JWKSet;
import com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.RSAKey;
import com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.gen.RSAKeyGenerator;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.JWTClaimsSet;
import com.nimbusds.jwt.SignedJWT;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpHandler;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Date;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;

/** An issuer of signed tokens on this machine, which serves its key as Keycloak does. */
public final class TestIssuer {

  /** The date the clock of the core is fixed at in the tests, which no token follows. */
  public static final Instant NOW = Instant.parse("2026-09-22T03:00:00Z");

  // The key the issuer signs with and serves.
  private static final RSAKey KEY = key();

  /** The address of the issuer, which the core finds its keys from. */
  public static final String ISSUER = start();

  private TestIssuer() {}

  /** The claims of a token of the issuer for the core, valid from now for five minutes. */
  public static JWTClaimsSet.Builder claims(String subject, @Nullable Object tenant) {
    Instant issued = Instant.now();
    return new JWTClaimsSet.Builder()
        .issuer(ISSUER)
        .audience("metis-core")
        .subject(subject)
        .claim("tenant_id", tenant)
        .issueTime(Date.from(issued))
        .expirationTime(Date.from(issued.plusSeconds(300)));
  }

  /** A token signed with the key of the issuer. */
  public static String token(JWTClaimsSet.Builder claims) {
    return signed(KEY, claims);
  }

  /** A token for the subject in the tenant, as the issuer signs it. */
  public static String token(String subject, Object tenant) {
    return token(claims(subject, tenant));
  }

  /** A token signed with the key given. */
  public static String signed(RSAKey key, JWTClaimsSet.Builder claims) {
    try {
      SignedJWT jwt =
          new SignedJWT(
              new JWSHeader.Builder(JWSAlgorithm.RS256).keyID(key.getKeyID()).build(),
              claims.build());
      jwt.sign(new RSASSASigner(key));
      return jwt.serialize();
    } catch (JOSEException unsigned) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(unsigned);
    }
  }

  /** A new key of the same id, which the issuer never serves. */
  public static RSAKey key() {
    try {
      return new RSAKeyGenerator(2048).keyID("test").generate();
    } catch (JOSEException ungenerated) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(ungenerated);
    }
  }

  private static String start() {
    try {
      HttpServer server =
          HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress(), 0), 0);
      String issuer = "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort() + "/issuer";
      server.createContext(
          "/issuer/.well-known/openid-configuration",
          answer("{\"issuer\":\"" + issuer + "\",\"jwks_uri\":\"" + issuer + "/keys\"}"));
      server.createContext("/issuer/keys", answer(new JWKSet(KEY.toPublicJWK()).toString()));
      server.start();
      return issuer;
    } catch (IOException unstarted) {
      throw new UncheckedIOException(unstarted);
    }
  }

  private static HttpHandler answer(String json) {
    byte[] body = json.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    return exchange -> {
      exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", "application/json");
      exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, body.length);
      try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) {
        out.write(body);
      }
    };
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import javax.sql.DataSource;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.BeanPostProcessor;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistrar;

/** The core of an API test: the shared database as the role of the API, the test issuer, NOW. */
@TestConfiguration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
class Api {

  @Bean
  static DynamicPropertyRegistrar stack() {
    Seed.write();
    return registry -> {
      registry.add("spring.datasource.url", () -> Stack.url(Stack.DATABASE));
      registry.add("spring.datasource.username", () -> "metis_app");
      registry.add("spring.datasource.password", () -> Stack.APP_PASSWORD);
      registry.add("metis.security.issuer", () -> TestIssuer.ISSUER);
      registry.add("metis.time.fixed", TestIssuer.NOW::toString);
    };
  }

  @Bean
  static Statements statements() {
    return new Statements();
  }

  @Bean
  static BeanPostProcessor countStatements(Statements statements) {
    return new BeanPostProcessor() {
      @Override
      public Object postProcessAfterInitialization(Object bean, String name) {
        return bean instanceof DataSource dataSource ? statements.counting(dataSource) : bean;
      }
    };
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import javax.sql.DataSource;
import net.ttddyy.dsproxy.ExecutionInfo;
import net.ttddyy.dsproxy.QueryInfo;
import net.ttddyy.dsproxy.listener.QueryExecutionListener;
import net.ttddyy.dsproxy.support.ProxyDataSourceBuilder;

/** Counts the statements the core sends to the database, on every thread. */
final class Statements implements QueryExecutionListener {

  private final AtomicInteger count = new AtomicInteger();

  /** The data source given, whose statements this counts. */
  DataSource counting(DataSource dataSource) {
    return ProxyDataSourceBuilder.create(dataSource).listener(this).build();
  }

  /** The statements sent since the last call. */
  int take() {
    return count.getAndSet(0);
  }

  @Override
  public void beforeQuery(ExecutionInfo execution, List<QueryInfo> queries) {}

  @Override
  public void afterQuery(ExecutionInfo execution, List<QueryInfo> queries) {
    count.addAndGet(queries.size());
  }
}
```
