```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.boot.test.web.server.LocalServerPort;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client.EntityExchangeResult;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client.RestTestClient;

@ApiTest
class ShellApiTest {

  private final RestTestClient client;
  private final Statements statements;
  private final int port;

  ShellApiTest(
      @Autowired RestTestClient client,
      @Autowired Statements statements,
      @LocalServerPort int port) {
    this.client = client;
    this.statements = statements;
    this.port = port;
  }

  private EntityExchangeResult<String> shell(String workspace, String bearer) {
    return client
        .get()
        .uri("/workspaces/{workspaceId}/shell", workspace)
        .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, bearer)
        .exchange()
        .expectBody(String.class)
        .returnResult();
  }

  private static Map<String, Object> place(Seed.Workspace workspace) {
    return Map.of("id", workspace.key(), "name", workspace.name());
  }

  private static Map<String, Object> bodyOf(EntityExchangeResult<String> answer) {
    return JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser().parseMap(String.valueOf(answer.getResponseBody()));
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "WSP-02 WSP-06 REG-03 a member reads the shell: the person, the tenant, the workspaces in position order and the tree")
  void aMember() {
    EntityExchangeResult<String> answer = shell(Seed.ALPHA.key(), Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER));
    assertThat(answer.getStatus().value()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(answer.getResponseHeaders().getCacheControl()).isEqualTo("no-store");
    assertThat(answer.getResponseHeaders().get(HttpHeaders.SET_COOKIE)).isNull();
    Map<String, Object> shell = bodyOf(answer);
    assertThat(shell)
        .containsEntry(
            "user", Map.of("name", Seed.MEMBER.name(), "initials", Seed.MEMBER.initials()))
        .containsEntry("tenant", Map.of("name", Seed.TENANT.name()))
        .containsEntry("workspace", place(Seed.ALPHA))
        .containsEntry("workspaces", List.of(place(Seed.BETA), place(Seed.ALPHA)))
        .containsEntry("notifications", 0)
        .containsEntry(
            "tree",
            List.of(
                Map.of(
                    "name",
                    Seed.PORTFOLIO.name(),
                    "programs",
                    List.of(
                        Map.of(
                            "name",
                            Seed.PROGRAM.name(),
                            "projects",
                            List.of(
                                Map.of("id", Seed.SOONER.key(), "name", Seed.SOONER.name()),
                                Map.of("id", Seed.LATER.key(), "name", Seed.LATER.name()))),
                        Map.of("name", Seed.EMPTY_PROGRAM.name(), "projects", List.of()))),
                Map.of("name", Seed.EMPTY_PORTFOLIO.name(), "programs", List.of())));
    assertThat(shell)
        .extractingByKey("nav")
        .asInstanceOf(org.assertj.core.api.InstanceOfAssertFactories.MAP)
        .containsOnlyKeys("home", "portfolio", "workspace");
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 a key that two tenants use opens the workspace of the tenant of the token")
  void aKeyOfTwoTenants() {
    assertThat(bodyOf(shell(Seed.ALPHA.key(), Seed.bearer(Seed.RIVAL))))
        .containsEntry("workspace", place(Seed.RIVAL_ALPHA))
        .containsEntry("tenant", Map.of("name", Seed.OTHER_TENANT.name()));
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("WSP-02 a person who is no member of the workspace is answered 403")
  void aPersonWhoIsNoMember() {
    EntityExchangeResult<String> answer = shell(Seed.ALPHA.key(), Seed.bearer(Seed.OUTSIDER));
    assertThat(answer.getStatus().value()).isEqualTo(403);
    assertThat(bodyOf(answer)).containsEntry("kind", "forbidden");
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("WSP-02 a person the tenant does not know is answered 403")
  void aPersonTheTenantDoesNotKnow() {
    String stranger = "Bearer " + TestIssuer.token("stranger", Seed.TENANT.id().toString());
    assertThat(shell(Seed.ALPHA.key(), stranger).getStatus().value()).isEqualTo(403);
    String elsewhere =
        "Bearer " + TestIssuer.token(Seed.MEMBER.subject(), Seed.OTHER_TENANT.id().toString());
    assertThat(shell(Seed.ALPHA.key(), elsewhere).getStatus().value()).isEqualTo(403);
  }

  @Test
  void aWorkspaceNoTenantHasIsAnswered404() {
    EntityExchangeResult<String> answer = shell("no-such-workspace", Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER));
    assertThat(answer.getStatus().value()).isEqualTo(404);
    assertThat(bodyOf(answer)).containsEntry("kind", "notFound");
  }

  @Test
  void anIdWithADotIsAKeyLikeAnyOther() {
    assertThat(shell("alpha.m4rk", Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER)).getStatus().value()).isEqualTo(404);
  }

  // Encoded here, so neither the client nor the server reads it as a slash of the path.
  @Test
  void anIdWithAnEncodedSlashIsRefusedAsAValidationError() throws Exception {
    URI path = URI.create("http://localhost:" + port + "/workspaces/a%2Fb/shell");
    HttpRequest request =
        HttpRequest.newBuilder(path)
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER))
            .build();
    try (HttpClient http = HttpClient.newHttpClient()) {
      HttpResponse<String> answer = http.send(request, BodyHandlers.ofString());
      assertThat(answer.statusCode()).isEqualTo(400);
      assertThat(answer.headers().firstValue(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_TYPE))
          .contains("application/problem+json");
      assertThat(answer.headers().firstValue(HttpHeaders.CACHE_CONTROL)).contains("no-store");
      assertThat(JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser().parseMap(answer.body()))
          .containsEntry("kind", "validation");
    }
  }

  @Test
  void theShellIsReadWithTheSameNumberOfStatementsWhateverTheSizeOfTheTree() {
    statements.take();
    shell(Seed.ALPHA.key(), Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER));
    int large = statements.take();
    shell(Seed.BETA.key(), Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER));
    assertThat(statements.take()).isEqualTo(large).isEqualTo(6);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import dev.metis.core.platform.security.CurrentUser;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data.People;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data.Trees;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data.Workspaces;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.Person;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.Space;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.TreeRow;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.TestingAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;

@ApiTest
class RepositoriesTest {

  private final TransactionTemplate read;
  private final People people;
  private final Workspaces workspaces;
  private final Trees trees;

  RepositoriesTest(
      @Autowired PlatformTransactionManager manager,
      @Autowired People people,
      @Autowired Workspaces workspaces,
      @Autowired Trees trees) {
    this.read = new TransactionTemplate(manager);
    this.read.setReadOnly(true);
    this.people = people;
    this.workspaces = workspaces;
    this.trees = trees;
  }

  @AfterEach
  void forgetTheUser() {
    SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
  }

  // A repository runs in the transaction of a use case, for the tenant of its user.
  private <T> T asMemberOf(Seed.Tenant tenant, Supplier<T> query) {
    CurrentUser user = new CurrentUser("any", tenant.id());
    SecurityContextHolder.getContext()
        .setAuthentication(new TestingAuthenticationToken(user, null));
    return java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(read.execute(status -> query.get()));
  }

  private static Space space(Seed.Workspace workspace) {
    return new Space(workspace.id(), workspace.key(), workspace.name());
  }

  @Test
  void aPersonIsFoundByTheSubjectOfTheTokenWithTheNameOfTheTenant() {
    assertThat(asMemberOf(Seed.TENANT, () -> people.bySubject(Seed.MEMBER.subject())))
        .contains(
            new Person(
                Seed.MEMBER.id(), Seed.MEMBER.name(), Seed.MEMBER.initials(), Seed.TENANT.name()));
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 a person, a workspace or a tree of another tenant is never found")
  void anotherTenant() {
    assertThat(asMemberOf(Seed.TENANT, () -> people.bySubject(Seed.RIVAL.subject()))).isEmpty();
    assertThat(asMemberOf(Seed.TENANT, () -> workspaces.byKey(Seed.DELTA.key()))).isEmpty();
    assertThat(asMemberOf(Seed.TENANT, () -> workspaces.of(Seed.RIVAL.id()))).isEmpty();
    assertThat(asMemberOf(Seed.OTHER_TENANT, () -> trees.of(Seed.ALPHA.id()))).isEmpty();
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "WSP-02 a workspace is found by its key, and the workspaces of a person come in position order")
  void theWorkspaces() {
    assertThat(asMemberOf(Seed.TENANT, () -> workspaces.byKey(Seed.ALPHA.key())))
        .contains(space(Seed.ALPHA));
    assertThat(asMemberOf(Seed.TENANT, () -> workspaces.of(Seed.MEMBER.id())))
        .containsExactly(space(Seed.BETA), space(Seed.ALPHA));
    assertThat(asMemberOf(Seed.TENANT, () -> workspaces.of(Seed.OUTSIDER.id())))
        .containsExactly(space(Seed.BETA));
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "WSP-06 REG-03 the tree of a workspace comes in position order at each level, its empty levels included")
  void theTree() {
    assertThat(asMemberOf(Seed.TENANT, () -> trees.of(Seed.ALPHA.id())))
        .containsExactly(
            new TreeRow(
                Seed.PORTFOLIO.id(),
                Seed.PORTFOLIO.name(),
                Seed.PROGRAM.id(),
                Seed.PROGRAM.name(),
                Seed.SOONER.key(),
                Seed.SOONER.name()),
            new TreeRow(
                Seed.PORTFOLIO.id(),
                Seed.PORTFOLIO.name(),
                Seed.PROGRAM.id(),
                Seed.PROGRAM.name(),
                Seed.LATER.key(),
                Seed.LATER.name()),
            new TreeRow(
                Seed.PORTFOLIO.id(),
                Seed.PORTFOLIO.name(),
                Seed.EMPTY_PROGRAM.id(),
                Seed.EMPTY_PROGRAM.name(),
                null,
                null),
            new TreeRow(
                Seed.EMPTY_PORTFOLIO.id(), Seed.EMPTY_PORTFOLIO.name(), null, null, null, null));
    assertThat(asMemberOf(Seed.TENANT, () -> trees.of(Seed.BETA.id()))).isEmpty();
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/** Every endpoint of the core with its cases, which each test of a boundary walks. */
final class Endpoints {

  /** A path that names a record of the other tenant, and a missing path it must answer as. */
  record Foreign(String path, String missing) {}

  /** An endpoint by its pattern: a path a member reads, and the cases of another tenant. */
  record Endpoint(String pattern, String readable, List<Foreign> foreign) {

    /** Every path of the cases, the readable one first. */
    List<String> paths() {
      List<String> paths = new ArrayList<>(List.of(readable));
      foreign.forEach(each -> paths.addAll(List.of(each.path(), each.missing())));
      return paths;
    }
  }

  /** The endpoints; one without its entry fails the test that holds this list to the core. */
  static final List<Endpoint> ALL =
      List.of(
          new Endpoint(
              "/workspaces/{workspaceId}/shell",
              "/workspaces/" + Seed.ALPHA.key() + "/shell",
              List.of(
                  new Foreign(
                      "/workspaces/" + Seed.DELTA.key() + "/shell",
                      "/workspaces/no-such-key/shell"))));

  private Endpoints() {}
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client.EntityExchangeResult;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client.RestTestClient;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.RequestMappingHandlerMapping;

@ApiTest
class CrossTenantTest {

  /** One answer: its status, its body without the id of the request, its statements. */
  record Answer(int status, Map<String, Object> body, int statements) {}

  private final RestTestClient client;
  private final Statements statements;
  private final RequestMappingHandlerMapping mappings;

  CrossTenantTest(
      @Autowired RestTestClient client,
      @Autowired Statements statements,
      @Autowired @Qualifier("requestMappingHandlerMapping") RequestMappingHandlerMapping mappings) {
    this.client = client;
    this.statements = statements;
    this.mappings = mappings;
  }

  private Answer call(String path) {
    statements.take();
    EntityExchangeResult<String> answer =
        client
            .get()
            .uri(path)
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER))
            .exchange()
            .expectBody(String.class)
            .returnResult();
    Map<String, Object> body =
        new TreeMap<>(
            JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser().parseMap(String.valueOf(answer.getResponseBody())));
    body.remove("correlationId");
    return new Answer(answer.getStatus().value(), body, statements.take());
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 every endpoint of the core has its cases in the list the boundary tests walk")
  void everyEndpointHasItsCases() {
    Set<String> patterns =
        mappings.getHandlerMethods().entrySet().stream()
            // A controller of the core, in its root package or below; the tests' own are left out.
            .filter(entry -> entry.getValue().getBeanType().getName().startsWith("dev.metis.core"))
            .filter(entry -> entry.getValue().getBeanType() != TestEndpoints.class)
            .flatMap(entry -> entry.getKey().getPatternValues().stream())
            // The error page answers for the other endpoints, whose cases stand for it.
            .filter(pattern -> !pattern.equals("/error"))
            .collect(Collectors.toSet());
    assertThat(patterns)
        .isEqualTo(
            Endpoints.ALL.stream().map(Endpoints.Endpoint::pattern).collect(Collectors.toSet()));
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 every endpoint called with the ids of another tenant answers as for a missing record, with as many statements")
  void aForeignRecordIsAMissingOne() {
    for (Endpoints.Endpoint endpoint : Endpoints.ALL) {
      // The endpoint answers its member, so a 404 below is the answer to the other tenant's id.
      assertThat(call(endpoint.readable()).status()).as(endpoint.pattern()).isEqualTo(200);
      for (Endpoints.Foreign foreign : endpoint.foreign()) {
        Answer theirs = call(foreign.path());
        Answer missing = call(foreign.missing());
        assertThat(theirs.status()).as(foreign.path()).isEqualTo(404).isEqualTo(missing.status());
        assertThat(theirs.body()).as(foreign.path()).isEqualTo(missing.body());
        assertThat(theirs.statements()).as(foreign.path()).isEqualTo(missing.statements());
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import com.nimbusds.jwt.PlainJWT;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client.EntityExchangeResult;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client.RestTestClient;

@ApiTest
class TokenTest {

  private final RestTestClient client;

  TokenTest(@Autowired RestTestClient client) {
    this.client = client;
  }

  private int status(String token) {
    return client
        .get()
        .uri("/workspaces/{workspaceId}/shell", Seed.ALPHA.key())
        .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + token)
        .exchange()
        .returnResult()
        .getStatus()
        .value();
  }

  private static com.nimbusds.jwt.JWTClaimsSet.Builder member() {
    return TestIssuer.claims(Seed.MEMBER.subject(), Seed.TENANT.id().toString());
  }

  @Test
  void aTokenOfTheIssuerOpensTheShellAndARequestWithoutOneIsAnswered401() {
    assertThat(status(TestIssuer.token(member()))).isEqualTo(200);
    client
        .get()
        .uri("/workspaces/{workspaceId}/shell", Seed.ALPHA.key())
        .exchange()
        .expectStatus()
        .isUnauthorized()
        .expectHeader()
        .valueMatches(HttpHeaders.WWW_AUTHENTICATE, "Bearer.*");
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName("TEN-02 every case of every endpoint of the core is answered 401 without a token")
  void everyEndpointWithoutATokenIsAnswered401() {
    for (Endpoints.Endpoint endpoint : Endpoints.ALL) {
      for (String path : endpoint.paths()) {
        EntityExchangeResult<String> answer =
            client.get().uri(path).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();
        assertThat(answer.getStatus().value()).as(path).isEqualTo(401);
        assertThat(
                JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser()
                    .parseMap(String.valueOf(answer.getResponseBody())))
            .as(path)
            .containsEntry("kind", "unauthenticated");
      }
    }
  }

  // The date of the core is fixed in the past, and a token follows the time of the machine.
  @Test
  void aTokenExpiredByTheTimeOfTheMachineIsAnswered401() {
    Instant then = Instant.now().minusSeconds(3600);
    assertThat(
            status(
                TestIssuer.token(
                    member()
                        .issueTime(Date.from(then))
                        .expirationTime(Date.from(then.plusSeconds(300))))))
        .isEqualTo(401);
  }

  @Test
  void aTokenOfAnotherIssuerOrForAnotherAudienceIsAnswered401() {
    assertThat(status(TestIssuer.token(member().issuer("http://127.0.0.1:9/other"))))
        .isEqualTo(401);
    assertThat(status(TestIssuer.token(member().audience("another-service")))).isEqualTo(401);
  }

  @Test
  void aTokenSignedWithAnotherKeyOrNotSignedIsAnswered401() {
    assertThat(status(TestIssuer.signed(TestIssuer.key(), member()))).isEqualTo(401);
    assertThat(status(new PlainJWT(member().build()).serialize())).isEqualTo(401);
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 a token without a tenant, with two, or with one that is not a UUID is answered 401")
  void theTenantOfTheToken() {
    assertThat(status(TestIssuer.token(TestIssuer.claims(Seed.MEMBER.subject(), null))))
        .isEqualTo(401);
    List<String> two = List.of(Seed.TENANT.id().toString(), Seed.OTHER_TENANT.id().toString());
    assertThat(status(TestIssuer.token(TestIssuer.claims(Seed.MEMBER.subject(), two))))
        .isEqualTo(401);
    assertThat(status(TestIssuer.token(TestIssuer.claims(Seed.MEMBER.subject(), "tenant-one"))))
        .isEqualTo(401);
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.CapturedOutput;
import org.springframework.boot.test.system.OutputCaptureExtension;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.client.RestTestClient;

@ApiTest
@ExtendWith(OutputCaptureExtension.class)
class LogTest {

  private final RestTestClient client;

  LogTest(@Autowired RestTestClient client) {
    this.client = client;
  }

  private void call(String path, Seed.Person person) {
    client.get().uri(path).header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, Seed.bearer(person)).exchange();
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 every line of a request carries its id and the tenant of its user, and no value of a record")
  void theLinesOfARequest(CapturedOutput output) {
    // The core has started before the test runs; what follows is the lines of the requests.
    int before = output.getOut().length();
    int beforeAll = output.getAll().length();
    int requests = 0;
    for (Endpoints.Endpoint endpoint : Endpoints.ALL) {
      for (String path : endpoint.paths()) {
        call(path, Seed.MEMBER);
        requests++;
      }
      for (Endpoints.Foreign foreign : endpoint.foreign()) {
        call(foreign.missing(), Seed.RIVAL);
        requests++;
      }
    }
    // A defect whose message holds a value of a record, which its line must not repeat.
    call(TestEndpoints.FAIL, Seed.MEMBER);
    List<Map<String, Object>> lines =
        output
            .getOut()
            .substring(before)
            .lines()
            .map(JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser()::parseMap)
            .toList();
    assertThat(lines).allSatisfy(line -> assertThat(line).containsKeys("requestId", "tenantId"));
    assertThat(lines)
        .extracting(line -> line.get("tenantId"))
        .containsOnly(Seed.TENANT.id().toString(), Seed.OTHER_TENANT.id().toString())
        .contains(Seed.OTHER_TENANT.id().toString());
    List<Map<String, Object>> served =
        lines.stream().filter(line -> message(line).startsWith("served ")).toList();
    assertThat(served).hasSize(requests + 1);
    assertThat(served).extracting(line -> line.get("requestId")).doesNotHaveDuplicates();
    assertThat(lines).filteredOn(line -> message(line).startsWith("a request failed: ")).hasSize(1);
    assertThat(output.getAll().substring(beforeAll)).doesNotContain(Seed.MARK);
  }

  private static String message(Map<String, Object> line) {
    return String.valueOf(line.get("message"));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers;
import java.util.Arrays;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.context.ConfigurableApplicationContext;
import org.testcontainers.postgresql.PostgreSQLContainer;

class FailureTest {

  private static HttpResponse<String> get(
      ConfigurableApplicationContext api, String path, String bearer) throws Exception {
    int port = api.getEnvironment().getRequiredProperty("local.server.port", Integer.class);
    HttpRequest request =
        HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create("http://localhost:" + port + path))
            .header("Authorization", bearer)
            .build();
    try (HttpClient http = HttpClient.newHttpClient()) {
      return http.send(request, BodyHandlers.ofString());
    }
  }

  @Test
  void whenTheDatabaseIsGoneTheCoreIsNotReadyButAliveAndAReadIsAnswered503() throws Exception {
    Seed.write();
    try (PostgreSQLContainer own = Stack.migrated(Stack.database())) {
      String[] given = Stack.api(own, TestIssuer.ISSUER);
      String[] arguments = Arrays.copyOf(given, given.length + 1);
      // A request waits a second for a connection, so the test does not wait for half a minute.
      arguments[given.length] = "--spring.datasource.hikari.connection-timeout=1000";
      try (ConfigurableApplicationContext api =
          SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, arguments)) {
        String member = Seed.bearer(Seed.MEMBER);
        assertThat(get(api, "/actuator/health/readiness", member).statusCode()).isEqualTo(200);
        own.stop();
        assertThat(get(api, "/actuator/health/readiness", member).body())
            .isEqualTo("{\"status\":\"DOWN\"}");
        assertThat(get(api, "/actuator/health/liveness", member).body())
            .isEqualTo("{\"status\":\"UP\"}");
        HttpResponse<String> read = get(api, "/workspaces/" + Seed.ALPHA.key() + "/shell", member);
        assertThat(read.statusCode()).isEqualTo(503);
        assertThat(read.body()).contains("\"kind\":\"unavailable\"");
      }
    }
  }

  @Test
  void whenTheKeysOfTheIssuerCannotBeReadATokenIsAnswered401AndNever500() throws Exception {
    String gone = "http://127.0.0.1:9/realms/gone";
    // The token names the issuer the core trusts, so the keys alone stand in its way.
    String bearer =
        "Bearer "
            + TestIssuer.token(
                TestIssuer.claims(Seed.MEMBER.subject(), Seed.TENANT.id().toString()).issuer(gone));
    try (ConfigurableApplicationContext api =
        SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, Stack.api(Stack.DATABASE, gone))) {
      HttpResponse<String> read = get(api, "/workspaces/" + Seed.ALPHA.key() + "/shell", bearer);
      assertThat(read.statusCode()).isEqualTo(401);
      assertThat(read.body()).contains("\"kind\":\"unauthenticated\"");
    }
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.platform.web.internal;

import dev.metis.core.platform.web.Forbidden;
import dev.metis.core.platform.web.NotFound;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
import java.util.Set;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.dao.DataAccessResourceFailureException;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatusCode;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.transaction.CannotCreateTransactionException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.ServletWebRequest;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.WebRequest;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.ResponseEntityExceptionHandler;

/** Turns every exception that leaves a controller, Spring's own included, into Problem Details. */
@RestControllerAdvice
class ProblemAdvice extends ResponseEntityExceptionHandler {

  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ProblemAdvice.class);

  private final Problems problems;

  ProblemAdvice(Problems problems) {
    this.problems = problems;
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(NotFound.class)
  ResponseEntity<Problem> notFound(HttpServletRequest request) {
    return problems.answer(404, request);
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(Forbidden.class)
  ResponseEntity<Problem> forbidden(HttpServletRequest request) {
    return problems.answer(403, request);
  }

  @ExceptionHandler({
    CannotCreateTransactionException.class,
    DataAccessResourceFailureException.class
  })
  ResponseEntity<Problem> unavailable(Exception failure, HttpServletRequest request) {
    LOG.warn("the database cannot be reached: {}", failure.getClass().getName());
    return problems.answer(503, request);
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
  ResponseEntity<Problem> defect(Exception failure, HttpServletRequest request) {
    LOG.error("a request failed: {}", trace(failure));
    return problems.answer(500, request);
  }

  // The type and the frames of each cause and never a message, which may hold a value of a record.
  static String trace(Throwable failure) {
    StringBuilder trace = new StringBuilder();
    Set<Throwable> seen = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
    for (Throwable cause = failure; cause != null && seen.add(cause); cause = cause.getCause()) {
      trace.append(trace.isEmpty() ? "" : "caused by ").append(cause.getClass().getName());
      for (StackTraceElement frame : cause.getStackTrace()) {
        trace.append("\n\tat ").append(frame);
      }
      trace.append('\n');
    }
    return trace.toString();
  }

  // Every exception of Spring MVC ends here, with the body it chose, which is replaced.
  @Override
  protected ResponseEntity<Object> createResponseEntity(
      @Nullable Object body, HttpHeaders headers, HttpStatusCode status, WebRequest request) {
    ResponseEntity<Problem> answer =
        problems.answer(status.value(), ((ServletWebRequest) request).getRequest());
    return ResponseEntity.status(status)
        .headers(headers)
        .headers(answer.getHeaders())
        .<Object>body(answer.getBody());
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain;

import java.util.List;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;

/** The sidebar of the shell: fifteen destinations in three groups, the same for every tenant. */
public record Nav(List<Nav.Item> home, List<Nav.Item> portfolio, List<Nav.Item> workspace) {

  /** No count is kept yet, so no badge has a value; a later release names its planned item. */
  public record Item(String code, @Nullable Void badge, @Nullable String planned) {}

  /** WSP-06: no requirement lets a tenant change the list, so it is a constant. */
  static final Nav FIXED =
      new Nav(
          List.of(open("myFocus"), open("approvals")),
          List.of(
              open("cockpit"),
              open("dashboard"),
              open("registry"),
              open("roadmap"),
              open("capacity"),
              open("risk"),
              later("investment", "V2"),
              later("scenarios", "V2"),
              later("steerco", "V2"),
              later("copilot", "V3")),
          List.of(open("frameworks"), open("templates"), open("settings")));

  private static Item open(String code) {
    return new Item(code, null, null);
  }

  private static Item later(String code, String release) {
    return new Item(code, null, release);
  }
}
```

`core/src/main/java/dev/metis/core/workspace/internal/domain/Shell.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;

/** The frame of every screen of a workspace: who looks, where, and where the person may go. */
public record Shell(
    Shell.User user,
    Shell.Tenant tenant,
    Shell.Place workspace,
    List<Shell.Place> workspaces,
    Nav nav,
    List<Shell.Portfolio> tree,
    int notifications) {

  /** The person who looks. */
  public record User(String name, String initials) {}

  /** The tenant of the person. */
  public record Tenant(String name) {}

  /** A workspace, by its public id. */
  public record Place(String id, String name) {}

  /** A portfolio of the tree. */
  public record Portfolio(String name, List<Program> programs) {}

  /** A program of the tree. */
  public record Program(String name, List<Project> projects) {}

  /** A project of the tree, by its public id. */
  public record Project(String id, String name) {}

  /**
   * WSP-02 REG-03: the shell of a workspace the person is a member of; no count is kept yet, so
   * there are no unread notifications.
   */
  public static Shell of(
      Person person, Space workspace, List<Space> workspaces, List<TreeRow> tree) {
    return new Shell(
        new User(person.name(), person.initials()),
        new Tenant(person.tenantName()),
        place(workspace),
        workspaces.stream().map(Shell::place).toList(),
        Nav.FIXED,
        treeOf(tree),
        0);
  }

  private static Place place(Space space) {
    return new Place(space.key(), space.name());
  }

  // The rows come in position order, so each level keeps the order it first meets.
  private static List<Portfolio> treeOf(List<TreeRow> rows) {
    List<Portfolio> tree = new ArrayList<>();
    Map<UUID, List<Program>> programs = new HashMap<>();
    Map<UUID, List<Project>> projects = new HashMap<>();
    for (TreeRow row : rows) {
      List<Program> ofPortfolio =
          programs.computeIfAbsent(row.portfolio(), id -> add(tree, row.portfolioName()));
      UUID program = row.program();
      if (program != null) {
        List<Project> ofProgram =
            projects.computeIfAbsent(
                program, id -> addProgram(ofPortfolio, Objects.requireNonNull(row.programName())));
        String project = row.project();
        if (project != null) {
          ofProgram.add(new Project(project, Objects.requireNonNull(row.projectName())));
        }
      }
    }
    return tree;
  }

  private static List<Program> add(List<Portfolio> tree, String name) {
    List<Program> programs = new ArrayList<>();
    tree.add(new Portfolio(name, programs));
    return programs;
  }

  private static List<Project> addProgram(List<Program> programs, String name) {
    List<Project> projects = new ArrayList<>();
    programs.add(new Program(name, projects));
    return projects;
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data;

import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.Person;
import java.util.Optional;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

/** The people of the tenant. */
@Repository
public class People {

  private final JdbcClient jdbc;

  People(JdbcClient jdbc) {
    this.jdbc = jdbc;
  }

  /** The person the subject of a token names, with the name of the tenant. */
  public Optional<Person> bySubject(String subject) {
    return jdbc.sql(
            """
            select person.id, person.name, person.initials, tenant.name as tenant_name
            from person
            join tenant on tenant.tenant_id = person.tenant_id
            where person.subject = :subject
            """)
        .param("subject", subject)
        .query(Person.class)
        .optional();
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data;

import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.Space;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

/** The workspaces of the tenant. */
@Repository
public class Workspaces {

  private final JdbcClient jdbc;

  Workspaces(JdbcClient jdbc) {
    this.jdbc = jdbc;
  }

  /** The workspace whose public id is the key. */
  public Optional<Space> byKey(String key) {
    return jdbc.sql("select id, key, name from workspace where key = :key")
        .param("key", key)
        .query(Space.class)
        .optional();
  }

  /** The workspaces the person is a member of, in position order. */
  public List<Space> of(UUID person) {
    return jdbc.sql(
            """
            select workspace.id, workspace.key, workspace.name
            from workspace
            join workspace_member on workspace_member.workspace_id = workspace.id
            where workspace_member.person_id = :person
            order by workspace.position, workspace.key
            """)
        .param("person", person)
        .query(Space.class)
        .list();
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data;

import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.TreeRow;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

/** The tree of portfolios, programs and projects of a workspace. */
@Repository
public class Trees {

  private final JdbcClient jdbc;

  Trees(JdbcClient jdbc) {
    this.jdbc = jdbc;
  }

  /** Every portfolio, program and project of the workspace, in position order at each level. */
  public List<TreeRow> of(UUID workspace) {
    return jdbc.sql(
            """
            select portfolio.id as portfolio, portfolio.name as portfolio_name,
                program.id as program, program.name as program_name,
                project.key as project, project.name as project_name
            from portfolio
            left join program on program.portfolio_id = portfolio.id
            left join project on project.program_id = program.id
            where portfolio.workspace_id = :workspace
            order by portfolio.position, portfolio.id, program.position, program.id,
                project.position, project.key
            """)
        .param("workspace", workspace)
        .query(TreeRow.class)
        .list();
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.app;

import dev.metis.core.platform.security.CurrentUser;
import dev.metis.core.platform.web.Forbidden;
import dev.metis.core.platform.web.NotFound;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data.People;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data.Trees;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data.Workspaces;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.Person;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.Shell;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.Space;
import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

/** Reads the shell of a workspace for the person of the token. */
@Service
public class ShellReader {

  private final People people;
  private final Workspaces workspaces;
  private final Trees trees;

  ShellReader(People people, Workspaces workspaces, Trees trees) {
    this.people = people;
    this.workspaces = workspaces;
    this.trees = trees;
  }

  /**
   * WSP-02: a person the tenant does not know, or who is no member of the workspace, may not open
   * it; a workspace of another tenant is missing, as one that does not exist.
   */
  @Transactional(readOnly = true)
  public Shell read(CurrentUser user, String workspaceKey) {
    Person person = people.bySubject(user.subject()).orElseThrow(Forbidden::new);
    Space workspace = workspaces.byKey(workspaceKey).orElseThrow(NotFound::new);
    List<Space> memberOf = workspaces.of(person.id());
    if (!memberOf.contains(workspace)) {
      throw new Forbidden();
    }
    return Shell.of(person, workspace, memberOf, trees.of(workspace.id()));
  }
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.web;

import dev.metis.core.platform.security.CurrentUser;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.app.ShellReader;
import dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.domain.Shell;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

/** The shell of a workspace, which the app draws around every screen. */
@RestController
class ShellController {

  private final ShellReader reader;

  ShellController(ShellReader reader) {
    this.reader = reader;
  }

  @GetMapping("/workspaces/{workspaceId}/shell")
  Shell shell(@AuthenticationPrincipal CurrentUser user, @PathVariable String workspaceId) {
    return reader.read(user, workspaceId);
  }
}
```

```yaml
  application:
    name: metis-core

    banner-mode: "off"
  threads:

      enabled: true
  datasource:
    hikari:
      data-source-properties:
        # The driver keeps the values of a row out of the text of an error, which a log may hold.
        logServerErrorDetail: false
  mvc:
    servlet:
      # The dispatcher starts with the core, so no request waits for it and every line of a
      # request is the request's own.

      group:

          # Ready while the database answers, so a platform sends no request the core cannot serve.
          include: readinessState,db
logging:
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;

/** The counter-test of the coverage check. */
final class CoverageCanaries {

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          Canary.of("coverage-untested", "coverage", "dev.metis.core.CanaryUntested")
              .writing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "CanaryUntested.java",
                  """
                  package dev.metis.core;

                  final class CanaryUntested {
                    private CanaryUntested() {}

                    static int next(int number) {
                      return number + 1;
                    }
                  }
                  """),
          // A project with code whose report never came, which must not count as nothing to cover.
          Canary.of(
                  "coverage-no-report",
                  "coverage",
                  "no coverage report core/build/reports/jacoco/test/jacocoTestReport.xml")
              .appending(
                  "core/build.gradle.kts",
                  "\ntasks.named(\"jacocoTestReport\") { enabled = false }\n"),
          // Coverage of the unit tests alone, which never run a repository.
          Canary.of(
                  "coverage-unit-only", "coverage", "dev.metis.core.workspace.internal.data.People")
              .appending(
                  "core/build.gradle.kts",
                  """

                  tasks.jacocoTestReport {
                      executionData.setFrom(layout.buildDirectory.file("jacoco/test.exec"))
                  }
                  """));

  private CoverageCanaries() {}
}
```

```java
package dev.metis.tools.canary;

import java.util.List;

/** The counter-tests of the integration check. */
final class IntegrationCanaries {

  private static final String MIGRATION = "core/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__registry.sql";
  private static final String POLICY =
      """
      create policy tenant_rows on program
          using (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid);
      """;

  static final List<Canary> ALL =
      List.of(
          // A table a migration left without its policy.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-no-policy",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every table forces row-level security")
              .replacing(MIGRATION, POLICY, ""),
          // A table whose policy does not bind its owner, which the API alone would not show.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-no-force",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every table forces row-level security")
              .replacing(MIGRATION, "alter table program force row level security;\n", ""),
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-no-tenant-column",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every table holds the tenant of its row")
              .appending(
                  MIGRATION, "\ncreate table canary (id uuid primary key default uuidv7());\n"),
          // The role of the API allowed to pass by every policy.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-bypassrls",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API is no superuser")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/postgres/roles.sh",
                  "create role metis_app login password",
                  "create role metis_app login bypassrls password"),
          // The role of the API made a member of the owner, whose rights it then holds.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-app-in-owner-role",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API is no superuser")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/postgres/roles.sh",
                  "alter database",
                  "grant metis_migrator to metis_app;\nalter database"),
          // A write granted to every role, which a list of the grants to the API does not show.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-public-write",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API may read")
              .appending(MIGRATION, "\ngrant insert on person to public;\n"),
          // A right on one column, which a list of the rights on tables does not show.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-column-grant",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API may read")
              .appending(MIGRATION, "\ngrant update (name) on tenant to metis_app;\n"),
          // A materialized view the API can read, which no policy guards and no grant list shows.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-readable-view",
                  "integration",
                  "CatalogTest > TEN-02 every relation the API can read")
              .appending(
                  MIGRATION,
                  """

                  create materialized view canary as select name from tenant;
                  grant select on canary to metis_app;
                  """),
          // A changed stack under the seed of a green run, which a cached result would answer.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-stack-input",
                  "integration",
                  "RolesTest > TEN-02 the role of the API is no superuser")
              .replacing(
                  "stack/postgres/roles.sh",
                  "create role metis_app login password",
                  "create role metis_app login bypassrls password")
              .arguments("-PtestSeed=1"),
          // The tenant set for the session, so it outlives its transaction on a pooled connection.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-session-tenant",
                  "integration",
                  "TenantTransactionTest > TEN-02 the tenant of a transaction ends with it")
              .replacing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "platform/tenancy/internal/TenantTransactionManager.java",
                  "set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, true)",
                  "set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, false)"),
          // A read-only transaction left to the driver, which the tests tell to leave it alone.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-read-only",
                  "integration",
                  "TenantTransactionTest > aReadOnlyTransactionCannotWriteInTheDatabase")
              .replacing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "platform/tenancy/internal/TenantTransactionManager.java",
                  "    setEnforceReadOnly(true);\n",
                  ""),
          // The tree ordered by name, which a seed whose names follow its positions would not show.
          Canary.of(
                  "integration-tree-order",
                  "integration",
                  "RepositoriesTest > WSP-06 REG-03 the tree of a workspace comes in position order")
              .replacing(
                  Canaries.CORE + "workspace/internal/data/Trees.java",
                  "order by portfolio.position",
                  "order by portfolio.name"),
          // A test deleted without lowering the floor, which only the exact floor notices.
          Canary.of("integration-floor", "integration", "update test-floor.json")
              .deleting("test-support/java/dev/metis/testsupport/LocalHostOnlyTest.java"),
          // A setting of the order lost, which the test of the order runs here too.
          Canary.of("integration-fixed-order", "integration", "TestOrderTest >")
              .replacing(
                  "build-logic/src/main/kotlin/metis.java-conventions.gradle.kts",
                  "    systemProperty(\"junit.jupiter.testmethod.order.default\","
                      + " \"org.junit.jupiter.api.MethodOrderer\\$Random\")\n",
                  ""),
          // An endpoint of the actuator more than health, which the API must not answer.
          Canary.of("integration-exposed-endpoint", "integration", "ProbesTest > theDiscoveryPage")
              .replacing(
                  "core/src/main/resources/application.yml",
                  "management:\n",
                  "management:\n  endpoints:\n    web:\n      exposure:\n        include: health,env\n"));

  private IntegrationCanaries() {}
}
```

### Task 7: Keycloak and the development realm

Keycloak 26.8.1 joins the stack with the development realm `stack/keycloak/metis.json`: a public client `metis-dev` for the password grant, a mapper that puts every value of the attribute `tenant_id` of a user into the token as a list, a mapper that adds the audience `metis-core`, and two people whose password the import reads from the environment: `developer`, and `two-tenants`, whose two tenants reach the core as a list of two and are answered 401. The integration test starts the stack's own image with that file once, writes the rows of the first person and opens the shell with a token of the real product, and sends the token of the second, which names both tenants. The image check writes the same rows into the stack's database, takes a token from Keycloak inside the stack, whose address is the issuer the API trusts, and reads the shell with it.

**Files:**

- Create: `stack/keycloak/metis.json`
- Test: `core/src/integrationTest/java/dev/metis/core/KeycloakTest.java`
- Test: `tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/image/ShellReadTest.java`
- Create: `tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/image/ShellRead.java`
- Modify: `stack/compose.yaml`
- Modify: `tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/image/FakeDocker.java`
- Modify: `tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/image/ImageCheckTest.java`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: the shell (Task 6); the stack and the image check (Task 4).
- Produces: the realm; the class `ShellRead` of the image check; the counter-test image-wrong-issuer.

```yaml
# The local stack runs the image as a deployment runs it: docker compose -f stack/compose.yaml up --build --wait
# Every password comes from the environment and from no file here; the README says how to give them.
name: metis

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18.6@sha256:74935e72241653ca55e0414067e6d8763aceb8a810eb51b452253ec3dcfc4336
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_DB: metis
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${METIS_POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?the password of the superuser of the database}
      METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD: ${METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD:?the password of the owner of the tables}
      METIS_APP_PASSWORD: ${METIS_APP_PASSWORD:?the password of the role of the API}
    volumes:
      - ./postgres/roles.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/roles.sh:ro
      - database:/var/lib/postgresql/18/docker
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "--username=postgres", "--dbname=metis"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 30

  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.8.1@sha256:79c623a22abacf3fe6c00a5fb30f5b7843d717b234033b80995891c06116d244
    command: ["start-dev", "--import-realm", "--health-enabled=true"]
    environment:
      METIS_PERSON_PASSWORD: ${METIS_PERSON_PASSWORD:?the password of the person of the development realm}
    volumes:
      - ./keycloak/metis.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/metis.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      # The image has no curl, so bash asks the management port itself.
      test:
        - "CMD"
        - "bash"
        - "-c"
        - "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/9000 && printf 'GET /health/ready HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n' >&3 && grep -q UP <&3"
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 60

  core:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: core/Dockerfile
    image: ${METIS_IMAGE:-metis-core:local}
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${METIS_PORT-8080}:8080"
    environment:
      TZ: ${METIS_TIME_ZONE:-UTC}
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/metis
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: metis_app
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: ${METIS_APP_PASSWORD:?the password of the role of the API}
      METIS_SECURITY_ISSUER: http://keycloak:8080/realms/metis
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cpus: 1
    mem_limit: 2g
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "--fail", "--silent", "http://localhost:8080/actuator/health/readiness"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 30


  migrate:
    image: ${METIS_IMAGE:-metis-core:local}
    pull_policy: never
    environment:
      SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE: migrate
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/metis
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: metis_migrator
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: ${METIS_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD:?the password of the owner of the tables}
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

volumes:
  database:
```

`core/src/integrationTest/java/dev/metis/core/KeycloakTest.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.core;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import org.assertj.core.api.InstanceOfAssertFactories;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.json.JsonParserFactory;
import org.springframework.context.ConfigurableApplicationContext;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.testcontainers.containers.GenericContainer;
import org.testcontainers.containers.wait.strategy.Wait;
import org.testcontainers.utility.DockerImageName;
import org.testcontainers.utility.MountableFile;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;

class KeycloakTest {

  // The realm of the local stack, which this test imports as the stack does.
  private static final Path REALM = Path.of("stack/keycloak/metis.json");

  // The password the realm gives its people, made anew for each run.
  private static final String PASSWORD = UUID.randomUUID().toString();

  // The stack's own image with the realm of the stack, started once for the tests here.
  private static final GenericContainer<?> KEYCLOAK = keycloak();

  private static GenericContainer<?> keycloak() {
    GenericContainer<?> keycloak =
        new GenericContainer<>(DockerImageName.parse(Stack.image("keycloak")))
            .withCommand("start-dev", "--import-realm")
            .withEnv("METIS_PERSON_PASSWORD", PASSWORD)
            .withCopyFileToContainer(
                MountableFile.forHostPath(REALM), "/opt/keycloak/data/import/metis.json")
            .withExposedPorts(8080)
            .waitingFor(
                Wait.forHttp("/realms/metis/.well-known/openid-configuration")
                    .forPort(8080)
                    .withStartupTimeout(Duration.ofMinutes(2)));
    Stack.publishOnLoopback(keycloak);
    keycloak.start();
    return keycloak;
  }

  private static String issuer() {
    return "http://localhost:" + KEYCLOAK.getMappedPort(8080) + "/realms/metis";
  }

  // The answer of Keycloak to the password of a person of the realm.
  private static Map<String, Object> tokens(String username) throws Exception {
    String body =
        Map.of(
                "grant_type",
                "password",
                "client_id",
                "metis-dev",
                "username",
                username,
                "password",
                PASSWORD)
            .entrySet()
            .stream()
            .map(
                field ->
                    field.getKey()
                        + "="
                        + URLEncoder.encode(field.getValue(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
            .collect(Collectors.joining("&"));
    HttpRequest request =
        HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(issuer() + "/protocol/openid-connect/token"))
            .header("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
            .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body))
            .build();
    try (HttpClient http = HttpClient.newHttpClient()) {
      return JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser()
          .parseMap(http.send(request, BodyHandlers.ofString()).body());
    }
  }

  // The shell of the workspace, read from a core that trusts the Keycloak of this test.
  private static HttpResponse<String> shell(String workspace, Map<String, Object> tokens)
      throws Exception {
    assertThat(tokens).containsKey("access_token");
    try (ConfigurableApplicationContext api =
        SpringApplication.run(CoreApplication.class, Stack.api(Stack.DATABASE, issuer()))) {
      int port = api.getEnvironment().getRequiredProperty("local.server.port", Integer.class);
      HttpRequest shell =
          HttpRequest.newBuilder(
                  URI.create("http://localhost:" + port + "/workspaces/" + workspace + "/shell"))
              .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + tokens.get("access_token"))
              .build();
      try (HttpClient http = HttpClient.newHttpClient()) {
        return http.send(shell, BodyHandlers.ofString());
      }
    }
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 a token of the real Keycloak, from the realm of the stack, opens the shell of its person in its tenant")
  void aTokenOfKeycloak() throws Exception {
    JsonNode person = JsonMapper.builder().build().readTree(REALM.toFile()).path("users").get(0);
    UUID tenant = UUID.fromString(person.path("attributes").path("tenant_id").get(0).asString());
    String name = "Developer " + Seed.MARK;
    JdbcClient admin = Stack.admin(Stack.DATABASE);
    admin
        .sql("insert into tenant (tenant_id, name) values (:tenant, :name)")
        .param("tenant", tenant)
        .param("name", "Keycloak " + Seed.MARK)
        .update();
    UUID personId =
        admin
            .sql(
                "insert into person (tenant_id, subject, name, initials)"
                    + " values (:tenant, :subject, :name, 'DE') returning id")
            .param("tenant", tenant)
            .param("subject", person.path("id").asString())
            .param("name", name)
            .query(UUID.class)
            .single();
    UUID workspace =
        admin
            .sql(
                "insert into workspace (tenant_id, key, name, position)"
                    + " values (:tenant, 'keycloak', :name, 0) returning id")
            .param("tenant", tenant)
            .param("name", "Keycloak " + Seed.MARK)
            .query(UUID.class)
            .single();
    admin
        .sql(
            "insert into workspace_member (tenant_id, workspace_id, person_id)"
                + " values (:tenant, :workspace, :person)")
        .param("tenant", tenant)
        .param("workspace", workspace)
        .param("person", personId)
        .update();
    Map<String, Object> tokens = tokens(person.path("username").asString());
    // The mapper sends every tenant as a list, here a list of one.
    assertThat(tenantsOf(tokens)).asInstanceOf(InstanceOfAssertFactories.LIST).hasSize(1);
    HttpResponse<String> answer = shell("keycloak", tokens);
    assertThat(answer.statusCode()).isEqualTo(200);
    assertThat(JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser().parseMap(answer.body()))
        .containsEntry("user", Map.of("name", name, "initials", "DE"));
  }

  @Test
  @DisplayName(
      "TEN-02 a person of the realm with two tenants gets a token that names both, which the core answers 401")
  void aPersonWithTwoTenants() throws Exception {
    JsonNode person = JsonMapper.builder().build().readTree(REALM.toFile()).path("users").get(1);
    Map<String, Object> tokens = tokens(person.path("username").asString());
    assertThat(tenantsOf(tokens)).asInstanceOf(InstanceOfAssertFactories.LIST).hasSize(2);
    assertThat(shell("keycloak", tokens).statusCode()).isEqualTo(401);
  }

  // The tenant claim of the access token, read from the token itself.
  private static Object tenantsOf(Map<String, Object> tokens) {
    String token = String.valueOf(tokens.get("access_token"));
    String payload = token.substring(token.indexOf('.') + 1, token.lastIndexOf('.'));
    return Objects.requireNonNull(
        JsonParserFactory.getJsonParser()
            .parseMap(new String(Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(payload), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
            .get("tenant_id"));
  }
}
```

`tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/image/ShellReadTest.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.tools.image;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import dev.metis.tools.Processes;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class ShellReadTest {

  @TempDir Path root;

  private final FakeDocker docker = new FakeDocker();

  @BeforeEach
  void realm() throws IOException {
    Files.createDirectories(root.resolve("stack/keycloak"));
    Files.writeString(root.resolve(ShellRead.REALM), FakeDocker.REALM);
  }

  private List<String> read() throws IOException {
    return new ShellRead(docker.context(root, 1).context(), "metis-check").problems("secret");
  }

  @Test
  void theShellOfThePersonOfTheRealmReadWithATokenOfKeycloakIsClean() throws IOException {
    assertThat(read()).isEmpty();
    assertThat(docker.calls.get(0))
        .startsWith("docker", "exec", "metis-check-postgres-1", "psql", "--username=postgres")
        .last()
        .asString()
        .contains(
            "values ('15169616-8309-41f4-b55c-b3c3c903f2e1', '4e41662f-e84a-4bdb-85d8-65f9eeb9a93e',"
                + " 'Check person', 'CP')");
    assertThat(docker.calls.get(1))
        .startsWith("docker", "exec", "metis-check-core-1", "curl", "--silent", "--fail")
        .contains("username=developer", "password=secret")
        .endsWith("http://keycloak:8080/realms/metis/protocol/openid-connect/token");
    assertThat(docker.calls.get(2))
        .contains("Authorization: Bearer a.b.c")
        .endsWith("http://localhost:8080/workspaces/check/shell");
  }

  @Test
  void rowsThatCannotBeWrittenOrNoTokenStopTheRead() throws IOException {
    docker.answers.put(
        "exec psql", new Processes.Result(1, "ERROR:  relation \"tenant\" does not exist\n"));
    assertThat(read())
        .containsExactly(
            "cannot write the rows of the person: ERROR:  relation \"tenant\" does not exist");
    docker.answers.put("exec psql", FakeDocker.ok(""));
    docker.answers.put("exec token", new Processes.Result(22, "{\"error\":\"invalid_grant\"}"));
    assertThat(read()).containsExactly("Keycloak gave no token: {\"error\":\"invalid_grant\"}");
    docker.answers.put("exec token", FakeDocker.ok("{\"error\":\"invalid_grant\"}"));
    assertThat(read()).containsExactly("Keycloak gave no token: {\"error\":\"invalid_grant\"}");
    docker.answers.put("exec token", FakeDocker.ok("<html>"));
    assertThat(read()).containsExactly("Keycloak gave no token: <html>");
  }

  @Test
  void aShellAnsweredWithAnotherStatusOrForAnotherPersonOrWorkspaceIsAProblem() throws IOException {
    docker.answers.put("exec shell", FakeDocker.ok("{\"kind\":\"unauthenticated\"}\n401"));
    assertThat(read()).containsExactly("the shell answered 401: {\"kind\":\"unauthenticated\"}");
    docker.answers.put(
        "exec shell", FakeDocker.ok(FakeDocker.SHELL.replace("Check person", "Someone") + "\n200"));
    assertThat(read()).singleElement().asString().startsWith("the shell answered 200: ");
    docker.answers.put(
        "exec shell", FakeDocker.ok(FakeDocker.SHELL.replace("\"check\"", "\"other\"") + "\n200"));
    assertThat(read()).singleElement().asString().startsWith("the shell answered 200: ");
    docker.answers.put("exec shell", FakeDocker.ok(FakeDocker.SHELL + "\n500"));
    assertThat(read()).singleElement().asString().startsWith("the shell answered 500: ");
    docker.answers.put("exec shell", FakeDocker.ok("<html>\n502"));
    assertThat(read()).containsExactly("the shell answered 502: <html>");
    docker.answers.put("exec shell", FakeDocker.ok(""));
    assertThat(read()).containsExactly("the shell answered : ");
  }
}
```

`tools/src/test/java/dev/metis/tools/image/FakeDocker.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.tools.image;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import dev.metis.tools.Processes;
import dev.metis.tools.TestContext;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

/** Docker for the tests of the image check: each command answers by what tells it apart. */
final class FakeDocker {

  static final String UP = "{\"status\":\"UP\"}";
  static final String LOCKED =
      "true|[\"ALL\"]|[\"no-new-privileges:true\"]|2147483648|1000000000|{\"/tmp\":\"\"}|30"
          + "|null|false|[]";
  static final String INSIDE =
      "10001\nCapEff:\t0000000000000000\nCapBnd:\t0000000000000000\noverlay / overlay ro,relatime 0 0\n";

  /** A realm of one person, as the stack's realm file holds it. */
  static final String REALM =
      """
      {"realm": "metis", "users": [{"id": "4e41662f-e84a-4bdb-85d8-65f9eeb9a93e",
        "username": "developer",
        "attributes": {"tenant_id": ["15169616-8309-41f4-b55c-b3c3c903f2e1"]}}]}
      """;

  /** The shell the core answers for the person in the workspace of the check. */
  static final String SHELL =
      "{\"user\":{\"name\":\"Check person\",\"initials\":\"CP\"},"
          + "\"workspace\":{\"id\":\"check\",\"name\":\"Check\"}}";

  /** What Flyway says when the API starts on a database no migration job ran on. */
  static final String BEHIND = "Detected resolved migration not applied to database";

  /** Every command, as it was given. */
  final List<List<String>> calls = new ArrayList<>();

  /** What each command answers, by its key. */
  final Map<String, Processes.Result> answers =
      new HashMap<>(
          Map.ofEntries(
              Map.entry("image inspect", ok("182886790\n")),
              Map.entry("exec probe", ok(INSIDE)),
              Map.entry("compose down", ok("")),
              Map.entry("compose up", ok("")),
              Map.entry("compose up postgres", ok("")),
              Map.entry("compose up core", ok("")),
              Map.entry("compose stop", ok("")),
              Map.entry("compose logs", ok("core-1  | {\"message\":\"Started\"}\n")),
              Map.entry("compose logs core", ok("core-1  | " + BEHIND + ": 1.\n")),
              Map.entry("compose logs migrate", ok("migrate-1  | waiting for the database\n")),
              Map.entry("inspect lockdown", ok(LOCKED + "\n")),
              Map.entry("inspect state", ok("exited 1\n")),
              Map.entry(
                  "inspect env",
                  ok(
                      "[\"SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME=metis_app\",\"SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=x\"]\n")),
              Map.entry("stop --timeout", ok("metis-check-core-1\n")),
              Map.entry("exec readiness", ok(UP)),
              Map.entry("exec liveness", ok(UP)),
              Map.entry("exec psql", ok("INSERT 0 1\n")),
              Map.entry("exec token", ok("{\"access_token\":\"a.b.c\"}")),
              Map.entry("exec shell", ok(SHELL + "\n200")),
              Map.entry("stats --no-stream", ok("123.6MiB / 2GiB\n")),
              Map.entry("inspect exit", ok("143\n"))));

  /** The readiness of the API alone on a database no migration job ran on, asked first. */
  Processes.Result refused = new Processes.Result(1, "Error: container is not running");

  /** The name of a password the check makes, which the environment of the core then holds. */
  String leaked = "";

  static Processes.Result ok(String output) {
    return new Processes.Result(0, output);
  }

  /** A context whose processes this Docker answers, the first readiness with refused. */
  TestContext context(Path root, long step) {
    List<Boolean> first = new ArrayList<>(List.of(true));
    return new TestContext(root)
        .step(step)
        .run(
            (dir, command) -> {
              calls.add(command);
              String key = key(command);
              if (key.equals("exec readiness") && first.getFirst()) {
                first.set(0, false);
                return refused;
              }
              if (key.equals("inspect env") && !leaked.isEmpty()) {
                return ok("[\"SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME=metis_app\",\"X=" + made(leaked) + "\"]");
              }
              return answers.getOrDefault(key, new Processes.Result(99, "unexpected " + key));
            });
  }

  /** Runs the image check with this Docker, beside the realm of the stack. */
  TestContext check(Path root, long step, String... args) throws IOException {
    Files.createDirectories(root.resolve("stack/keycloak"));
    Files.writeString(root.resolve(ShellRead.REALM), REALM);
    TestContext test = context(root, step);
    test.exit = ImageCheck.command(test.context(), List.of(args));
    return test;
  }

  // The value the check of this run gave the password, the last one its commands hold.
  private String made(String password) {
    return calls.stream()
        .flatMap(List::stream)
        .filter(word -> word.startsWith(password + "="))
        .reduce((earlier, later) -> later)
        .orElseThrow()
        .substring(password.length() + 1);
  }

  /** The commands, the passwords the check makes for each run left out. */
  List<List<String>> made() {
    return calls.stream()
        .map(
            command ->
                command.stream()
                    .map(word -> word.replaceFirst("^(METIS_\\w+_PASSWORD)=.*", "$1=*"))
                    .toList())
        .toList();
  }

  private static String key(List<String> command) {
    List<String> words =
        command.stream().dropWhile(word -> word.equals("env") || word.contains("=")).toList();
    assertThat(words.getFirst()).isEqualTo("docker");
    return switch (words.get(1)) {
      case "compose" ->
          "compose "
              + words.get(6)
              + (words.contains("--no-deps") || Set.of("core", "migrate").contains(words.getLast())
                  ? " " + words.getLast()
                  : "");
      case "exec" -> exec(words);
      case "inspect" -> inspect(words.get(3));
      default -> words.get(1) + " " + words.get(2);
    };
  }

  private static String inspect(String format) {
    if (format.contains("Env")) {
      return "inspect env";
    }
    return format.contains("Readonly")
        ? "inspect lockdown"
        : format.contains("Status") ? "inspect state" : "inspect exit";
  }

  private static String exec(List<String> words) {
    if (words.contains("psql")) {
      return "exec psql";
    }
    if (!words.contains("curl")) {
      return "exec probe";
    }
    String url = words.getLast();
    return url.endsWith("token")
        ? "exec token"
        : url.endsWith("shell")
            ? "exec shell"
            : url.endsWith("readiness") ? "exec readiness" : "exec liveness";
  }
}
```

```java
  @Test

    assertThat(docker.made().get(1)).isEqualTo(compose("down", "--volumes"));
    assertThat(docker.made())

                "--no-deps",
                "--wait",
                "--wait-timeout",

            List.of(
                "docker",

                "metis-check-core-1"),
            compose("logs", "--no-color", "core"),

            List.of("docker", "inspect", "--format", "{{json .Config.Env}}", "metis-check-core-1"),

    assertThat(
```

`tools/src/main/java/dev/metis/tools/image/ShellRead.java`:

```java
package dev.metis.tools.image;

import dev.metis.tools.Context;
import dev.metis.tools.Processes;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import tools.jackson.core.JacksonException;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;

/** Reads the shell from the running stack as its development person, with a token of Keycloak. */
final class ShellRead {

  /** The development realm of the stack, which names the person and the tenant of the token. */
  static final String REALM = "stack/keycloak/metis.json";

  /** The workspace the check writes for the person, and its name. */
  static final String WORKSPACE = "check";

  private static final String PERSON = "Check person";
  private static final JsonMapper JSON = JsonMapper.builder().build();
  private final Context context;
  private final String project;

  ShellRead(Context context, String project) {
    this.context = context;
    this.project = project;
  }

  /** The problems of the read: none when the shell names the person and the workspace. */
  List<String> problems(String password) throws IOException {
    JsonNode person =
        JSON.readTree(Files.readString(context.root().resolve(REALM))).path("users").get(0);
    UUID subject = UUID.fromString(person.path("id").asString());
    UUID tenant = UUID.fromString(person.path("attributes").path("tenant_id").get(0).asString());
    Processes.Result seeded = seed(subject, tenant);
    if (seeded.status() != 0) {
      return List.of("cannot write the rows of the person: " + seeded.output().strip());
    }
    Processes.Result token = token(person.path("username").asString(), password);
    String bearer = accessToken(token);
    if (bearer.isEmpty()) {
      return List.of("Keycloak gave no token: " + token.output().strip());
    }
    Processes.Result shell =
        core(
            "--max-time",
            "5",
            "--write-out",
            "\n%{http_code}",
            "--header",
            "Authorization: Bearer " + bearer,
            "http://localhost:8080/workspaces/" + WORKSPACE + "/shell");
    return judged(shell.output());
  }

  // Rows of the person's tenant, written by the superuser of the database, whom no policy binds.
  private Processes.Result seed(UUID subject, UUID tenant) {
    String sql =
        """
        insert into tenant (tenant_id, name) values ('%s', 'Check tenant');
        insert into person (tenant_id, subject, name, initials) values ('%s', '%s', '%s', 'CP');
        insert into workspace (tenant_id, key, name, position) values ('%s', '%s', 'Check', 0);
        insert into workspace_member (tenant_id, workspace_id, person_id)
            select person.tenant_id, workspace.id, person.id from person, workspace;
        """
            .formatted(tenant, tenant, subject, PERSON, tenant, WORKSPACE);
    List<String> command =
        new ArrayList<>(List.of("docker", "exec", project + "-postgres-1", "psql"));
    command.addAll(List.of("--username=postgres", "--dbname=metis", "--set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1"));
    command.addAll(List.of("--command", sql));
    return context.run().apply(context.root(), command);
  }

  // From inside the stack, so the issuer of the token is the one the core trusts.
  private Processes.Result token(String username, String password) {
    return core(
        "--fail",
        "--max-time",
        "5",
        "--retry",
        "60",
        "--retry-delay",
        "1",
        "--retry-all-errors",
        "--data",
        "grant_type=password",
        "--data",
        "client_id=metis-dev",
        "--data-urlencode",
        "username=" + username,
        "--data-urlencode",
        "password=" + password,
        "http://keycloak:8080/realms/metis/protocol/openid-connect/token");
  }

  private static String accessToken(Processes.Result token) {
    try {
      return JSON.readTree(token.output()).path("access_token").asString("");
    } catch (JacksonException notJson) {
      return "";
    }
  }

  private static List<String> judged(String output) {
    String status = output.substring(output.lastIndexOf('\n') + 1).strip();
    String body = output.substring(0, Math.max(0, output.lastIndexOf('\n')));
    try {
      JsonNode shell = JSON.readTree(body);
      if (status.equals("200")
          && shell.path("workspace").path("id").asString("").equals(WORKSPACE)
          && shell.path("user").path("name").asString("").equals(PERSON)) {
        return List.of();
      }
    } catch (JacksonException notJson) {
      // An answer that is no JSON is reported below with its status.
    }
    return List.of("the shell answered " + status + ": " + body.strip());
  }

  private Processes.Result core(String... curl) {
    List<String> command = new ArrayList<>(List.of("docker", "exec", project + "-core-1", "curl"));
    command.add("--silent");
    command.addAll(List.of(curl));
    return context.run().apply(context.root(), command);
  }
}
```
